title: Content Marketing Manager (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Du weißt, was du tust, und willst eine Umgebung, in der das auch gefordert wird. Bei Migrando bekommst du volle Verantwortung für Content-Strategie und Umsetzung, ein Team, das abliefert, und eine Reichweite, mit der sich echte Tests lohnen.

  • Modernes Toolset der Extraklasse
    Ahrefs, Searchmetrics, Screaming Frog, Sistrix oder Semrush: Du wählst die Tools, die du für die beste Analyse und Performance brauchst. Bei essenziellen Helfern sparen wir nicht am falschen Ende.
  • Daten statt Bauchgefühl
    Du bekommst den Raum, Hypothesen aufzustellen, A/B-Tests zu strukturieren und Ergebnisse wirklich auszuwerten. Es geht nicht darum, Traffic zu reporten, sondern zu verstehen, was dahintersteckt und was als Nächstes zu tun ist.
  • Große Reichweite
    15.000 Website-Klicks täglich, davon 6.500 auf Blog und News. Dein Content landet nicht im Nirgendwo, er wird gelesen, getestet und verbessert. Du siehst schnell, was funktioniert.
  • Ein Team, das mitdenkt, und kurze Wege
    Design, SEO, Development, Performance Marketing: Du arbeitest direkt mit Spezialist:innen zusammen, die wissen, was sie tun. Keine Hierarchieschleifen, keine langen Mails. Du sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook oder Windows-Tower, du entscheidest. Dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und ein ergonomischer Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

In dieser Rolle gestaltest du Inhalte, die gefunden werden, verstanden werden und konvertieren. Du planst, schreibst und optimierst und arbeitest dafür eng mit SEO, Design und Marketing zusammen. Egal ob Landingpage, Ads-Creatives, E-Mail-Kampagne oder CTAs auf unserem Blog.

  • SEO-Texterstellung & Optimierung
    Du erstellst hochwertige, SEO-optimierte Long- und Short-Form-Inhalte, von Fachartikeln über Landingpages bis zu FAQs. Du schreibst nicht für Suchmaschinen, sondern für Menschen, und weißt, dass beides kein Widerspruch ist.
  • Copywriting
    Du schreibst klare, verständliche Texte für Website- und Service-Seiten, Ratgeber, E-Mail-Strecken und Ads. Du weißt, dass der Unterschied zwischen einem guten und einem sehr guten Text oft eine einzige Formulierung ist.
  • Content-Audit & Optimierung
    Du lässt bestehende Inhalte nicht veralten. Du prüfst regelmäßig Performance, Aktualität und SEO-Tauglichkeit, schließt Content-Gaps und verhinderst aktiv Content-Rot.
  • Conversion-Rate-Optimierung
    Du analysierst, wo Nutzer:innen abspringen, formulierst klare Hypothesen und optimierst Inhalte, CTAs und Seitenstrukturen. A/B-Tests sind für dich kein Sonderaufwand, sondern Standard.
  • Landingpage-Entwicklung
    Gemeinsam mit dem Design-Team entwickelst du conversionstarke Landingpages, von der inhaltlichen Konzeption über den Feinschliff in Elementor bis zur Auswertung nach dem Launch.
  • HubSpot-Marketing
    Du baust Landingpages, CTAs, Formulare und Kampagnen mit den Marketing-Tools von HubSpot, platzierst sie in Abstimmung mit dem Team auf der Website und wertest die Ergebnisse gemeinsam aus.
  • Storytelling & neue Formate
    Du denkst Content nicht nur als Artikel. Du entwickelst neue Formate wie interaktive Ratgeber, Info-Seiten oder Conversion-Elemente und erzählst komplexe Themen so, dass sie wirklich ankommen.
  • Performance-Reporting
    Du erstellst Reports zu Traffic, Rankings, Leads und CRO-Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern echtes Handwerk und praktische Erfahrung. Wir suchen jemanden, der Content nicht nur produziert, sondern strategisch denkt: Warum sucht jemand nach diesem Begriff? Was erwartet die Person zu finden? Und was muss passieren, damit sie bleibt und konvertiert? Bei uns zählt, was du in der Praxis wirklich draufhast, und dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Erfahrung im Content Marketing & Storytelling
    Du hast bereits Inhalte entwickelt, die nicht nur gut klingen, sondern gelesen, verstanden und genutzt werden. Du weißt, wie man eine Content-Strategie aufbaut und umsetzt, und kannst das mit erfolgreichen Projekten oder Kampagnen belegen.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und starke Schreibskills
    Du schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch und hast ein sicheres Gefühl für klare, verständliche Sprache, auch bei komplexen Themen. Du erkennst, wenn ein Text nicht das tut, was er soll, und weißt, wie man es besser macht. Gutes Englisch ist ein Plus. Einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht, deine Texte sprechen für sich.
  • Gefühl für SEO & Suchintentionen
    Keyword-Recherche, SERP-Analyse, Suchintention: Das ist für dich Handwerk, das du im Schlaf beherrschst. Du weißt, wann man ein Thema mit einem langen Artikel angeht und wann eine kurze, fokussierte Seite besser rankt.
  • Praxis in Content-Optimierung
    Bestehende Inhalte lässt du nicht einfach liegen. Du schaust in die Zahlen, erkennst Potenziale und verbesserst Texte, Struktur und CTAs Schritt für Schritt.
  • Blick für Nutzerführung & Conversion
    Du siehst Texte immer aus Nutzerperspektive: verständlich, logisch aufgebaut, mit klarem nächsten Schritt. Du weißt, dass ein guter CTA kein Zufall ist.
  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit
    Guter Content entsteht selten im Alleingang. Du gibst klares Feedback, holst dir aktiv Input aus Design, SEO und Performance Marketing und weißt, wie man gemeinsam schneller zu besseren Ergebnissen kommt.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität
    Du wartest nicht auf die perfekte Lösung. Du testest neue Formate, optimierst nach und bringst Projekte eigenständig über die Ziellinie.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Nice to have: SEO-Tools
    Sistrix, Ahrefs, Google Search Console: Du hast damit gearbeitet und weißt, wie man die Daten interpretiert.
  • Nice to have: WordPress, Elementor & HubSpot
    WordPress (oder ein Headless-CMS), Elementor und die Marketing-Features von HubSpot sind kein Neuland für dich, und du stimmst dich ganz selbstverständlich mit Designer:innen in Figma ab.

title: Controller / Bilanzbuchhalter / Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) für Photovoltaikhandel
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind ein wachsender Onlinehandel, spezialisiert auf
Photovoltaikprodukte und erneuerbare Energielösungen. Unsere Mission ist
es, Kunden bei der nachhaltigen Energiewende zu unterstützen und ihnen
hochwertige Produkte sowie erstklassigen Service zu bieten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen engagierten Mitarbeiter Controlling & Buchhaltung (m/w/d),der Zahlen nicht nur sauber verarbeitet, sondern auch aktiv mitdenkt, wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge erkennt und unsere internen Abläufe kritisch auf Effizienz und Rentabilität prüft.

Aufgaben

  • Laufende Buchhaltung: Sie unterstützen bei der
    laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung und sorgen für eine saubere, strukturierte
    und nachvollziehbare Erfassung aller Geschäftsvorfälle.
  • Prüfung von Eingangs- und Ausgangsvorgängen: Sie
    kontrollieren Rechnungen, Belege, Zahlungen und Buchungsvorgänge auf
    Richtigkeit, Vollständigkeit und wirtschaftliche Plausibilität.
  • Wirtschaftlichkeitsprüfung: Sie prüfen unsere Prozesse,
    Kostenstrukturen und Ausgaben mit Blick auf Wirtschaftlichkeit und
    zeigen Verbesserungspotenziale auf.
  • Bestell- und Margenprüfung: Sie bewerten eingehende Bestellungen und Aufträge hinsichtlich Marge, Kosten, Versand, Gebühren und Gesamtrentabilität.
  • Controlling und Kennzahlen: Sie erstellen Auswertungen,
    Reports und betriebswirtschaftliche Analysen zu Umsatz, Kosten,
    Deckungsbeiträgen, Rohertrag und weiteren relevanten Kennzahlen.

title: Conversion Rate Optimisation Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods.

We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction.

  • Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands.

  • Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights.

  • Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale.

  • Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams.

  • Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools.

  • The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries.

  • Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights.

  • Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps.

  • You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.

  • When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

title: Counsel, International (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an enterprising, dynamic and highly self-sufficient Counsel, International to join our fast-paced International Legal team.

In this role, you will be a key player supporting our European footprint with a primary focus on Germany, while also driving expansion into new European markets through our international launch function. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce, you will tackle novel legal questions, bring clarity to complex regulatory frameworks, and partner closely with business leaders to build compliant, high-growth healthcare experiences across Europe.

You will be a central operational driver for our German and pan-European commercial, telehealth, and pharmacy strategy.

You Will:

  • Support German Operations: Serve as a key legal advisor on day-to-day matters across Germany advising on healthcare and pharmacy regulations, e-commerce compliance, digital health, and marketing.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Untangle complex, novel, or undefined regulatory challenges where traditional precedents don't exist. You will help build legal frameworks using first principles rather than off-the-shelf templates.

  • Deliver Actionable, Concise Advice: Cut through ambiguity and synthesise complex legal risks into clear, commercially pragmatic guidance. Your advice will be direct, risk-calibrated, and focused on business value.

  • Navigate Pharmacy & Healthcare Regs: Advise cross-functional teams on German, Dutch, and cross-European pharmacy regulations, telemedicine rules, prescribing workflows, healthcare compliance and privacy. Particular focus on Germany’s AMG and HWG.

  • Commercial Risk & Disputes: Mitigate commercial risk, negotiate key partner/vendor agreements, and assist with advertising and competition matters (including Germany’s unfair competition / UWG litigation environment).

  • Drive Market Expansion & Growth: Partner with the international launch team to scale existing operations and launch Hims & Hers into new European markets, navigating local regulatory, legal, and operational landscapes from scratch.

Who You Are:

  • Qualified Attorney: Admitted to practice in the UK, Germany, or Ireland (other EU jurisdictions considered by exception) with ~5+ years PQE in a top-tier law firm, tech company, or fast-growing digital health/telehealth business.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You thrive on novelty and ambiguity. When faced with a problem that has never been solved before, you dig into core principles to construct creative, compliant paths forward.

  • Pragmatic & Commercial: You balance legal requirements with real-world commercial pressure. You understand what the business values and can move quickly without sacrificing quality or compliance.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You get straight to the point accurately and efficiently. You can explain intricate healthcare or consumer laws to non-lawyers clearly and concisely.

  • Self-Sufficient Operator: You take ownership, run autonomously, and prioritise effectively in a high-velocity environment without needing hand-holding.

Nice to Have:

  • Domain Exposure: Prior experience navigating German and/or European pharmacy regulations, digital health/e-health laws, or Germany's unfair competition landscape is strongly favored. GDPR experience will also be viewed favourably, particularly in a healthcare context.

  • Language Skills: German

Nice to Have:

  • Preferred: Based in London with a hybrid work structure (time spent in our Old Street office collaborating with team members).

  • Flexible: We are also open to exceptional candidates based remotely in Ireland or Germany.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

title: Country Director DACH / Managing Director Germany (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Standort: Deutschland (flexibel / hybrid)
Berichtet an: Executive Leadership Team
Verantwortungsbereich: Gesamtverantwortung für kommerzielles Wachstum, Organisationsentwicklung und Geschäftsergebnis in Deutschland in den Märkten Utility-Scale BESS sowie Community, Commercial & Industrial (CCI).

Über iwell
iwell ist ein führender europäischer Anbieter von intelligentem Energiemanagement und Batteriespeicherlösungen (Battery Energy Storage Solutions, BESS). Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei, Energiekosten zu senken, den Energieverbrauch zu optimieren, ihre Resilienz zu erhöhen und die Energiewende zu beschleunigen. iwell hat eine starke Erfolgsbilanz in ganz Europa und eine etablierte Präsenz in Deutschland. Darauf aufbauend startet iwell in die nächste Wachstumsphase in einem der dynamischsten und strategisch wichtigsten Energiespeichermärkte des Kontinents.

Für diese Ambition sucht iwell eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Country Director / Managing Director Germany (m/w/d). Sie führen das deutsche Geschäft und treiben die weitere Expansion in zentralen Wachstumssegmenten voran.

Sie berichten direkt an das Executive Leadership Team und tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für das deutsche Geschäft. Dabei vereinen Sie kommerzielle Führung, strategische Ausrichtung, Organisationsentwicklung und operative Steuerung. Sie treiben das Vertriebswachstum selbst voran. Sie stärken die Marktposition von iwell, skalieren die lokalen Aktivitäten und erreichen ambitionierte Wachstumsziele, stets in enger Abstimmung mit der übergeordneten Gruppenstrategie.


Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit: Sie führen einen der wichtigsten Märkte in der europäischen Wachstumsstrategie von iwell und tragen direkt zur Transformation des deutschen Energiesektors bei.

Die Chance
Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Wachstum in zwei strategischen Geschäftsbereichen:
Utility-Scale BESS
Ausbau der Präsenz von iwell bei großen Batteriespeicherprojekten. Dazu gehört der Aufbau von Beziehungen zu Projektentwicklern, EPC-Unternehmen, Investoren, Energieversorgern, unabhängigen Stromerzeugern (IPPs), Übertragungs- und Verteilnetzbetreibern sowie weiteren zentralen Stakeholdern im gesamten Energie-Ökosystem.
Community, Commercial & Industrial (CCI)
Beschleunigung des Wachstums bei dezentralen Energiespeicheranwendungen. Der Fokus liegt auf Branchen wie Verkehrs- und Logistikinfrastruktur, Mobilität und Flottenelektrifizierung, Gewerbeimmobilien, Industrieanlagen, Häfen und Rechenzentren. Hinzu kommen weitere energieintensive Standorte, die mehr Resilienz, Optimierung und Nachhaltigkeit in ihrer Energieversorgung anstreben.
Ihre Aufgabe ist es, die bestehende Marktdynamik in nachhaltiges kommerzielles Wachstum umzusetzen und eine High-Performance-Kultur zu fördern. Dabei stellen Sie sicher, dass das deutsche Geschäft eng an den strategischen Zielen der Gruppe ausgerichtet bleibt.

Ihre Aufgaben
Strategische Führung

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der langfristigen Geschäftsstrategie für Deutschland im Einklang mit den Zielen der Gruppe und den europäischen Wachstumsambitionen.

  • Definition und Umsetzung von Wachstumsplänen für die Geschäftsbereiche Utility-Scale BESS und CCI.

  • Identifikation neuer Marktchancen, Partnerschaften, Vertriebswege und Umsatzquellen im deutschen Energie-Ökosystem.

  • Festlegung von Jahresplänen, Budgets und Wachstumszielen für das deutsche Geschäft.

  • Direkter Beitrag zu übergreifenden europäischen Wachstumsinitiativen und zur Unternehmensstrategie.

Kommerzielles Wachstum & Marktentwicklung

  • Vorantreiben der weiteren Expansion des deutschen Geschäfts von iwell in den Märkten für Großbatteriespeicher (Utility-Scale) und dezentrale Batteriespeicher.

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen auf Senior-Ebene zu Projektentwicklern, EPCs, Energieversorgern, Aggregatoren, Infrastruktureigentümern, Investoren, strategischen Partnern sowie großen gewerblichen und industriellen Energieverbrauchern.

  • Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung kommerzieller Strategien, die nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum und steigende Marktanteile sichern.

  • Identifikation und Gewinnung strategischer Partnerschaften, die die Wettbewerbsposition von iwell stärken und das Wachstum beschleunigen.

  • Repräsentation von iwell als zentrales Gesicht des Unternehmens in der sich rasant wandelnden Landschaft der deutschen Energiewende.

Geschäftsführung & Operations

  • Gesamtverantwortung für Performance und Wachstum des deutschen Geschäfts.

  • Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz in Vertrieb, Projektabwicklung, Customer Success, Service und Support.

  • Etablierung wirksamer Strukturen für Governance, Performance-Management und Reporting.

  • Steuerung von Budgetierung, Forecasting, Ressourcenplanung und Profitabilitätszielen.

  • Regelmäßige Berichterstattung an das Executive Leadership Team zur Geschäftsentwicklung und zu Markteinblicken.

Teamführung

  • Aufbau, Führung und Weiterentwicklung einer leistungsstarken deutschen Organisation, die ambitionierte Wachstumspläne tragen kann.

  • Rekrutierung, Mentoring und Bindung herausragender Talente in kommerziellen, operativen und kundennahen Funktionen.

  • Förderung einer Kultur von Verantwortung, Zusammenarbeit, Kundenorientierung und Exzellenz.

  • Sichtbare und inspirierende Führung mit unternehmerischer und hands-on Arbeitsweise.

Markt- & Stakeholder-Engagement

  • Vertretung von iwell auf Branchenkonferenzen, bei Kundenterminen, in Regierungsforen und in Branchenverbänden.

  • Aufbau von Beziehungen zu zentralen Stakeholdern im gesamten Ökosystem der deutschen Energiewende.

  • Fundiertes und aktuelles Verständnis von Marktentwicklungen, Regulierung, Trends im Energiespeicherbereich, Flexibilitätsmärkten und neuen Chancen.

Ihr Profil
Wir suchen eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, etwa als Country Leader, Managing Director, General Manager oder Senior Commercial Executive. Sie verbinden strategische Weitsicht mit ausgeprägtem kommerziellem Gespür und können Unternehmen im deutschen Energiewendesektor skalieren.

Erfahrung & Qualifikationen

  • Umfangreiche Führungserfahrung in den Bereichen Batteriespeicher, erneuerbare Energien, dezentrale Energie, Energieinfrastruktur, Ladeinfrastruktur für E-Mobilität, Flexibilitätsdienstleistungen, Smart Energy, Energiesysteme oder in angrenzenden Branchen.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in relevanten Kundensegmenten wie Transport, Logistik, Flottenelektrifizierung, Gewerbeimmobilien sowie Co-Location von erneuerbaren Energien und BESS.

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge in der Führung einer Ländergesellschaft, eines Geschäftsbereichs, einer regionalen Organisation oder einer wachstumsstarken kommerziellen Einheit.

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wachstumsstrategien.

  • Fundiertes Verständnis des deutschen Energiemarkts, des regulatorischen Umfelds und der kommerziellen Dynamik.

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb komplexer technischer Lösungen und infrastrukturbasierter Energieprodukte.

  • Starkes Netzwerk unter Projektentwicklern, Energieversorgern, EPCs, Investoren, Aggregatoren, gewerblichen und industriellen Kunden sowie weiteren Akteuren der Energiewende.

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke Teams aufzubauen und zu führen.

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Geschäftsergebnissen, Budgets, Forecasts und kommerziellen Zielen.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Persönliche Eigenschaften

  • Strategisch denkende und kommerziell versierte Führungskraft.

  • Unternehmerisch, wachstumsorientiert und hands-on.

  • Hohe Glaubwürdigkeit und die Fähigkeit, Senior Stakeholder intern wie extern zu überzeugen.

  • Ergebnisorientiert, mit ausgeprägten analytischen Fähigkeiten und Entscheidungsstärke.

  • Leidenschaft für die Energiewende und technologiegetriebene Innovation.

Warum iwell?

  • Führung eines der strategisch wichtigsten europäischen Märkte von iwell.

  • Aufbau auf einer etablierten Plattform und starker Marktdynamik, mit der Chance, die nächste Wachstumsphase aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Eine führende Rolle bei der Beschleunigung der deutschen Energiewende durch innovative Batteriespeicherlösungen.

  • Einfluss auf die Strategie auf deutscher und europäischer Ebene, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Executive Leadership Team.

  • Langfristige Wertschöpfung durch das Wachstum einer äußerst ambitionierten und unternehmerischen Organisation.

  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket auf Executive-Niveau mit wettbewerbsfähigem Grundgehalt, leistungsabhängigem Bonus und Beteiligung an der langfristigen Wertsteigerung.

Interesse geweckt?
Mehr über iwell, was wir tun, warum wir es tun, und einen Überblick über unsere Partner finden Sie unter https://iwell.eu/.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess
Bewerbung. Unser People & Culture Team und die einstellende Führungskraft prüfen Ihre Bewerbung und melden sich innerhalb von 2 Wochen bei Ihnen.

Sind Sie die richtige Person? Es folgen zwei oder mehr Interviews. Für einige Positionen bitten wir Sie zusätzlich, eine Fallstudie zu bearbeiten.

title: Creative Strategist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Vollzeit · Köln, hybrid · ab sofort
Hunderunde ist eine Gesundheitsmarke für Hunde aus Köln. Wir machen pflanzliche Futtertoppings, veganes Alleinfutter und Snacks für konkrete Probleme wie Verdauung, Fell, Gelenke oder Zähne. Tierärztlich mitentwickelt, ehrliche Rezepturen, keine Versprechen ohne Substanz.
Gegründet 2019 von Fabio und Luis, bekannt aus „Die Höhle der Löwen”, komplett gebootstrapped. 5% unseres Nettoumsatzes gehen an Tierschutzprojekte, unter anderem an ein Tierheim in Rumänien. Heißt: Jede Ad, die bei dir performt, hilft am Ende auch Hunden, um die sich sonst niemand kümmert.

Aufgaben

Du machst aus Kundensprache Ads, die verkaufen. Von der Idee bis zur Zahl im Account.
Du entwickelst die Konzepte, briefst Cutter, Designer*innen und On-Camera-Talent, schaltest die Kampagnen in Meta und Google und entscheidest anhand der Daten, was skaliert und was rausfliegt. Du arbeitest direkt mit Luis (Co-Founder, verantwortet Marketing und Marke).
Was du machst

  • Creative-Strategie für Meta und Google: Angles, Hooks, Formate. Deine Ideen kommen aus echten Kundenstimmen (Kommentare, Reviews, DMs, Support-Tickets), nicht aus dem Bauch.
  • Mit KI schneller werden: Recherche, Kundenstimmen auswerten, Konzepte und Briefings mit Claude und Co. Du nutzt KI, um mehr und bessere Ideen schneller auf die Straße zu bringen.
  • Produktion steuern: Concept One-Pager, Shoot Brief, Cut Brief. So klar, dass Cutter, Designer*innen und On-Camera-Talent ohne Rückfragen loslegen. Du produzierst nicht selbst, du sorgst dafür, dass das Richtige produziert wird.
  • Media Buying: Kampagnen im Meta Ads Manager und in Google Ads aufsetzen, steuern, testen und skalieren.
  • Auswerten und nachlegen: Performance mit unseren Attributions-Tools lesen und daraus die nächste Testrunde ableiten.
  • Creator-Content nutzen: Mit unserem Social- und Creator-Team zusammen aus Creator-Material starke Ads machen.
  • Sauber bleiben: Für Werbeaussagen bei Hundefutter gelten klare rechtliche Regeln. Du hast Lust, innerhalb dieser Regeln kreativ zu sein.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung in Paid Social und Paid Search, idealerweise im DTC oder E-Commerce
  • Du beherrschst Meta Ads Manager und Google Ads (Search, PMax, YouTube/Demand Gen) hands-on
  • Du hast Creatives verantwortet, die nachweislich performt haben, und kannst erklären, warum
  • KI ist für dich Alltagswerkzeug: Claude, ChatGPT und Co. Du baust dir damit eigene Workflows für Recherche, Konzepte und Briefings
  • Gespür für Hooks, Schnitt und Text. Du musst nicht selbst schneiden oder designen, aber du erkennst, was den Scroll stoppt, und kannst es so briefen, dass es rauskommt
  • CAC, ROAS, CTR und Hook Rate sind für dich keine Fremdwörter
  • Eigentümer-Denken: Du wartest nicht auf Erlaubnis, sondern entscheidest und stehst dafür gerade
  • Ehrlichkeit, auch wenn’s unangenehm ist. Das ist bei uns nicht verhandelbar

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein Job mit Sinn: 5 % vom Nettoumsatz gehen in den Tierschutz. Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt.
  • Mitgestalten statt abarbeiten: Kleines Team, kurze Wege. Deine Ideen gehen live statt in Abstimmungsschleifen.
  • Hybrid: 3 Tage im Office in Köln, 2 Tage remote.
  • Workation: 2 x mal im Jahr fahren wir mit dem ganzen Team weg
  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Weiterbildung: Für Kurse, Konferenzen und Tools
  • Schönes Office: In der Schanzenstraße in Köln
  • Offene Kultur: Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, Zahlen und Entscheidungen werden geteilt, Kritik ist Werkzeug, kein Angriff

Wir freuen uns über kreative Bewerbungen, vielleicht hast du ja auch schon direkt Idee, die wir besser machen können. Sei gern kreativ.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About DataCamp

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you'll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education.

About the role

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines.
  • Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors.
  • Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content.
  • Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale.
  • Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective.
  • Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements.
  • Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum.

We're excited about you because you have the following:

  • A solid hands-on background building and shipping production AI applications as an AI engineer, machine learning engineer, or software engineer. Experience taking LLM-powered systems from prototype to production (e.g. evaluation, monitoring, cost and latency optimization) is a strong plus.
  • Broad AI engineering fluency spanning LLM fundamentals, prompt and context engineering, RAG, agents, and evaluation, with additional depth in at least one area such as agentic systems, retrieval and search, fine-tuning, or LLMOps.
  • A solid technical background in Python, with comfort working with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), open-source models and frameworks (e.g. Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), agentic systems, vector databases, Git, and the command line.
  • Intuitive understanding of instructional design, with proven ability to structure and teach technical concepts clearly.
  • Graduate degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related STEM field—or equivalent industry experience.
  • Strong experience with agentic coding systems, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Replit. You consider yourself a sophisticated user of these tools.

Bonus if you have the following:

  • A deep understanding of the DataCamp course format—you have an intuitive understanding of what makes a great DataCamp course.
  • An existing network of potential subject matter experts who can become DataCamp instructors.
  • An extensive track record of teaching AI engineering to technical audiences.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Belonging at Samsara

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote.

You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. title: Database Engineering Intern
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Database Engineering Intern to work on the data layer of our production software. You will work alongside the developer who owns our data layer on data modelling, query optimisation and documentation.

Our stack is PostgreSQL, Supabase, PostgREST and row-level security, with TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest, Deno edge functions and GitHub Actions around it. Every change goes through a pull request with automated type, lint, format, build and test checks.

Duration: 6 months; Start: flexible

Tasks

  • Get familiar with our database structures and document how they are modelled.

  • Analyse table and column usage and prepare migrations where structures are no longer needed.

  • Improve our data models: reduce duplicated values and work with references and views.

  • Optimise data access so that more work happens in the database and less in the application.

  • Measure query performance and add indexes where they make a difference.

  • Review our database access policies.

Requirements

  • You are studying computer science, data engineering or something similar.

  • Comfortable in SQL: joins, aggregates, indexes, and reading a query plan.

  • You are happy to spend time reading existing code before changing it.

  • PostgreSQL specifics (indexing strategies, EXPLAIN, constraints, triggers) and experience with Supabase or a similar API-over-Postgres layer are a plus.

  • Coursework or a project in data modelling and normalisation.

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools.

  • Humble, low ego, not afraid to get your hands dirty.

  • Get things done mentality: prioritising results over process.

  • Fluent in English, German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Scaling from 0 to 1: you shape how this company works, from the processes to the team around you.

  • Lunch allowance, a subsidized sports membership and modern tech.

title: Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
At Ankar, we’re building AI to transform industrial R&D.

From understanding the technology landscape and identifying new invention opportunities to accelerating R&D and bringing products to market, we're inventing how innovation happens.

We work with some of the world's leading enterprises across industries, helping them unlock the value of their knowledge, experts, technical expertise, inventions, and turn ideas into real-world impact. We're the builders of the new age of industrial innovation.

Join us at a unique moment of scale:

  • We've raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the founders of Hugging Face, CEO of Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We're already working with the world's most innovative companies including Fortune 500 companies such as L'Oréal.

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We're just getting started.

We're growing rapidly, and looking for exceptional people to help us build what comes next.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist at Ankar, you'll help chart and build the art of the possible in enterprise R&D. You'll work on the frontlines with some of the world's leading enterprises, tackling their most important innovation challenges and bringing together technology, product and business to deliver real world outcomes.

Your mission is to discover where Ankar can create extraordinary value for our customers, and make that value a reality.

You'll immerse yourself in complex organisations, develop a deep understanding of their people, science, priorities and challenges, and uncover opportunities others might miss.

You'll bring curiosity, product intuition, commercial instinct and the ability to connect with people at every level of an organisation, helping them challenge established ways of working, imagine what's possible, and turn that ambition into action.

This isn't a traditional consulting, customer success or technical implementation role. You'll be part strategist, part operator, part product thinker and part builder. You'll need to be equally comfortable working with end users to understand their day-to-day challenges, shaping a proposition with senior executives, and collaborating with engineers to build something that doesn't yet exist.

You'll own outcomes, not just deliverables. From shaping an initial pilot to driving adoption, demonstrating impact and identifying opportunities to expand, you'll play a critical role in building Ankar's most important customer partnerships.

What You'll Do

Discover and unlock customer value

  • Immerse yourself in customers' businesses, workflows and strategic priorities to identify their most important problems and opportunities.

  • Connect the dots between customer needs, technology capabilities and commercial opportunities to define where Ankar can deliver the greatest impact.

  • Work with stakeholders from hands-on SMEs to senior executives, challenging assumptions and helping customers reimagine what's possible while building excellent rapport and passion for innovation to enable the work that’s needed.

Own deployments and drive impact

  • Lead customer engagements from early discovery and pilot scoping through deployment, adoption and expansion.

  • Translate ambitious, often ambiguous objectives into actionable plans, bringing together customers, engineers, product teams and commercial colleagues to deliver results.

  • Get hands-on with the product, data and customer workflows to solve problems, prototype solutions and unblock progress.

  • Define and demonstrate success through measurable customer outcomes, holding the vision of what’s genuinely valuable to the organisation beyond explicit deliverables.

Build strategic customer partnerships

  • Develop trusted relationships across complex enterprise organisations, from end users to executive sponsors.

  • Identify new use cases, stakeholders and opportunities to deepen the impact of Ankar's technology.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to shape account strategy, build compelling business cases and turn successful deployments into broader enterprise partnerships.

  • Communicate complex ideas and results clearly, building conviction and momentum at every level of the organisation.

Help shape the product and how we scale

  • Act as a critical bridge between our customers and our product and engineering teams, translating real-world challenges into product insights and opportunities.

  • Identify patterns across deployments that can inform our product roadmap, new capabilities and future market opportunities.

  • Develop repeatable approaches, tools and ways of working that help us deliver extraordinary customer outcomes at scale.

  • Help shape the deployment function itself as Ankar grows.

What We're Looking For

Above all, we're looking for exceptional problem solvers with the curiosity, creativity, judgment and drive to make things happen.

You might come from technology, consulting, engineering, product, strategy or an entirely different background. What matters most is how you think, learn and operate.

We value:

  • Intellectual curiosity and analytical rigour. A love for getting to the bottom of complex problems, asking better questions and finding connections others miss.

  • Value oriented instincts where you naturally look for opportunities to create value, understand what matters to a business, and can connect technical possibilities to meaningful commercial outcomes.

  • Product intuition and technical fluency - excited by technology, comfortable getting hands-on with software and data, and able to work effectively with engineers. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be eager and able to learn.

  • Ownership and resourcefulness. A tendency to thrive in ambiguity, take initiative and find ways forward even when there's no established playbook.

  • Strong communication and empathy. You build trust with people from very different backgrounds, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and can influence and bring people along without formal authority.

  • Adaptability and low ego - you’ll join a team that is willing to roll up their sleeves at any time and task. We index on value, and care more about outcomes than credit.

  • A bias for action. You combine big-picture thinking with the willingness and ability to execute.

Bonus points:

  • Experience working with enterprise software, AI, data or complex technical products, particularly in customer-facing roles.

  • Founding experience, or experience building a new product or business.

  • Experience in R&D-intensive industries such as automotive, semiconductors, advanced materials, chemicals, energy, aerospace or industrial manufacturing, including exposure to complex innovation and product development workflows.

  • Familiarity with technical information sources such as scientific literature, patents, experimental results, specifications and research documentation.

  • Hands-on experience prototyping, investigating technical problems or analysing data using Python, SQL, APIs or low-code tools.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.

The role involves travel, working closely with customers across the US and Europe.

Why Ankar?

You'll join a small, ambitious team at a pivotal moment in Ankar's growth, working at the frontier of AI and enterprise industrial R&D.

You'll help shape not just how our technology is deployed, but how some of the world's most innovative companies work.

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with some of the world's leading companies, tackle genuinely complex problems and see the impact of your work firsthand.

You'll have real ownership from day one, a direct influence on the product we're building, and the opportunity to help define how Ankar works with customers as we scale globally.

If this sounds like you - sign up for the mission.

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

title: DevOps - Consultant
locations: Hybrid - Newcastle, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Manchester, Birmingham, Bristol, London
descriptionHtml:
Ready to automate, innovate and make a real impact?

Do you want to build reliable, scalable systems that make a real difference to millions of people? Do you want to work at a certified B Corp with an inclusive and learning culture as part of a diverse team of great people? If so, Opencast could be the place for you. We’re a growing tech consultancy that creates user-centred solutions with purpose for our clients in government, healthcare and purpose-driven businesses. Working in DevOps, you’ll build and maintain the systems that let teams respond quickly to needs. You’ll work on high-impact projects, helping to build reliable, scalable systems. We align work to industry-recognised roles such as Build & Release Engineer (BRE), Platform Engineer (PLE) or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) and, where needed, to more specialised areas such as security, cloud hosting, infrastructure or networking.

The Role

At Opencast, we love to keep things simple, and we love automation. It’s not the same as your standard DevOps Consultant job. Depending on your client’s needs, you’ll take on a range of roles. These will include:
  • Taking the lead on responding to outages, triaging issues, balancing stakeholder priorities/concerns, and keeping communication channels open with all parties.
  • Developing, and implementing continuous deployment solutions that help our clients to deliver software faster and more efficiently.
  • Collaborating with our clients to understand their ways of working and will have an enthusiasm to learn new tools and technologies as needed.
  • Contributing within Opencast communities.
  • Ensure that work is carried out in accordance with Opencast's quality, environmental, and information security policies and procedures, as well as applicable customer policies, standards, and procedures while working on client.
We care about building things right. We believe in good DevOps practices and keeping things simple. We want to support you as much as we can on interiorising our approach to DevOps engineering and you supporting others. We are proud consultants who combine our own experience and approach with our company values. We are comfortable with new tech. We are empowered, cloud native, vendor agnostic DevOps engineers. We are empathetic, patient and care about quality. We know when to pick our battles and how to manage expectations. We are humble, inclusive team players that listen and collaborate, with zero egos! We’re always willing to teach and help others (inside or outside of our team). And we’re always willing to learn. It’s a varied job that keeps you super technical and excited.

Requirements

This role involves weekly on-site work, and you’ll be required to travel regularly to client locations across the UK. We’re looking for people who value in-person collaboration, enjoy building strong relationships, and are passionate about delivering solutions that make a real difference for our clients.

Due to the nature of this role, you must either hold active Security Check (SC) clearance or be eligible and willing to undergo the clearance process. 

SC clearance is granted in line with UK Government security vetting requirements. Typically, applicants must have UK citizenship and have lived continuously in the UK for at least the past five years, with no single absence exceeding 28 consecutive days. Nationality and immigration status may also be considered as part of the vetting process. We are unable to progress applications from candidates who do not meet these requirements.

If you are unsure whether you meet the eligibility criteria, we encourage you to review the guidance or discuss this with us before applying.

We’re looking to welcome new team members for multiple roles from June 2026 onward. If you’re interested in joining Opencast, we’d encourage you to apply.

Essential experience

To succeed in this role, you'll have experience working within DevOps and be able to demonstrate, with tangible examples, that you can:

  • Create, modify, and maintain complex CI/CD pipelines.

  • Create dashboards and visualisations for application performance that proactively identify and address potential problems before they occur.

  • Use automated testing to detect security issues/vulnerabilities in application and/or infrastructure code, thereby detecting issues before it reaches production (aka Shift-Left).

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

You will partner closely with Core Tech, Product, and Engineering leadership to define our security roadmap and culture.

Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

You'll own complete product slices end-to-end — things like a candidate database with rich search and filtering, a dashboard that surfaces call transcripts and match history for our Talent Operations team, and the workflows that let them stack-rank candidates against a new role in minutes rather than hours. You ship these without needing to be guided step by step.

You're not a specialist who hands off at the API boundary. You think in user outcomes and delivery units, and you're reliable: your code handles edge cases, your APIs have clean contracts, and the work you ship stays shipped.

  • Own product delivery — take features from spec to production, backend-first but covering frontend and integration where needed

  • Build and maintain backend systems — product APIs, data pipelines, and core infrastructure on our Python/FastAPI/Postgres stack

  • Work across the stack — ship workable React/TypeScript frontend for product features; not a frontend specialist, but comfortable and pragmatic

  • Collaborate with product and design — translate ambiguous requirements into concrete shipped work; be the engineer who unblocks, not the one who waits

  • Maintain quality at speed — handle data integrity, error paths, API evolution, and operational concerns as a default, not an afterthought

 

What We're Looking For

  • Leading teams or entire product lines - You can take responsibility for driving delivery across a team or across an entire product line

  • Seeing good at scale, and early stage - you've moved fast in scrappy, early-stage environments, and seen what good looks like at scale

  • Independent delivery - You can own and ship end-to-end product slices with minimal supervision; your track record shows features that shipped, stuck, and scaled

  • Product trade-off judgment - you balance speed, quality, and user impact under ambiguity; you push back when something is underspecified and make pragmatic calls when it needs to ship

  • Reliability and API discipline - you handle data integrity, error paths, idempotence, and API versioning as standard practice; production reliability is your default, not a later concern

  • Cross-functional pragmatism - you work effectively with product and design, can unblock yourself across the stack, and ship workable frontend when that's what's needed

 

Strong technical depth in:

  • Python backend (FastAPI or equivalent, async patterns, Postgres, Redis)

  • API design and data modelling

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with evals, guardrails, or agent observability

  • Familiarity with GCP / cloud infrastructure

  • Experience in recruiting tech, marketplaces, or matching systems

 

The Stack

A modern Python stack: FastAPI, Postgres, Redis, Docker, Pydantic AI, running on GCP. Frontend in React/TypeScript. We iterate fast and keep the codebase clean.

title: Director of People Operations
descriptionHtml:

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.


The role
This role owns how it works to be an employee at Legora on the backend. You will operationalise every stage of the employee journey, making sure every moment is supported by clean systems, accurate data, and processes that scale. If an employee interacts with a Legora program or system, from their first day in the HRIS to a salary change three years in, your team is accountable for making it accurate, timely, and smooth.

You will lead a distributed People Operations team across Stockholm and New York, reporting to the VP, People Operations. As we enter new markets, you will also build and manage local specialisms to handle day-to-day employee and manager questions and run structured, lower-complexity casework, with a clean handoff to Employee Relations for anything that becomes formal, contested, or carries legal weight.



What you'll own

  • The full employee lifecycle, operationally. Every touchpoint from offer to exit, mapped, documented, and supported end to end.

  • HRIS and data integrity. Onboarding new hires into the HRIS, data entry, and data QA. You keep employee data accurate, complete, and audit-ready as the single source of truth.

  • Contracts and changes. Addendums, employee transfers, salary and reporting-line changes, and the workflows and documentation behind each one, working in close partnership with Payroll so every change flows through accurately and on time.

  • Benefits and leave administration. Run the day-to-day administration of benefits and leave across our markets. Total Rewards owns the policies, plan design, and philosophy; your team makes sure they are executed cleanly for every employee. Anything contested, discriminatory, or medically complex is escalated to Employee Relations.

  • Local HR Generalist build-out. As Legora enters new markets, hire, ramp, and manage the local HR Generalist / People Advisor-Ops layer: the in-market presence for day-to-day employee and manager questions, and for structured, lower-complexity casework such as absence management, recurring capability concerns, and restructuring conversations. These roles report into People Operations for management and delivery, with a dotted line to the regional Employee Relations Director for sign-off on jurisdictional readiness and casework quality.

  • Systems and tooling. Run the People tech stack (HiBob, Ashby, Ironclad), drive adoption, and take manual work out of the process.

  • Process and SOPs. Design scalable, well-documented processes for every program employees touch, and keep reducing friction and cycle time.

  • Compliance and controls. Partner with Legal and Finance to keep operations compliant across our markets, including working time, leave, and entity or EOR transitions, with a clean escalation path to Employee Relations for anything that becomes formal or carries legal weight.

  • Reporting. Own people data quality and the reporting backbone that powers People analytics for the business.



What you'll bring

  • 8+ years in People Operations or HR Operations, including leading a team and building out local, in-market HR capability as a company scales into new geographies, ideally in a high-growth or global company.

  • Deep HRIS expertise across complex, multidisciplinary system landscapes, with a strong interest in data quality, integrations, AI and tools.

  • A track record of building and scaling lifecycle processes and SOPs internationally, and of moving work from manual to automated.

  • Strong grasp of multi-jurisdiction employment compliance across EMEA, AMER, and APAC.

  • Comfort operating in a tiered People model, with clear judgment on what your team owns directly and what belongs with Employee Relations, Legal, or Total Rewards.

  • An operator's mindset: detail-obsessed, systems-thinking, and a high bar for accuracy.

  • Comfort partnering across Finance, Legal, and IT, and communicating clearly with employees and leaders alike.

  • Fluency in English, which is our working language.


Why this role
 People Operations is the infrastructure that lets the rest of the People team, and the business, move fast without breaking things. That now includes building the in-market HR Generalist presence that gives every employee fast, consistent support close to home, wherever they are, with a clean handoff to Employee Relations the moment something becomes formal. You will build that infrastructure for one of the most exciting companies in tech, and set the standard for what operational excellence looks like as we scale.

descriptionHtml:

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

The role

We’re looking for a strategic, proactive EA / workplace manager to amplify our founders impact and make Lucis run seamlessly. You will watch their back.

You'll scale faster than the founders, and will grow faster than the company.

  • Operational rigour: Handling invoice payments, accounting workflows, and HR admin (employee requests and office onboarding).

  • Culture infrastructure: Designing and executing the logistics for team events and marketing pop-ups as we expand across Europe.

  • Founder proxy: Acting as the first point of contact for the team and external stakeholders, protecting the founders' deep work time while ensuring the team has what it needs.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You're curious about AI and how it can be used to move faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if you

  • 1 to 3+ years in a challenging / fast-growing environment (Series A/B preferred) or a rigorous professional services environment (law, finance, or consulting).

  • Fluent in English and in French.

  • Take radical ownership and default to action: You anticipate needs before they are voiced and ensure that once a task is started, the loop is closed every single time.

  • You’re used to fast change and context-switching: You can jump from complex multi-time-zone calendar management to fixing an office infrastructure issue without losing momentum.

  • You're very comfortable using AI, and learn super fast.

  • You're willing to take anything that has to be done. Anytime, anywhere. No matter how fun that is.

  • You can act as a high-level gatekeeper and founder proxy: You are comfortable hosting investors, partners and protecting the founders' time for 10x deep work.

  • You bring extreme rigor to operational admin: Experienced in handling invoice payments, expense tracking, and basic HR/onboarding workflows.

  • You’re strong at stakeholder management and culture-building: You take pride in building a world-class environment in the Paris HQ for both local and visiting remote employees.

 

We might not be a fit if

  • You need a clearly defined role with stable responsibilities.

  • You prefer strategic advisory work over hands-on execution.

  • You've only worked in large, well-established companies.

  • You need perfect information before making decisions.

  • You prioritise predictable 9-5 work over mission intensity.

  • You're uncomfortable with frequent context-switching and urgent pivots.

 

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side.

 

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

 

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

title: Engineering Manager - Hands-on (CDI)
descriptionHtml:
🏗️ À propos de Bricks

Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. Aujourd’hui, plus de 670 000 membres utilisent notre plateforme.

Quelques jalons : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée avec 5 M€ collectés en 5 secondes, puis plus de 20 M€ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

En 2025, Bricks a collecté 176 M€, soit +90 % en un an, tout en atteignant la rentabilité.

Derrière cette croissance, il y a un produit B2C régulé, des flux financiers réels, des enjeux forts de sécurité, de fiabilité et de cohérence des données. Ce qui part en production peut être utilisé par des milliers d’investisseurs dans les heures qui suivent.

Côté Engineering, on fonctionne avec une équipe autonome, proche du produit et du business. On attend de chacun qu’il comprenne les problèmes en profondeur, prenne des décisions et contribue directement à la qualité de ce qu’on construit.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoindras une équipe Engineering de 10 ingénieurs, avec un CTO qui code au quotidien. Côté Produit : 2 Designers et 2 PM.

L’équipe grandit, les enjeux aussi. On cherche aujourd’hui un Engineering Manager qui travaillera étroitement avec le CTO, à la fois sur le management de l’équipe, son organisation et les sujets techniques structurants.

Tu participeras aux roadmaps Engineering, à la composition des squads, à la définition des objectifs et aux prochains recrutements, tout en restant proche du code et du produit.

Chez Bricks, devenir manager ne veut pas dire s’éloigner de la technique : tu dois pouvoir entrer dans une discussion d’architecture, challenger une décision, faire une code review utile ou débloquer un sujet complexe.

🧱 Ce que tu vas owner

👉 Construire l’organisation Engineering avec le CTO : faire évoluer la composition des équipes, les objectifs, les façons de travailler et participer activement aux recrutements.

👉 Manager et faire progresser les ingénieurs au quotidien : 1:1, feedback, accompagnement, progression, exigence technique. Comprendre ce qui bloque quelqu’un et l’aider à passer au palier suivant.

👉 Rester connecté au code et au produit. Tu ne coderas pas nécessairement toute la journée, mais tu dois pouvoir entrer dans la codebase, participer aux reviews et prendre part aux décisions d’architecture.

👉 Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe shippe vite et bien. Identifier les blocages, arbitrer, clarifier les responsabilités et faire évoluer le process uniquement lorsqu’il apporte de la valeur.

👉 Maintenir un haut niveau d’exigence technique. Modélisation du domaine, architecture, qualité des données, sécurité, performance : tu aides l’équipe à prendre les bonnes décisions là où elles comptent vraiment.

🛠️ La stack

Tu dois être suffisamment proche de notre environnement technique pour pouvoir intervenir réellement dans les discussions et dans le code :

👉 TypeScript end-to-end. Les types sont de la documentation qui s’exécute.

👉 Node monolithe, Screaming Architecture.

👉 Postgres (NeonDB) avec Graphile pour les queues ACID. Redis pour ce qui doit être rapide.

👉 Zod, Kysely, ts-pattern - type-safety du front à la DB.

👉 Better Auth.

👉 Railway pour l’infra.

👉 Github CI, Datadog, K6.

👉 React Native + RN Web côté front : une seul codebase web + mobile.

Tu n’as pas besoin d’avoir utilisé exactement chacune de ces technos. En revanche, Node/TypeScript et une vraie profondeur backend sont importants : on cherche quelqu’un capable de challenger techniquement l’équipe, pas seulement de la manager.

🤖 IA-first mindset

L’IA est partout dans notre quotidien. 100**% des workflows passe par elle** : Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Cursor, Automations, etc.

Et pour un Engineering Manager, l’enjeu va plus loin que sa propre utilisation : tu dois comprendre comment l’IA transforme la façon de manager, coder, de reviewer, de tester, de recruter et de faire progresser une équipe Engineering.

Si tu vois encore l’IA comme secondaire, ce poste n’est pas pour toi.

Vos compétences

🎯 Tu fitteras si...

👉 Tu as d’abord été Senior Software Engineer et tu n’as pas quitté la technique en devenant manager. Tu aimes toujours le code, tu restes proche des sujets techniques et tu peux encore mettre les mains dedans quand c’est nécessaire.

👉 Tu sais construire et faire vivre une équipe Engineering. Recruter, intégrer, faire progresser, donner du feedback et faire évoluer les responsabilités font partie du rôle.

👉 Tu as une forte expérience backend Node /TypeScript en environnement produit.

👉 Tu sais prendre de la hauteur. Au-delà du management individuel, tu réfléchis à la composition des équipes, aux responsabilités, aux recrutements et à la façon dont l’organisation doit évoluer.

👉 Tu sais quand ralentir et quand shipper. Tout ne mérite pas 3 semaines de réflexion, mais tout ne mérite pas non plus un quick fix.

👉 Tu es pragmatique et tu préfères construire une organisation adaptée au contexte plutôt qu’appliquer un playbook tout fait.

👉 Tu reconnais tes erreurs sans en faire un drame. Tu peux changer d’avis quand quelqu’un apporte de meilleurs arguments.

👉 La fintech, l’investissement ou l’immobilier t’intéresse : gros bonus si tu investis toi-même.
