title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
descriptionHtml:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

  • Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.
  • Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.
  • Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. 
  • Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.
  • Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.
  • You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.

What’s In It for You

​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:

  • Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.
  • Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.
  • Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/

Commitment to Inclusion

​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.
​
​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.

​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​

​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:

  • It all starts with your application and a video interview.
  • Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.
  • Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.
  • Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.
  • And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.

​Exciting, right? Let's get started!

4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​

Learn more about our recruitment process:

Candidate Interview Preparation

​

title: Graduate Associate - Content at SetSales
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Content Associate.

About us

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. 

What we offer you

As our Content Associate you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Leading research to identify rising trends that will define the future of the industry.
  • Creating comprehensive content programs with formats that produce best-in-class conference experience and engagement.
  • Maintaining and developing long-standing and fruitful relationships with industry-leading companies, new and existing senior executives across the globe.

title: GRC Specialist (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Remote from the UK, Germany, Austria, Poland, Montenegro or Serbia. C1 German Language is essential

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

About the Role

We're hiring a GRC Specialist (Governance Risk and Compliance) to strengthen our compliance function as Secfix scales into more frameworks, mid-market customers, and a growing compliance team. This role sits at the intersection of compliance delivery, content, and team support. You'll own the compliance knowledge that lives inside our platform, run internal audits, support our customer success team, and act as the compliance voice for customers, auditors, and product. You'll work closely with our co-founder & CISO and our CS Lead. This is a high-impact role with real influence on how Secfix delivers compliance: both as a service to customers and as content inside our app.

What You'll Do:

You will own one of the most important pillars of Secfix: the quality and breadth of our compliance offering. We don't (and can't afford to) micro-manage. We've built strong foundations and will give you full context on what works. You can test new approaches, but at the end of the day, you have full ownership of how you deliver results (with a strong support network from within and outside the company). You will:

  • Build and maintain compliance frameworks in the Secfix platform (ISO 27001, TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS 2, DORA, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 42001, C5, and more as we expand)

  • Own internal audits for our customers end to end, from kickoff through to the final report they take into their external audit

  • Keep several audits moving at once and keep every one on schedule

  • Implement ISO 27001 and adjacent frameworks end-to-end for customers

  • Own the quality of compliance content in the platform (including creating policies, automated checks, evidence templates, Compliance enable playbooks for our CSMs, security awareness trainings and more)

  • Close framework gaps and incorporate auditor feedback into both team practice and platform improvements

  • Partner with product and engineering to translate compliance gaps into structured product work

  • Collaborate closely with CS, Product, and Founders to align compliance, customer, and roadmap priorities

  • Deepen relationships with our existing certification partners and train auditors on the Secfix platform so they can confidently use it during customer audits

To be qualified for this role, you must have the following:

  • German (C1/C2) and English (fluent) are a must for this role

  • 3+ years of hands‑on information security and GRC experience

  • Led at least 1 successful ISO 27001 certification projects as an implementer and/or auditor at a startup or mid-market company

  • You have run at least 2 internal audits before.

  • Hands on experience with a GRC platform like Secfix, or similar GRC platforms

  • Real depth in at least one framework beyond ISO 27001 (TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, or similar).

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to break down ambiguous initiatives into concrete deliverables, prioritizes ruthlessly, and ships

  • Excellent written communication, especially in producing clear, precise compliance content for diverse audiences (auditors, founders, engineers)

  • Strong ownership mindset: operates as an individual contributor without waiting for direction

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues in a compliance, audit, or GRC context

  • Experience in a startup environment is a plus

  • A PECB ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification or a direct equivalent

Interview Process:

title: GTM Systems Engineer (Salesforce)
descriptionHtml:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

Not a remote position, presence is required 3x per week in our Paris office.

GTM Systems builds and runs the platform behind Pigment’s go-to-market, from first touch to renewal: Salesforce at the core, and the tools connected to it.

As our GTM Systems Engineer, you’ll bring an engineering mindset to that platform: how it’s built, how it’s shipped and how it stays secure as Pigment scales, while staying close to the business need behind every change

You’ll report to the GTM Systems Lead and work alongside a Senior GTM Systems Admin. Revenue Operations and Functional Ops are your closest partners, with Growth, Data and IT teams around you.


Who will thrive in this role:

  • An engineer at heart: you reach for Apex, LWC or an integration when declarative tools hit their limits, and you write code others can maintain.

  • A delivery-minded builder: you ship through Git and CI/CD, never straight into production, and you want the pipeline to get faster and safer.

  • A security-first architect: you design access, integration users and data flows so that every system writing into Salesforce follows clear rules.

  • A business partner, not a ticket-taker: you want to understand the process before you build it, and you’ll say so when a request doesn’t solve the real problem.

  • An AI builder: you don’t just use AI tools, you want to build agents into GTM processes, and the guardrails that let others build safely.


    • What You’ll Do:

  • Build and improve Salesforce with Flows, Apex and LWC, across the data model, automation and integrations

  • Work with the Ops teams to understand and challenge their needs, and turn them into functional and technical designs: specs, test plans, success criteria and documentation..

  • Ship through our Git-based delivery pipeline, and help make it faster and safer.

  • Build AI agents into the processes you own, and develop the AI skillset and guardrails that let others build safely.

  • Own the security of Salesforce and the tools connected to it: access, permissions, integration users, and clear rules for every system that writes into Salesforce.

  • Run each launch through its first weeks in production, then hand it over to the Ops teams with documentation they will actually use.

  • Pay down technical debt and keep every solution consistent with our architecture.


    • Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in a B2B SaaS company, with a strong development side.

  • Solid Apex and Flow skills, and experience with LWC and Salesforce integrations.

  • Hands-on experience shipping Salesforce changes through Git-based version control and CI/CD.

  • Deep knowledge of the Salesforce security model (permissions, sharing, integration users) and the judgment to keep it simple.

  • Business curiosity: you want to understand the process before you build, and you’re comfortable challenging a request.

  • A proactive, opinionated approach: you look for better ways of doing things and know how to bring people along.

  • Clear communication in English, written and spoken: you can explain what you built, and why, to non-technical teams.

  • A habit of learning new tools, AI included, and pushing Salesforce further than its defaults.

    Nice to Have:

  • Experience with integration and data tools such as Hightouch, n8n or BigQuery, or with partner and customer success tooling.

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II a plus).

  • Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
  • Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations

  • Competitive package
  • Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London

title: Head of Data Science
descriptionHtml:
About Peec AI

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

The role

Almost everything Peec shows a customer passes through a model at some point. We track brands, products, sentiment, citations and sources across millions of AI answers. Those answers change whenever a provider ships a new model and differ by country, language and prompt. Turning that into numbers customers can trust and act on is the core data science problem at Peec.

Our data science team has grown fast, with AI-powered features shipping across the product. We're now growing the team further and need someone to lead it. You'll turn a group of strong individual contributors into a high-powered, fast-shipping team. You'll report directly to the CTO and lead a team of 7 data scientists.

What you'll do

Leading people

  • Hire, onboard and grow the data science team. We're hiring several data scientists right now, and you'll shape who joins and how they ramp up.

  • Build a team culture that matches our values: a high bar for quality, full ownership of outcomes, and kindness towards each other

  • Lead and inspire the team through regular 1:1s, actionable feedback and clear career paths

Leading the technical work

  • Set the technical direction and roadmap for data science, together with product and engineering leadership, and decide what the team works on and what it doesn't

  • Own quality in production with strong operational excellence and reproducibility across the ML lifecycle

  • Drive innovation by investing in scalable machine learning data infrastructure

  • Stay close to the work: review designs and code, and step in hands-on when it matters

  • Represent data science to leadership and customers

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in data science or machine learning, including 3+ years managing data scientists or ML engineers as direct reports, ideally at a high-growth startup or an established tech company

  • A track record of building great teams: hiring well, developing people, and creating the standards and rituals that make a team more than the sum of its individuals

  • Experience taking ML products from research to production, and building the practices that keep them reliable: evaluation, monitoring, reproducibility

  • A solid understanding of LLMs and strong instincts for measurement and statistics when outputs are noisy

  • Strong technical depth to review architecture and modeling decisions, ideally in cloud-native environments (GCP a plus)

  • Clear communication with executives, engineers and customers, including being honest about uncertainty

  • Good judgment under ambiguity, and the ownership to deliver outcomes despite blockers

Our stack

A standard Python and SQL stack on GCP. We work with all the major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Perplexity) as well as open-weight models.

Bonus points

  • Contributions to open-source projects or ML tooling

  • Public side or research projects that show technical depth

  • Publications or talks at ML or AI conferences

  • Founder experience or senior technical leadership at a high-growth startup

What we offer

  • A defining leadership role with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Aggressive equity compensation package

  • Paid dinner & Uber home when working late

  • The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

Compensation: €120K – €160K • Offers Equity

title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende Immobilien-Intelligence-Plattform für ESG und Wert-Management in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften und seit Kurzem auch Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Entscheidungen werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt AI-Agenten, die diese Arbeit im Zusammenspiel mit Kunden übernehmen. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Immobilienbranche.

Deine Mission

Als Head of Engineering übernimmst du als Teil des Predium Leadership-Teams die Führung unseres rund 10-köpfigen Engineering-Teams, das in drei kleinen, domänenfokussierten Teams arbeitet. Du baust es weiter mit starken Kandidaten aus und hilfst deinem Team, ambitionierte Produktideen in die Realität zu verwandeln - mit kontinuierlicher Verbesserung der agentischen Entwicklungsprozesse, Architekturentscheidungen und Stärkung der Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team, damit alle jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden. Und: Jede Zeile Code hilft, dass Immobilienkapital dort eingesetzt wird, wo es den größten Wert schafft und CO2 zu reduzieren - auf Basis von Daten statt Bauchgefühl.

Welche technischen Herausforderungen warten auf dich:

  • AI in Produktion: Vom Prototyp zum Produkt, auf das sich Kreditentscheidungen stützen: Evals, messbare Genauigkeit, Kosten- und Latenzsteuerung, Observability für nicht-deterministische Systeme.
  • Document Ingestion: Zehntausende Mietlisten, Grundbuchauszüge und Exposés – nativ, gescannt oder als Excel – mit höchster Genauigkeit extrahieren, strukturieren, rückverfolgbar (Provenance) und per Human-in-the-Loop prüfbar machen
  • Immobilien-Kontext-Graph: Informationen aus Dokumenten und Datenquellen in Vektor- und relationalen DBs verknüpfen – das Fundament für eine 360°-Sicht und für Agenten, die Analysen selbstständig erstellen.
  • Bank-Grade-Plattform: Security, Mandantentrennung, Schlüsselmanagement und Compliance-Anforderungen unserer Bankkunden (z. B. DORA) auf AWS – so, dass unsere Plattform die IT-Due-Diligence einer Bank besteht. Und wie sieht unser Tech Stack heute aus?
    TypeScript (Full Stack, React im Frontend, NestJS im Backend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL RDS, AWS ECS, Claude.

Und in Zukunft? Du entscheidest - die beste Idee gewinnt.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Nach 90 Tagen: Du kennst Codebase, Team und Kunden, hast eine Architektur-Roadmap für die neue Produktwelt aufgesetzt und die größten Engpässe in der Delivery beseitigt.
  • Nach 6 Monaten: Document Engine und Immobilien-Kontext-Graph laufen produktiv bei den ersten Bankkunden – mit messbarer Extraktionsgenauigkeit.
  • Nach 12 Monaten: Agentic Engineering ist Standard im Team, die drei Teams liefern unabhängig, du hast das Team um starke Talente erweitert, und jede Person weiß, wie sie mit deiner Unterstützung wachsen kann.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Engineering-Führung und Software-Architektur und hast Teams skaliert, ohne die Shipping-Geschwindigkeit zu verlieren - idealerweise in einem Scale-up.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit AI-Produkten und datenintensiven Systemen: Datenpipelines, Dokumentenverarbeitung, Datenmodellierung.
  • Du kennst moderne Web-Architekturen und Cloud-Infrastruktur (idealerweise TypeScript und AWS) gut genug, um Architektur- und Code-Reviews fundiert zu führen.
  • Du liebst es, Teams wachsen zu lassen, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen und ihnen gleichzeitig ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen.
  • Du denkst in Systemen und löst Probleme aus einer First-Principles-Perspektive.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch (mindestens C1) und fließend Englisch.

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Enterprise- oder Bankkunden - Security-Reviews, ISO 27001, DORA oder vergleichbare Anforderungen.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, und mit starker Kundenbasis für die nächste Wachstumsstufe und ohne Konzernpolitik. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss und kann.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Team, Architektur, ein Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar: im Umsatz, im Produkt und darin, wie das Engineering-Team in einem Jahr arbeitet.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.

30 Urlaubstage · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · Team-Events

Unser Prozess: Kennenlernen → Fachgespräch mit Case Study (Agent- und Architektur-Design) mit Debrief → Kennenlernen des Teams → Angebot.

Why Encord

Operating principles

High agency

title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

descriptionHtml:
Informadis | Les Ulis (91) | CDI Cadre | 50–60 K€ package | Déplacements nationaux

Qui sommes-nous ?

INFORMADIS est le partenaire informatique du réseau E.Leclerc. Nous accompagnons les magasins adhérents et leurs centrales régionales (SCA) dans leurs projets IT : téléphonie IP, réseau et sécurité (firewalls, switches…), hébergement en datacenter, logiciel de comptabilité Space X, matériel informatique, impression, et services managés / helpdesk.

Nos projets vont d’un magasin à plusieurs sites en déploiement simultané. Pour soutenir cette croissance, nous renforçons notre équipe d’avant-vente.

Le poste

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Commerce, vous êtes le pont entre les commerciaux et les équipes techniques. Vous transformez le besoin d’un magasin ou d’une centrale régionale en une solution concrète, chiffrée et convaincante. Vous intervenez sur tout le périmètre infrastructure (réseau et sécurité, téléphonie IP, hébergement), du magasin unique aux réseaux multi-sites, depuis la première visite jusqu’au passage en production.

Vos missions

Recueil et analyse du besoin

  • Qualifier les opportunités avec les commerciaux : périmètre, nombre de sites, enjeux, budget

  • Auditer l’existant réseau (LAN/WAN, liens opérateurs, Wi-Fi, sécurité), téléphonie, parc et hébergement

  • Rencontrer les directeurs de magasin, les responsables informatiques et les centrales

  • Identifier les risques techniques : câblage, liens opérateurs, fin du RTC, compatibilité du matériel

Conception réseau et sécurité

  • Concevoir les architectures LAN/WAN des magasins et des réseaux multi-sites : interconnexion, VPN, SD-WAN, redondance des liens

  • Définir la segmentation (VLAN) et le plan d’adressage

  • Préconiser les firewalls (Fortinet ou équivalent), les règles de filtrage et les accès distants sécurisés

  • Dimensionner les switches (PoE) et la couverture Wi-Fi

  • Intégrer la cybersécurité dans chaque proposition

Conception téléphonie

  • Concevoir l’architecture de téléphonie : IPBX on-premise ou hébergé, trunks SIP, SDA, portabilité, SVI, DECT

  • Garantir la qualité de service de la voix : QoS, priorisation des flux

  • Accompagner la migration RTC vers IP (fin du réseau cuivre)

Hébergement et chiffrage

  • Définir l’hébergement des applications métiers en datacenter

  • Dimensionner et chiffrer la solution : matériel, licences, liens, prestations

  • Proposer des scénarios alternatifs (achat ou service managé, standard ou optimisé)

Rédaction et soutenance

  • Rédiger les propositions techniques, dossiers d’architecture et réponses aux consultations

  • Présenter et défendre les solutions en soutenance, aux côtés du commercial

  • Contribuer à la standardisation des offres

Passage en production et veille

  • Transmettre un dossier complet aux chefs de projet et aux équipes techniques

  • Anticiper le plan de bascule pour limiter l’impact sur l’activité du magasin

  • Assurer une veille sur la fin du cuivre, la cybersécurité, le SD-WAN et le cloud

Profil recherché

  • Bac+3 à Bac+5 en informatique, réseaux ou télécoms, ou expérience équivalente

  • 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en avant-vente, ingénierie de solutions ou intégration (ESN, intégrateur, opérateur télécom)

  • Réseau et sécurité : LAN/WAN, VLAN, routage, VPN, QoS, firewalls (Fortinet apprécié), switches, Wi-Fi

  • Téléphonie IP : IPBX (Asterisk, 3CX, Alcatel ou équivalent), SIP, SDA, portabilité, SVI

  • Capacité à dimensionner une solution et à produire un chiffrage fiable

  • Appréciés : SD-WAN, virtualisation, SaaS/cloud, certifications constructeurs

  • Une expérience de la grande distribution ou d’un réseau multi-sites est un vrai plus

  • Vous savez vulgariser : vous expliquez aussi bien à un DSI qu’à un directeur de magasin

  • Permis B, déplacements nationaux

Compétences clés

Avant-vente · Réseau LAN/WAN · Sécurité / Firewall · Téléphonie IP · SIP / IPBX · Chiffrage · Rédaction technique · Pédagogie · Sens commercial

Ce que nous offrons

  • CDI, statut cadre

  • 50–60 K€ package selon profil

  • Smartphone (iPhone ou Samsung, au choix) et ordinateur portable

  • Mutuelle prise en charge à 100 %

  • Carte restaurant

  • Prime de gratification et prime d’intéressement

  • 1 jour de télétravail par semaine après la période d’essai

  • Les Ulis (91)

Ce poste vous correspond ? Postulez directement ou contactez-nous en message privé.

title: Interim Director of Financial Operations & Control
descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London / UK Remote | 💰£142,000 - £170,000 + Benefits  ✨

Our Financial Control team ⭐

We are seeking an experienced finance operations leader for a 12-month fixed-term contract to lead our Global Financial Operations and Control team. The incumbent Director is stepping out of day-to-day operations to spearhead a strategic, multi-year finance automation and systems program.

Your mandate is  to provide steady-state operational leadership across all financial operations, close cycles, and management reporting; and serve as the essential operational contact for the program.  You will ensure BAU integrity while actively operationalising and absorbing newly automated processes.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

  • Leading all aspects of financial control and operations, including Accounts Payable, Treasury Operations/Product Control, Money Operations ensuring robust, well controlled, and timely transaction processing.
  • Leading the production and end-to-end delivery of monthly close and management reporting cycle, working across Finance to provide the Group Financial Controller, UK CFO and EU CFOs with actionable insights and variance analysis.
  • Maintaining a robust, control and governance framework focused on integrity of our data and processes.  
  • Serving as the primary operational counterpart and sounding board to the Director of Financial Operations & Control (incumbent) within the programme, providing operational feedback on target operating models and workflow designs.
  • Managing team capacity and workflows to free up key subject matter experts for involvement in the programme, including (not limited to) User Acceptance Testing, parallel runs, and systems testing.
  • Supporting the practical change management and operational rollout of new automation tools within the live environment, establishing new standard operating procedures without interrupting daily processing.
  • Working closely with the Director of Financial & Regulatory Reporting to ensure core financial operations and control processes comply with overarching accounting policies  and provide a seamless hand off into the consolidation.
  • Providing stable, empathetic, and accountable leadership to a distributed team during a period of change, maintaining high engagement, retention, and performance.
  • Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, external auditors and advisors.
  • Driving the delivery of the Financial Operations and Control teams milestones and actions on existing key projects such as EU expansion, working with stakeholders to identify and resolve delivery risks.
  • Managing a structured, documented operational handover back to permanent leadership at the conclusion of the 12-month term.

Role Scope Clarification

  • Included: Global financial operations and control process ownership, including delivery of those services to subsidiaries, Treasury operations/Product control, Money Operations, Month-end Close and related management reporting.
  • Excluded: Group Consolidation and the preparation/filing of Statutory Financial Statements for the Group and subsidiaries; Regulatory Reporting. 

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You have a demonstrated track record stepping into high volume, multi-entity finance operations leadership roles and delivering immediate stability within regulated environments (Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services preferred). 
  • You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.
  • You have a deep understanding of internal control environments and the ability to build "best-in-class" processes.
  • You have experience operating within complex, multi-entity or cross-border structures where data consistency is paramount.
  • You have demonstrated experience operationalising new technology, and embedding change within Finance teams.
  • Have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain operational complexities to key stakeholders and peers.
  • You are adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, tech-led, and agile environments.
  • You hold strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS) 

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £142,000 - £170,000.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) *(delete if doesn’t apply) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 5 key steps

  • Initial Call with the Recruiter
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Role Specific Interview
  • Behavioural Interview
  • Final Interview with the Team 

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.

 #LI-TP1 #LI-REMOTE

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: Internship - Finance (Dec/Jan start, 6 months)
descriptionHtml:
Axelera AI is a fast-growing European AI hardware scale-up building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration for the edge. We are looking for a hands-on Finance Intern to join our team for 5-6 months, starting December 2026 or early January 2027.

You will join at one of the busiest and most interesting moments of the financial year: the year-end close and the FY2026 external audit. You will work directly with our VP Finance and Finance Managers on real day-to-day finance operations, not side projects. You will learn how a high-growth tech company runs its accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations and audit, and get exposure to investor and board reporting.

Location: Eindhoven (hybrid, 2 office days per week minimum)

Start date: December 2026 or early January 2027

Duration: 5-6 months

Hours: Minimum 4 days per week; full-time preferred

What you'll do:

  • Accounts payable: process and match supplier invoices, help clear the AP backlog and handle supplier queries.

  • Accounts receivable: follow up on overdue customer payments and keep the receivables overview up to date.

  • Reconciliations: prepare bank reconciliations and support month-end close reconciliations.

  • Audit support: help prepare PBC (provided-by-client) lists, pull sample support and respond to auditor and external accountant requests during the FY2026 audit.

  • Investor and board reporting: help gather and organise financial information for investor updates, board packs and ad hoc finance projects.

  • Process improvement: help document key finance processes and support our work on automation in NetSuite and AI tools (e.g. AP invoice capture, AR reminders, bank reconciliation matching).

What we're looking for:

Must have

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's programme in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or a related field, and able to do this internship with an internship agreement (stageovereenkomst) from your university.

  • Solid understanding of bookkeeping basics: debits and credits, accruals, AP/AR and reconciliations.

  • Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, basic formulas).

  • Interest in automation and using AI tools to improve finance processes.

  • Available for 6 months from December 2026 or early January 2027, for at least 4 days per week (full-time preferred).

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  • The right to work in the Netherlands. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • Accurate, organised and comfortable working through a high volume of transactions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with an ERP system, ideally NetSuite.

  • Previous finance, audit or accounting experience (internship, part-time job or student role).

What we offer

  • Hands-on experience across the full finance cycle in a high-growth deep-tech company, including a live external audit.

  • Close mentoring from experienced finance professionals, with real responsibility from day one.

  • Exposure to NetSuite and to how finance teams are using AI and automation.

  • A monthly internship allowance.

  • An international, collaborative team and a chance to be considered for future roles.

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. Die XIAO Gruppe ist eine mittelständische, inhabergeführte Unternehmensgruppe aus Gastronomie und Immobilienwirtschaft mit Sitz in Gelsenkirchen und Leverkusen. Gemeinsam mit unserer IT-Fachbereichsleitung und einem langjährigen externen IT-Partner stellen Sie den zuverlässigen Betrieb unserer IT sicher. DAS KÖNNTE DEIN AUFGABENGEBIET SEIN

  • Sie administrieren und pflegen unsere Microsoft-365-Umgebung – insbesondere Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint und SharePoint – sowie weitere cloudbasierte Systeme und entwickeln diese weiter.
  • Sie begleiten unsere Neueröffnungen aktiv und sorgen vor Ort für den Anschluss und die Inbetriebnahme sämtlicher IT-Systeme.

title: Key Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Key Account Management Team


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

  • Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

  • Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

  • Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

  • Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

  • Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

  • Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

  • Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

  • You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

  • You have at least advanced level in English

  • You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions

  • You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

  • You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

  • You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

  • You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

  • You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

  • You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux or Marseille.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux or Marseille.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Kundenmanager (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Beschwerdemanagement
descriptionHtml:
Über Wiese Dental Beratungs GmbH

Die Wiese Dental Beratungs GmbH unterstützt Gesundheitsunternehmen beim Wachstum mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Personalgewinnung und Mitarbeiterbindung. Unser Team arbeitet in München-Bogenhausen in den Bavaria Towers auf 800 qm Fläche an messbaren Ergebnissen für Unternehmen der Gesundheitsbranche.

Kundenmanagement | Beschwerdemanagement | Leistungsorientierte Vergütung

Du kannst gut mit Menschen umgehen, lässt dich auch von schwierigen Gesprächen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen und möchtest, dass sich dein Einsatz finanziell auszahlt? Dann bist du bei Visidental genau richtig!

Wir suchen eine kommunikationsstarke, durchsetzungsfähige und strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Freude daran hat, auch anspruchsvolle Kundenbeziehungen professionell zu betreuen.

Bei uns erwartet dich keine klassische Kundenservice-Stelle, in der du den ganzen Tag dieselben Anfragen abarbeitest. Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich, betreust Kunden eigenständig und hast die Möglichkeit, deine Ergebnisse und damit auch deine finanzielle Entwicklung aktiv zu beeinflussen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für einen definierten Kundenbereich und bist Ansprechpartner für Kundenanliegen, Rückfragen und Beschwerden.

  • Professionelles Beschwerdemanagement: Du kümmerst dich um anspruchsvolle Kundenanliegen, findest passende Lösungen und führst auch schwierige Gespräche souverän und zielorientiert.

  • Schriftliche Kommunikation: Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Kommunikation per E-Mail. Je nach Situation führst du ergänzend Telefonate oder Videogespräche.

  • Strukturierte Fallbearbeitung: Du analysierst Sachverhalte, priorisierst Anliegen, dokumentierst Vereinbarungen und sorgst dafür, dass offene Vorgänge konsequent bearbeitet werden.

  • Wirtschaftliches Kundenmanagement: Du behältst neben der Kundenzufriedenheit auch die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen im Blick und triffst Entscheidungen mit Augenmaß.

  • Zielorientiertes Arbeiten: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich auf gemeinsam vereinbarte Ziele hin und kannst dir durch deine Leistung attraktive zusätzliche Vergütungen sichern.

Das bringst du mit

Wir suchen keinen bestimmten Lebenslauf, sondern die richtige Persönlichkeit.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst dich schriftlich hervorragend ausdrücken und findest auch in schwierigen Situationen die richtigen Worte.

  • Durchsetzungsvermögen: Du kannst freundlich, aber bestimmt kommunizieren, Grenzen setzen und deinen Standpunkt souverän vertreten.

  • Belastbarkeit: Beschwerden, Kritik oder Ablehnung bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept. Du nimmst Dinge nicht persönlich und behältst einen kühlen Kopf.

  • Struktur und Organisation: Du kannst mehrere Vorgänge parallel bearbeiten, behältst den Überblick und arbeitest zuverlässig.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du verstehst komplexere Sachverhalte schnell, erkennst Zusammenhänge und findest eigenständig praktikable Lösungen.

  • Wirtschaftliches Denken: Du hast ein Gespür für sinnvolle Entscheidungen und arbeitest gerne ergebnisorientiert.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden Schritt vorgibt, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Dinge selbstständig zum Abschluss.

Erfahrungen im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement, Vertrieb, Account Management oder in der kaufmännischen Sachbearbeitung sind von Vorteil. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger mit der passenden Persönlichkeit sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

Das bieten wir dir

Deine Leistung soll sich lohnen.

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Du erhältst eine Kombination aus fixer Vergütung und leistungsabhängigen zusätzlichen Verdienstmöglichkeiten.

  • Überdurchschnittliches Einkommenspotenzial: Bei entsprechender Zielerreichung und überdurchschnittlicher Performance sind attraktive zusätzliche Einkünfte möglich. Deine Entwicklung ist dabei nicht ausschließlich an klassische Gehaltserhöhungen gebunden.

  • Transparente Zielvereinbarungen: Deine Leistung wird anhand gemeinsam definierter Ziele bewertet. Gute Ergebnisse werden finanziell honoriert.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du erhältst einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und kannst deine Arbeit selbstständig gestalten.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen und dich weiterentwickeln möchtest, stehen dir bei uns entsprechende Perspektiven offen.

  • Wiese Dental-Benefits: Zusätzlich profitierst du von unseren weiteren Mitarbeiterangeboten und Arbeitgeberleistungen.

Wen wir besonders suchen

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht bei jeder kritischen E-Mail nervös wird, sondern sich denkt: „Das bekomme ich gelöst.“

Jemanden, der freundlich bleiben kann, ohne sich alles gefallen zu lassen. Der gerne kommuniziert, aber auch weiß, wann eine klare Ansage notwendig ist. Und jemanden, der nicht nur seine Aufgaben erledigen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen und sich durch gute Leistung auch finanziell weiterentwickeln möchte.

Du erkennst dich darin wieder? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Bewirb dich jetzt bei Wiese Dental als Kundenmanager (m/w/d).

title: Lead AI Enablement Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Lead AI Enablement Engineer

Location: Belfast

Department: Engineering Enablement

Reports to: VP Enablement

Employment Type: Full time

About EverQuote

EverQuote’s vision is to make it more efficient to shop for and buy insurance with confidence. We use data, technology and marketplace expertise to connect insurance shoppers with providers and help our customers grow their businesses.

As AI becomes part of everyday work across the organisation, we want every colleague, technical or not, to get real value from it. Our enablement teams make that possible by turning new AI capabilities into reliable, trusted services.

About the team

The Lead AI Enablement Engineer sits within Engineering Enablement and owns the integration, usability and adoption of EverQuote’s enterprise AI services.

You will also partner with IT, Security and Platform Engineering on service support and controls, and with data owners on access, privacy and auditability.

About the role

Help everyone across our organisation get more value from AI. We are looking for a hands-on Lead AI Enablement Engineer to make our AI products and services connected, reliable and useful in everyday work across Finance, Operations, HR, Sales, Engineering and beyond.

We already use Claude, and there is significant opportunity to improve the experience through relevant features, connectors, skills and access to trusted knowledge. You will turn that opportunity into working services and practical ways of working that colleagues adopt and value, while evolving our capabilities as AI technology advances.

You will lead the technical integration and continuous improvement of these services, combining engineering depth with curiosity about LLMs and a strong customer focus. The role combines hands-on delivery with technical leadership and mentoring.

You will shape how an entire organisation works with AI. You will have the opportunity to explore new capabilities, turn promising ideas into dependable services and see the impact directly in colleagues’ daily work. Your technical decisions and customer insight will help define a new AI capability and how it evolves.

What you’ll do:

Own the AI service roadmap:

  • Understand how colleagues work and identify friction.
  • Prioritise improvements with department leads.
  • Treat technical and non-technical employees as customers, and test changes with them.

Integrate AI into everyday work

  • Configure and administer enterprise AI products.
  • Work closely with other enablement teams to make sure the tooling is fully integrated.
  • Work closely with InfoSec to make sure risks and standards have been met.
  • Build connectors, MCP integrations, APIs and lightweight services that connect approved tools, business systems and knowledge sources.
  • Keep permissions and data access aligned with users’ existing entitlements.

Turn new capabilities into useful services

  • Track model releases, product features and emerging tools.
  • Evaluate quality, usability, cost and risk against real tasks.
  • Recommend, pilot and roll out improvements with clear guidance and a way to reverse unsuccessful changes.

Create reusable capabilities

  • Make skills, shared instructions, workflow templates and agents discoverable, with clear owners, testing and version control.
  • Help teams adapt proven approaches to their own work.

Show colleagues what is possible

  • Run practical demonstrations, workshops, office hours and hands-on sessions using real business workflows.
  • Build a network of departmental champions.
  • Make guidance accessible to different confidence and skill levels.

Own the end-user experience

  • Monitor integration health, answer quality and user feedback.
  • Investigate failures and recurring friction.
  • Coordinate fixes, vendor escalations, change communications and support arrangements with IT, Security and Platform Engineering.

Provide technical leadership

  • Establish integration and evaluation standards.
  • Mentor others and shape vendor decisions.
  • Continuously keep up to date with the latest LLM releases and harnesses to better inform the direction of the organisation.
  • Partner with Security and data owners on access, privacy, auditability and safe tool use.

What we’re looking for:

  • 10 years experience in software development with 3+ years in AI
  • Strong hands-on engineering experience building and supporting integrations, internal tools or enterprise services: you write maintainable code, work with APIs and authentication, and diagnose problems across connected systems.
  • Practical experience applying LLMs and AI tools to real workflows used by other people, with an understanding of context, retrieval, tool use and evaluation, the limits of model outputs, and when human review is needed.
  • A sustained interest in AI tooling, demonstrated through experimentation and working solutions. You follow developments actively and can explain which changes are worth adopting, which need more testing and which add little value.
  • A customer-focused approach: you listen, observe how work happens and stay involved until the solution is useful. You can support a non-technical colleague and discuss integration trade-offs with an engineer.
  • Evidence of technical leadership, prioritisation and cross-functional delivery: you can turn broad needs into a practical roadmap, set standards and bring others with you through coaching and clear communication.
  • Experience delivering reliable services with appropriate access controls, testing, monitoring and documentation, and taking ownership of how a capability performs after launch.
  • You do not need experience with every product or tool listed, but experience in several would be valuable:
    • Claude Enterprise or similar enterprise AI products.
    • MCP, reusable skills and agent workflows.
    • Enterprise search and knowledge integration.
    • Python or TypeScript.
    • AWS.
    • SaaS administration, SSO and OAuth.
    • AI adoption programmes and communities of practice.

How you work

You put customers first: You observe how work actually happens, test changes with the people who will use them and stay involved until the solution is useful.

You are evidence-led: You evaluate new capabilities against real tasks, establish baselines with users and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities.

You stay curious: You experiment, follow developments in AI and separate changes worth adopting from those that add little value.

You own the outcome: You take responsibility for how a capability performs after launch, not only for getting it live.

You bring others with you: You mentor, set standards and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues, with departmental champions and with vendors.

What success looks like:

In your first 90 days, you will have:

  • Assessed our current AI services, feature availability, integration gaps and user experience.
  • Agreed a prioritised roadmap.
  • Delivered a small set of valuable integrations and reusable workflows across several departments.
  • Established practical enablement sessions and a feedback loop.

Over time, success means:

  • Sustained adoption across business functions.
  • Reliable integrations.
  • Better user satisfaction.
  • Measurable improvements in task time or output quality.

You will establish baselines with users, track cost alongside benefit, and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities. Feature launches and licence activation alone are not measures of success.

Our values

At EverQuote, how we achieve results matters as much as the results themselves.

  • Be Tenacious: We aim high, move quickly and persist through difficult technical and organisational problems.
  • Help Customers Win: We prioritise work that creates meaningful and sustainable value for our customers.
  • Follow the Data: We use evidence to guide decisions and measure outcomes.
  • Strengthen Our Team: We communicate directly, share knowledge and leave teams and systems stronger than we found them.

Equal opportunity

EverQuote is committed to equal opportunity employment and to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and consider qualified candidates without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.

Reasonable Adjustments

We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to arrange them.

title: Lead Designer / Design System Owner (f/x/m) in Tech & Data Team
descriptionHtml:
Our design system is the shared foundation behind the experiences millions of musicians use on thomann.de. It provides consistent components and guidelines for our product teams so they can build faster and focus on what makes each experience unique.

The Design System Team sits within our Product Division, alongside Product Design and Product Research, and brings together a Design System Architect and a group of frontend engineers who turn design decisions into robust, reusable code. We treat the design system as a product in its own right, with its own users, roadmap and priorities.

  • Tjark, Tobias & Heiko are our Frontend Engineers, building and improving the components our shop is made of and making sure every team can use them with ease.

  • Juliane designs the components that bring our shop to life as our Design System Architect, owns our Figma and accessibility libraries and helps new designers find their way.

  • And that’s where you come in: As our Product Owner, you help us decide what matters most, keep close contact with the many teams who rely on our Design System and roll up your sleeves as a designer to shape our components hands-on.

We work remote, distributed, together: Whether fully remote within Germany or on-site in our offices in Berlin & Erlangen - always as a team, always customer-oriented and data-driven.



Here’s what you’ll be doing

  • Own and maintain the design system roadmap, documentation and backlog, aligned with the needs of consuming product teams and with the division's process while following scrum events and existing formats in the team.

  • Run intake and triage: collect requests from designers, engineers and product owners, make prioritization decisions, communicate them transparently and track adoption.

  • Represent the design system in cross-team planning, and represent consuming teams' needs inside the design system team.

  • Design and improve components end to end like states, variants, responsive behaviour, accessibility, edge cases.

  • Maintain the quality bar for anything entering the shared library in Figma.

  • Work closely with the Design System Architect to make sure design intent and component architecture match.

What you should bring to the table

  • Experience owning a product or platform backlog, including saying no to stakeholders and explaining why.

  • Hands-on product design skill: you can design a component to production quality yourself, not only review someone else's.

  • Advanced Figma skills, including component and variant modelling in a shared library.

  • Solid understanding of design systems: tokens, component APIs, theming, accessibility requirements.

  • Enough technical fluency to have a substantive conversation with frontend engineers about implementation constraints.

  • Strong written communication. Much of this role is documentation, release notes and rationale.

What we have to offer

  • Flexible working hours and location, with the option to go into the office (fully-remote possible)

  • 13th salary in November

  • Further training opportunities with clear development paths for your career

  • Thomann.de employee discount

  • Personal work equipment according to your wishes and regarding your role

  • Regular team events

  • English or German language courses

  • 1:1 sessions with an external coach, for professional development

  • Urban Sports Club discount

  • and more! Check out our Handbook

We value inclusion and diversity

We pride ourselves on being an inclusive employer that creates a welcoming atmosphere, and value diversity in our teams. We do not make judgements based on ethnicity, nationality, age, marital status, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion.
