title: Lead Learning & Development Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

About The Role

As our Lead Learning & Development Partner, you'll be the first dedicated L&D hire at Focused Energy and will have the opportunity to build the function from the ground up. This is a build from zero, sequenced for impact rather than a catalogue of offerings. You'll own manager development, a shared picture of the skills the organization has and needs, the learning infrastructure that makes learning findable and current, successor readiness for the roles that matter most, and the knowledge management work that keeps technical and scientific expertise from leaving with the person who holds it.

You'll work closely with People Business Partners, functional leads, People Operations, and the Strategic People Projects Partner, and you'll partner with subject matter experts across the organization as co-authors of the learning that translates deep technical and scientific knowledge into something usable by the people who need it.

This is a highly hands on role. We're looking for someone who brings a strong point of view, can operate independently, and is excited to determine what great learning looks like at Focused Energy, and then make it happen.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and own the L&D function at Focused Energy, from diagnosing organizational needs through designing, delivering, and continuously improving learning programs.

  • Design and run manager development: frameworks, content, cohorts, and ongoing support for people managers at every level.

  • Own the skill map: the critical skills per function and level, where Focused Energy stands today and where the gaps are, kept current together with functional leads.

  • Design skill development: learning paths that close those gaps, spanning technical and scientific depth as well as leadership, built with subject matter experts as co-authors rather than external content alone.

  • Own succession planning for critical roles: successor pipelines, readiness reviewed together with People Business Partners and the VP People, and the development plans that follow from that review.

  • Build the learning infrastructure, including platform selection, setup, and content that stays findable and current.

  • Own the capability track of onboarding, so new joiners understand how Focused Energy works within their first 30 days, in partnership with People Operations, which keeps the administrative side of onboarding.

  • Own knowledge management: capturing technical and scientific expertise so it doesn't leave the organization when the person who holds it does.

  • Use feedback, data, and observation to evaluate learning effectiveness, and be willing to stop investing in programs that aren't creating meaningful impact.

  • Partner with People Business Partners on the parts of succession and skills work that draw on the performance picture they hold, and with the Enablement & Analytics team so skill and succession data live in the People reporting layer.

  • Partner with the Strategic People Projects Partner on leadership program builds that run as joint projects.

  • Bring recommendations and a clear point of view on L&D priorities, sequencing, program design, and infrastructure rather than waiting for direction.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Several years of experience in Learning & Development, organizational development, leadership development, instructional design, or a closely related field.

  • Strong knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design, with the ability to translate those principles into practical, engaging learning experiences.

  • Experience designing and delivering manager and/or leadership development programs.

  • Experience building skill frameworks or competency models, and using skills data to inform development and workforce planning conversations.

  • Experience with succession planning, including building successor pipelines for critical roles and the development plans that support readiness.

  • Experience building or improving learning infrastructure, ideally including selecting, implementing, or managing a Learning Management System or equivalent platform.

  • Experience with knowledge management, documentation, and practices that capture and transfer critical expertise.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex or technical information into accessible learning formats without losing accuracy.

  • A highly independent, hands on approach. You're comfortable building something from scratch, making decisions with imperfect information, and taking ownership for outcomes.

  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to build trust with executives, managers, technical experts, and employees across different functions.

  • A data informed and iterative mindset: you use feedback and evidence to understand what is working, improve it, and change course when it isn't.

  • Experience working in a deep tech, scientific, engineering, or otherwise highly technical environment is a strong advantage.

Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Lead Performance Marketing & Client Delivery (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
📍 Ort: München, Office am Marienplatz (Montag bis Donnerstag im Office, Freitag flexibel)
🗓️ Start: flexibel
🚀 Rolle: Leadership Role, erste Vollzeit Senior Rolle in unserem Münchner Kernteam
💶 Gehalt: 65.000 bis 80.000 € fix plus unbegrenzter Bonus auf den Deckungsbeitrag deiner eigenen Kunden

👋 Über Grannel

Grannel ist eine Founder-led Boutique Performance Marketing Agentur aus München.

2020 als One-Man-Show gestartet. Heute bauen wir in München unser Kernteam auf und fahren die externe Arbeit Schritt für Schritt zurück.

Wir arbeiten nicht als „Dienstleister“, sondern als strategischer Wachstumspartner auf Augenhöhe mit Foundern, CMOs und Heads of Growth.

  • Unser Fokus: Paid Ads und alles, was darauf einzahlt. Tracking, Funnel, Creatives und Media.

  • Unsere Kernkanäle: Meta, Google, TikTok.

  • Unsere Stärke: Creative + Data als zentraler Wachstumstreiber.

  • Referenzen: Brands wie HOLY und Sunday Natural haben wir bereits beim Wachstum begleitet.

Und wir bauen Grannel als AI first Agentur. Reporting, Monitoring, Uploads und Analysen laufen zu großen Teilen über eigene AI Workflows. So bleibt Zeit für das, was wirklich Impact hat.

Wir wachsen bewusst über Ergebnisse, nicht über Sales-Pitches.

🎯 Warum wir diese Rolle jetzt aufbauen

Grannel ist stark über Delivery gewachsen. Der Founder (ex-Meta, ex-Google) bleibt strategisch eng an unseren Kunden dran.

Für die nächste Wachstumsstufe brauchen wir jedoch eine zentrale Delivery-Instanz in München, die:

  • Kundenergebnisse verantwortet

  • strategisch mitführt

  • Prozesse strukturiert

  • ein kleines Team vor Ort mit aufbaut

Wir suchen keinen zusätzlichen Media Buyer. Wir suchen einen Partner in der Delivery.

🧭 Deine Rolle

Als Lead Performance Marketing & Client Delivery bist du Owner der Kundenergebnisse. Du:

  • führst mehrere Kunden end-to-end

  • arbeitest auf Entscheider-Ebene

  • entwickelst kanalübergreifende Strategien

  • priorisierst Hebel mit echtem Business Impact

  • steuerst Werkstudenten, Freelancer und unsere AI Workflows

  • baust perspektivisch ein kleines Team in München auf

Du machst nicht alles selbst. Du stellst sicher, dass die richtigen Dinge richtig gemacht werden. Wenn es drauf ankommt, gehst du aber selbst in die Tools und packst mit an.

🛠️ Verantwortungsbereiche

Client Ownership & Growth Consulting

  • Strategische Beratung auf Founder- und Exec-Level

  • Weekly Syncs, Monthly Strategy Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews

  • Erwartungs- und Stakeholder-Management

  • Klare Priorisierung von Business-Hebeln, auch jenseits der Ads: Angebot, Landingpage, Funnel

Performance & Channel Strategy

  • Entwicklung kanalübergreifender Strategien (Meta, TikTok, Google)

  • Budget-Allokation und Skalierungslogik

  • Testing-Frameworks

  • Ownership von Tracking- und Attributionslogik (nicht operative Umsetzung)

Creative Strategy & Analytics

  • Analyse von Creative-Performance und Ableitung klarer Learnings

  • Entwicklung von Growth-Angles

  • Briefing von Designern und UGC-Creators

Team & Delivery Excellence

  • Steuerung von Werkstudenten und Freelancern

  • Sicherstellung konstanter Delivery-Qualität

  • Aufbau von Prozessen und Standards

📈 Was Erfolg bedeutet

Nach 6 Monaten:

  • Du führst Kunden eigenständig

  • Klare Routinen und saubere Prozesse

  • Founder nur noch punktuell operativ involviert

Nach 12 Monaten:

  • Du bist zentrale Delivery-Instanz

  • Du führst ein kleines, starkes Team

  • Du prägst die strategische Weiterentwicklung von Grannel

🔍 Wen wir suchen

✅ Must-Haves

  • Mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung im Performance Marketing (idealerweise 3 bis 6 Jahre)

  • Agentur oder schnell wachsendes E-Commerce / Startup

  • Tiefe Praxis in Meta Ads, solides Verständnis von TikTok und Google Ads

  • Business-Denken jenseits von „ROAS optimieren“: Deckungsbeitrag, CAC, CLV

  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt auf Entscheider-Ebene

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) und sehr gutes Englisch

  • Montag bis Donnerstag im Office in München

➕ Nice-to-Haves

  • Tracking- und Attribution-Know-how

  • Gespür für Creatives und Content

  • Erste Führungserfahrung

  • Du nutzt AI Tools bereits produktiv im Alltag

🚫 Für wen diese Rolle nicht ist

  • Wenn du hauptsächlich Ads klicken willst

  • Wenn du klare Aufgaben ohne Verantwortung suchst

  • Wenn du keinen Kundenkontakt möchtest

  • Wenn du nur einen Kanal optimieren willst

🎁 Was wir bieten

  • Founding-Role mit echtem Einfluss

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founder

  • Anspruchsvolle Growth-Cases mit Brands aus D2C und Lead Gen

  • Aufbau eines Münchner Teams

  • Klare Perspektive: von Lead zu Head of Growth

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 € im Jahr, monatlicher Sachbezug

  • Hochwertige Hardware und Zugang zu allen relevanten AI Tools

💰 Und weil man von Obstkorb & Wellpass keine Miete zahlt

65.000 bis 80.000 € Base plus skalierbarer, unbegrenzter Performance-Bonus. Bei Zielerreichung liegst du bei circa 85.000 bis 100.000 €, nach oben offen.

Wir skalieren mit unseren Kunden über Performance-Modelle, die uns finanziell alignen. Warum sollten wir das intern anders machen? Wenn wir wachsen, wächst du mit.

✍️ Bewerbung

Diese Rolle ist anspruchsvoll. I know.

Du musst nicht der perfekte Fit sein. Ownership und strategisches Denken sind entscheidend.

CV oder LinkedIn-Profil reichen aus. Anschreiben ist optional. Die kurzen Fragen im Bewerbungsformular helfen uns, dir schnell zu antworten. Keine Sorge, wir nageln dich auf keine Zahl fest 😄

Hinweis zur Gleichbehandlung: Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Kandidat:innen. Mit deiner Bewerbung erklärst du dich einverstanden, dass wir deine Daten im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses speichern und verarbeiten. Daten abgelehnter Bewerbungen löschen wir nach sechs Monaten.

Our Mobile team⭐

At Monzo, we believe managing your mobile plan should feel as simple and transparent as managing your money. With Monzo Mobile, we’re bringing that experience to connectivity, helping customers stay connected with a product that feels intuitive, flexible and genuinely useful.

We’ve launched our mobile offering and are now focused on the next phase of growth. That means reaching more customers, improving how they discover and engage with Monzo Mobile, and exploring how we can serve broader connectivity needs over time.

As a Product Lead, you’ll help shape the direction of Monzo Mobile as a business and product area. You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations and Customer Experience to set strategy, drive execution and ensure we’re investing in the right opportunities to deliver meaningful customer and commercial outcomes.

This is an opportunity to lead a high-potential product area at Monzo, combining the pace and ambiguity of building something relatively new with the reach of a trusted brand. You should be excited about setting direction in uncertain spaces, leading through influence, and translating strategy into high-quality execution.

  • Setting the product strategy for Monzo Mobile, identifying where we can win in connectivity and translating that into clear priorities, bets and trade-offs.
  • Owning growth and business performance for the area, using customer, market and data insight to drive adoption, engagement and retention.
  • Leading multiple workstreams across the product area, ensuring teams are focused on the highest-impact opportunities and that short-term delivery ladders up to longer-term goals.
  • Partnering closely with Marketing, Operations and Customer Experience to improve the end-to-end customer journey and ensure the product scales effectively.
  • Building a strong understanding of the commercial drivers of the business to inform investment decisions, prioritisation and partner choices.
  • Working with external partners where needed to improve customer experience, delivery outcomes and commercial effectiveness.
  • Influencing senior stakeholders across Monzo and aligning adjacent teams around a coherent vision for the space.
  • Coaching and raising the bar for product thinking, execution and decision-making across the team.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’ve led and scaled consumer digital products or product areas with meaningful customer and business impact.
  • You’re able to set strategy in ambiguous spaces and translate it into clear execution plans.
  • You’re highly analytical and comfortable using data to identify opportunities, make decisions and measure impact.
  • You’re commercially minded and can balance customer value with business outcomes.
  • You’re excellent at influencing senior stakeholders and aligning multiple teams behind a shared direction.
  • You care deeply about customer experience and know how to make complex products feel simple.
  • You’ve led large, cross-functional initiatives and are comfortable operating across product, marketing, operations and technology.
  • You’re thoughtful, low-ego and excited by what we’re building at Monzo.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £120,000 - £140,000  range ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK. 

✅ We can sponsor your visa. 

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Recruiter Call 
  • Initial Call with Hiring Manager 
  • Final Loop, consisting of x 3 hour long interviews to assess Project Walkthrough, Case Study and Leadership.

Our average process takes around 4-6 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.

title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
descriptionHtml:
REQ ID: FEQ227R147

Location: United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based)

Recruiter: Dina Hussain

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.

You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.
  • Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.
  • Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.
  • Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.
  • Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.
  • Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.
  • Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.
  • Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.
  • Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).
  • Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.
  • Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.
  • A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.
  • Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.
  • Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.
  • Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.

Nice to Have

  • Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.
  • Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.

Why This Role

You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

descriptionHtml:

Notre impact : garantir la disponibilité du bon produit au bon moment pour nos magasins, entrepôts et marketplaces à travers le monde. Nos défis : accompagner la transformation numérique du groupe, intégrer les nouveaux modèles commerciaux (circularité, wholesale) et préparer la transition vers SAP S/4HANA.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

En tant qu'Ingénieur·e Support (f/m/d), tu garantis la stabilité, l'efficience et l'évolution des outils d'orchestration de nos commandes et stocks. Tes missions principales :

  • Communication & Astreintes : Assurer une communication claire auprès des parties prenantes lors des maintenances et participer aux rotations d'astreinte sur les fonctions critiques.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Formation & Expérience : Diplôme d'ingénieur·e (idéalement en informatique) ou parcours équivalent.

STACK TECHNIQUE

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • Organisation de travail hybride (jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine) ;

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

DECATHLON DIGITAL

Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

title: Leiter Ersatzteile & Nachfertigung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
ALPINA CLASSIC – fast 40.000 Automobile, die weiterfahren sollen

ALPINA begeistert Automobilenthusiasten weltweit. 1965 gegründet von Burkard Bovensiepen, entwickelte sich die Marke unter Familienführung zu einer Ikone automobiler Kleinserien und der Ingenieurskunst. Ab 2026 wird die Zukunft der Marke von der BMW AG gestaltet. Zwischen 1965 und 2025 entstanden in Buchloe Automobile in kleinen Serien, geprägt von Präzision, Charakter und handwerklicher Perfektion. Fast 40.000 dieser Fahrzeuge sind noch unterwegs, und hinter jedem steht ein Besitzer, der sein Auto fahren will. Die entscheidende Frage ist dabei nicht der Service, sondern das Teil, das es nicht mehr gibt. Genau darum geht es in dieser Position.

“Born and Made in Buchloe“

ALPINA CLASSIC ist und bleibt die zentrale Adresse für die Fahrzeuge, die in Buchloe endgefertigt und ausgeliefert wurden: fundiertes Know-how, autorisierter Service, Original-Ersatzteile und Zubehör, die es exklusiv bei uns gibt. Technische Unterlagen, Stücklisten und die Erfahrung aus dem Bau dieser Fahrzeuge liegen am Standort – in dieser Tiefe gibt es das nirgends sonst. Dazu kommt eine Gemeinschaft von Besitzern, die weltweit zusammenhält.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgabe – Die Nachfertigung treiben, das Teilegeschäft führen

Ihre erste Priorität ist die Nachfertigung von Originalteilen. Teile, die seit Jahren nicht mehr lieferbar sind, müssen wieder entstehen – in kleinen Stückzahlen, in Originalqualität, zu einem Preis, der trägt. Sie entscheiden, welche Teile das sind, und Sie bringen jedes dieser Projekte durch das Haus: über Technik, Einkauf, Qualität und Lager hinweg, bis das Teil im Regal liegt und im Shop bestellbar ist. Sie berichten direkt an die Geschäftsleitung, ohne Zwischenebene.

Ihre zweite Priorität ist die Sparte selbst, für die Sie die Ergebnisverantwortung tragen und ein abteilungsübergreifendes Team steuern. Als Spartenleiter führen Sie dabei in der Matrix: Sie verantworten die GuV Ihrer Sparte und führen fachlich die Beteiligten aus Technik, Einkauf, Qualität, Lager, Vertrieb und Marketing, die zu Ihren Projekten zuliefern, ohne Ihnen zu unterstehen. Die ALPINA CLASSIC Community treibt das Marketing voran – Sie koordinieren und liefern zu, was nur Sie liefern können: Modellwissen, Produktgeschichten und die Antwort auf die Frage, warum ein Teil so gebaut war, wie es gebaut war.

  • Priorisierung des Nachfertigungsprogramms: Sie entscheiden anhand von Nachfrage, Restbeständen und Ausfallhäufigkeit, welche Teile nachgefertigt werden – und rechnen jedes Projekt vorher durch
  • Steuerung des Projektportfolios: mehrere Nachfertigungsprojekte laufen parallel, mit Terminen, Budgets, Meilensteinen und einem Reporting, das die Geschäftsleitung entscheidungsfähig macht
  • Führung in der Matrix: Technik, Einkauf, Qualität, Lager, Vertrieb und Marketing liefern zu Ihren Projekten zu, ohne Ihnen zu unterstehen – Sie treiben, terminieren und eskalieren, wenn es klemmt
  • Volle Ergebnisverantwortung für die Sparte ALPINA CLASSIC: Versorgung mit Original-Ersatzteilen und Zubehör, Services, Sortiment, Preise, Marge, Verfügbarkeit und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Sicherstellung der autorisierten Instandsetzung und technischen Betreuung der bis Ende 2025 gebauten BMW ALPINA Automobile
  • Weiterentwicklung des Online-Shops ALPINA CLASSIC Shop als zentraler Vertriebskanal für Teile, Zubehör und Merchandising
  • Pflege des internationalen Kundenstamms und fachliche Unterstützung des Marketings beim Auf- und Ausbau der ALPINA CLASSIC Community – Modellkenntnis, Produktgeschichten, Beiträge zu Events, Clubs und Kooperationen

Der Kern dieser Aufgabe ist Projektarbeit: Aus einem Teil, das es nicht mehr gibt, wird ein Projekt mit Zeitplan, Kalkulation und Liefertermin – und am Ende ein Teil, das ein Kunde in Australien bestellen kann.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – Projekterfahrung trifft Modellkenntnis

Sie kennen diese Fahrzeuge: die Baureihen, die Technik, die Unterschiede zwischen den Ausbaustufen. Und Sie können ein Projekt über Monate am Laufen halten, wenn drei Beteiligte gerade anderes zu tun haben. Beides zusammen ist selten – und beides ist für diese Rolle nötig. Die Historie allein reicht nicht, die Methode allein auch nicht.

Was bringen Sie mit?

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung von Projekten im industriellen oder automobilen Umfeld: Sie haben Vorhaben mit Termin, Budget und mehreren Beteiligten geliefert, nicht nur begleitet
  • Erfahrung im automobilen Aftersales, Teile- oder Zubehörgeschäft – Sortiment, Beschaffung, Verfügbarkeit und Kalkulation, idealerweise mit eigener Ergebnis- oder Budgetverantwortung
  • Fundierte Kenntnis der ALPINA Modelle und ihrer Historie: Sie wissen, welches Teil zu welcher Baureihe gehört und warum es sich von der BMW Serie unterscheidet
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Stücklisten, Teilenummern, technischen Zeichnungen und ERP-Daten
  • Führungserfahrung in der Matrix: Sie bringen Beteiligte ohne disziplinarische Weisung dazu, Zusagen und Termine zu halten – über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg
  • Englisch, das für Lieferanten, Händler und Kunden weltweit trägt

Was uns zusätzlich überzeugt:

  • Erfahrung in Nachfertigung, Reproduktion oder Kleinserienfertigung – Werkzeuge, Erstmuster, Lieferantenqualifizierung
  • Erfahrung im E-Commerce oder im Aufbau von Online-Vertriebskanälen
  • Eigener Bezug zu Klassikern, ob als Schrauber, Sammler oder im Club

Benefits

Was wir bieten – Echte Möglichkeiten mit klaren Perspektiven

Sie arbeiten am Standort Buchloe, mit technischer Dokumentation und Fertigungserfahrung zu diesen Fahrzeugen, die es in dieser Tiefe nur hier gibt. Wir sind inhabergeführt und schlank organisiert: Ihre Ideen landen direkt dort, wo Entscheidungen getroffen werden. Über ein Nachfertigungsprojekt entscheiden Sie mit der Geschäftsleitung, nicht mit einem Gremium.

  • Vergütung: Attraktives Fixgehalt und ein leistungsbezogener variabler Anteil
  • Verantwortung: Spartenleitung mit voller Ergebnisverantwortung für ALPINA CLASSIC – eine Sparte mit klarer Mission und globalem Kundenstamm, Führung in der Matrix über die Fachbereiche hinweg, direkte Berichtslinie an die Geschäftsleitung ohne Zwischenebene
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Das Nachfertigungsprogramm entsteht mit Ihnen. Reihenfolge, Umfang und Tempo bestimmen Sie mit
  • Produktnähe: Manufaktur, Teilelager und Ihr Schreibtisch liegen wenige Schritte auseinander
  • Zusatzleistungen: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, JobRad und freier Parkplatz direkt am Standort
  • Perspektive: Die Teile- und Zubehörversorgung ist der wachsende Teil unseres Geschäfts – diese Sparte bauen Sie auf
  • Pendeln ohne Umzug: Aus Kaufbeuren, Landsberg, Marktoberdorf und Mindelheim sind Sie in 20 bis 30 Minuten hier, aus Augsburg, Memmingen und dem Münchner Westen in gut 40. Der Bahnhof Buchloe ist fünf Gehminuten entfernt

Bereit?

Wenn Sie beim Lesen schon wissen, welches Teil Sie als erstes nachfertigen würden, bewerben Sie sich. Ein Lebenslauf genügt, ein Anschreiben ist willkommen, aber kein Muss. Sagen Sie uns, ab wann Sie können. Wir behandeln jede Bewerbung vertraulich und melden uns innerhalb von sieben Tagen. Wenden Sie sich bei Fragen gerne direkt an Frau Janet Weiss, Leitung Personal, unter +49 8241 5005-439.

title: Machine Learning Engineer III, Routing Cost
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What We Do

The Navigation team at Mapbox develops and operates web services powering virtually all of Mapbox’s strategic navigation initiatives in consumer, automotive, and logistics verticals. We are a highly multidisciplinary organization, with work spanning distributed systems on AWS to geospatial localization, traffic telemetry, and mapping.

Collectively we are revolutionizing in-car experiences with technology to build fast, industry-leading maps and navigation for any vehicle. We’ve launched products such as MapGPT, Mapbox for EV, and we’re enhancing the visual experience of in-vehicle navigation with 3D styling with our new Mapbox Standard through web and mobile SDKs. Mapbox has worked with automotive partners — including BMW, Toyota, and GM — to bring the best aspects of mobile app development into in-vehicle navigation and infotainment.

  • Mapbox Blog: Introducing 3D Live Navigation

  • Mapbox Blog: Route Notifications Improve Driver Safety

  • Mapbox Newsroom: AI Features in New Navigation SDK

As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

What You’ll Do

As a Machine Learning Engineer III on the Routing Cost team, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of highly trafficked recommendation systems for our routing cost engine. Your technical contributions will include:

  • Lead the engineering team(s) to execute end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation organization (~80 engineers).

  • Design and build new ML and data pipelines, as well as optimizing existing ML and data pipelines.

  • Build tools for automated quality assurance and data exploration.

  • Leverage geospatial algorithms to optimize pipelines, as well as creating automated tuning and outlier detection algorithms.

  • Partner with data scientists to make improvements to our models for determining patterns in movement and/or traffic.

  • Mentor colleagues and participate in code and design reviews.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • 8-10+ years of backend and ML experience: Extensive hands-on experience showcasing expertise and a strong track record in the engineering field.

  • Technical knowledge: Extensive experience with Python, distributed processing pipelines (Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Dask), and very large datasets – statistical analysis, data quality control, optimizing storage.

  • Cloud proficiency: Extensive experience with cloud and infrastructure services, including, as well as deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud environments.

  • Operational excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement in your organization. Strong passion for clean code and robust architecture, with a drive to elevate engineering practices and design standards across the team.

  • Ownership & execution: Own the technical vision, lead the strategy and guide the team to execute towards building the future of our routing cost engine.

  • Customer focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf.

  • Growth mindset: Have the humility to accept mistakes, learn and grow from them.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

  

About the role

 

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse clients.

 

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working with clients, and cross-functional teams, you'll ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems.

  

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.

  • Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of ML systems.

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility and impact.

  • Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning at scale.

  • Acting as a technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts for stakeholders.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

  • You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.

  • You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.

  • You've worked with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, and common learning techniques.

  • You're an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve and delivery solutions

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)


#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Manager, Revenue Strategy & Operations, DACH
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll own the commercial operating backbone for Airwallex’s Germany and DACH business, turning performance data, territory planning, sales tooling and inbound optimisation into scalable revenue operations. You’ll partner closely with commercial leaders as their local strategy partner, providing weekly performance and forecasting support, running country QBRs and driving improvements across the business. You’ll lead go-to-market and expansion initiatives across EMEA, including product-market-fit assessment, product localisation, competitor analysis, win-rate analysis and vertical experimentation. You’ll align stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations, Compliance and Legal, while using AI-driven tools and automation to improve commercial workflows and reporting.

You’ll work from our Berlin office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years of experience, ideally combining top-tier strategy consulting and/or high-growth startup experience with meaningful time focused on commercial strategy or revenue operations.

  • Strong analytical skills, including data modelling and experience working with data reporting tools.

  • Experience owning processes end to end, building scalable systems and tooling, and maintaining high standards of data quality and hygiene.

  • A track record of driving tangible outcomes with a bias for action and a high level of personal accountability.

  • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to simplify and communicate complex problems clearly.

  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to speak, read, write and understand German and English at a native or near-native level.

  • Experience influencing without authority and building trust with senior stakeholders across functions and cultures.

Preferred

  • Experience in a high-growth fintech, financial services or technology environment.

  • Experience with complex, cross-functional commercial operations and scaling go-to-market processes.

  • An outstanding record of academic achievement.

  • Experience using AI-driven tools or automation to improve commercial workflows and reporting.

  • Experience leading product-market-fit assessment, product localisation, competitor analysis, win-rate analysis or vertical experimentation.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You like defining your own space rather than staying in one narrow lane.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You're low-ego. You care more about the right outcome than getting credit for it.

Learn more about your team

Most strategy roles hand you a slide deck. This one hands you the keys.

Strategy & Operations finds the next point of leverage in a hyper-growth fintech, then builds the system to capture it. We spot opportunities early, design how Airwallex scales into them, and turn that vision into the machinery that drives revenue across markets and products.

You'll get the kind of access most people wait a decade for: a direct line to the growth engine, work that spans every function, and the freedom to own ambiguous, high-stakes problems end to end.

And you won't do it the old way. We arm our people with AI to move faster than teams ten times our size, modeling, researching, and shipping at a pace that creates an unfair advantage.

If you want to do the best work of your career on problems that actually matter, build with us.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey. We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further. Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

Contentsquare is hiring a player-coach Solutions Consulting Manager to lead its France & Southern Europe team: about 5 Solution Consultants covering France, Spain, Portugal and Italy. You will spend roughly half your time leading and developing the team and half personally running the region's most strategic deals.

You will be the pre-sales business partner to regional Sales leaders across Enterprise and Mid-Market, for new business and growth in existing accounts. You will also lead the region's move to the Contentsquare Experience Platform (CSQ XP), for new customers and for the existing customer base.

You report to the Head of Solutions Consulting EMEA and sit on the EMEA Solutions Consulting leadership team. The role is based in Paris.


What you'll do

Own the regional pre-sales plan

  • Turn EMEA and global Solutions Consulting priorities into a clear regional plan: objectives, coverage model and operating rhythm

title: Market Data Analyst - Dry Bulk
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 700 experts from 35+ countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.


Your future position:

Kpler’s Dry Bulk business is expanding, and we are looking for a Market Data Analyst – Dry Bulk to take ownership of data quality and operational processes across assigned geographical regions and product groups.

While the position is internally known as Market Data Analyst - Metals & Minerals, its scope extends across a broader range of dry bulk commodities, including ferrous and non-ferrous metals, solid fuels, and industrial minerals.

This is a role for someone who wants to sit close to how global commodity markets actually move. You will combine strong SQL and Python skills with a curiosity about the real-world events shaping those movements - from shifting trade flows and supply chain disruptions to changes in industrial demand, policy, and pricing dynamics.

You won’t just be processing data. You will play a key role in turning complex, high-volume datasets into reliable market intelligence used by clients to understand what is happening in global physical markets. Your work will directly influence how accurately we reflect real-world commodity flows.


Your mission is to:

  • Take charge of specific regions and product groups, ensuring the highest standard of data quality by reviewing internal constraints, validating automated outputs, and ingesting data from diverse external sources.

  • Identify and implement technology and process improvements – including contributions to SQL queries, Python scripts, and pipeline tooling – to increase the efficiency and accuracy of our seaborne flow data.

  • Track news, trade flows, and industry developments across metals and minerals markets. Extract meaningful patterns and ensure they are well reflected in our data product.

  • Lead responses to ad-hoc client requests (email, video call, in-person) with rapid, well-structured analysis. Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to address client data needs and feed insights back into internal systems.

  • Engage proactively with the broader data architecture; understand how upstream data sources, internal systems, and client-facing solutions interact, and propose improvements that scale across the team.

  • Act as a knowledgeable and self-directed team member capable of picking up complex technical tasks independently and driving them to completion with minimal supervision.


    • You could be a match if you are or have:
  • Experience working with data products and complex datasets. You understand how data is collected, processed, validated, and delivered to end users. You can investigate data inconsistencies, identify root causes, and contribute to improving data quality, reliability, and the overall user experience.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, or similar) is a core requirement. You use both to query databases, analyse data, and automate workflows, building and maintaining scripts to remove manual processes and improve efficiency. Strong Excel skills are required for analysis and commercial reporting.

  • A genuine interest in physical commodity markets. You are curious about how global trade works in practice and how commodities move around the world. You want to understand the forces shaping supply and demand, trade flows, production, shipping, and pricing, as well as the economic, political, and industrial developments behind market movements. You actively seek to understand not only what is happening, but why it matters. We are looking for someone who can articulate what interests them about these markets and is motivated to deepen their knowledge over time.

  • Comfortable managing high-frequency datasets, identifying anomalies, and maintaining high standards of data quality under tight deadlines.

  • Strong communicator, able to translate complex technical outputs into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and build effective relationships across teams.

  • Proactive and self-directed: takes ownership, anticipates issues, and drives work independently to completion.

  • Experience supporting or mentoring junior colleagues, or a clear interest in developing others as the team grows would be highly adventagous.

    • Desirable:

  • Experience working with seaborne commodity data (e.g. AIS, port or vessel data).

  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Tableau or similar.

  • Extreme Ownership: Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt was zu tun ist. Wenn du eine Chance siehst, ergreifst du sie. Wenn Hindernisse kommen, überspringst du sie. Du gehst voran.

Über uns

Wir bauen das intelligente Rückgrat für die Wirtschaft von übermorgen.

title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures.

  • Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus.

  • Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme would be beneficial.

  • Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for landing gear systems on CS-23 aircraft program is a plus.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Mechatronic Engineer - Automation Test Equipment
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Working within the R&D department, you will create robust, scalable automation tools that support both product development and manufacturing operations. Your primary focus will be mechanical development for test automation, while also collaborating on software and electrical integration aspects of test systems.

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field.

descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een hbo-student Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare opleiding en wil je praktijkervaring opdoen binnen een professionele softwareontwikkelomgeving? Wil je meewerken aan een applicatie die door gemeenten wordt gebruikt voor het beheren van WOZ-gegevens? Dan is deze meewerkstage binnen het Scrumteam WOZ ABC iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen?

Als meewerkstagiair binnen het Scrumteam WOZ ABC (Afnemers, Bronhouders & Confrontatie) werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling, het onderhoud en het testen van functionaliteiten binnen Key2WOZ. De stage biedt volop ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen een professionele softwareontwikkelomgeving, waarbij werkzaamheden worden afgestemd op kennis, ervaring en leerdoelen. De focus ligt op actief meewerken en praktijkervaring opdoen binnen het scrumteam, niet op het uitvoeren van onderzoek of een afstudeeropdracht.

Omdat de stagiair volledig meedraait in het scrumteam en direct bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van onze WOZ-oplossingen, zoeken we een hbo- of wo-student met aantoonbare ervaring in softwareontwikkeling, opgedaan tijdens projecten, stages of een relevante bijbaan.

Je gaat onder andere:

  • Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling en het testen van software binnen Key2WOZ.

  • Meewerken aan reguliere werkzaamheden binnen de sprints.

  • Deelnemen aan Scrum-events, zoals stand-ups en sprintoverleggen.

  • Ontwikkelen en testen van functionaliteiten, passend bij de eigen kennis en leerdoelen.

Wij bieden:

  • Een leerzame meewerkstage binnen een professioneel softwareontwikkelteam

  • Een open en informele werksfeer binnen een internationaal team, waarin collega’s elkaar helpen en kennis met elkaar delen.

  • Een stagevergoeding van €550,- per maand op basis van een fulltime stage (40 uur per week)

  • Laptop van de zaak

Dit breng je mee:

  • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare studie

  • Je hebt al enige ervaring met .NET en/of C#, bijvoorbeeld vanuit je opleiding, projecten of een bijbaan

  • Je hebt interesse in softwareontwikkeling en agile werken

  • Je bent analytisch, leergierig en communicatief vaardig

  • Je werkt graag samen en vindt het leuk om actief bij te dragen aan een softwareproduct

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Wij zijn Centric, een IT-software en services bedrijf dat verweven zit in de Nederlandse Maatschappij. Vaak zie je ons logo niet op onze producten, maar ze worden gebruikt door o.a. gemeenten, grote retailers, banken en ziekenhuizen. Door bij ons te werken omring je jezelf met kansen. Kansen om impact te maken terwijl jij jezelf ontwikkelt! Geïnteresseerd? Neem vooral even contact op!

Ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan via de button. Heb je vragen? Dan kan je contact opnemen met onze Campus Recruiter, Nicolle, via of +316 10 63 99 27.

title: Meewerkstage Landschapsarchitectuur
descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Bouw mee aan een duurzame leefomgeving, met het landschap als stevig fundament voor wonen, werken en recreëren.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je maakt analyses, schetsen en visualisaties van landschappelijke projecten;

  • Je werkt mee aan ontwerpen voor straten, bouwblokken, woonwijken en openbare ruimte;

  • Je helpt bij visies voor gebieden waar wonen, werken en leven samenkomen;

  • Je werkt kaarten, rapportages en presentaties helder en zorgvuldig uit;

  • Je vertaalt ideeën naar beelden die collega’s en opdrachtgevers verder helpen.

In deze meewerkstage draag je bij aan projecten die de leefomgeving beter maken. Je werkt vanuit onze hub in ’s-Hertogenbosch samen met ontwerpers en adviseurs aan doordachte oplossingen voor stedelijke en landschappelijke vragen. Daarbij krijg je ruimte om jouw creativiteit, ruimtelijk inzicht en ontwerpvaardigheden in te zetten in integrale projecten. Van het ontwerpen van straten, bouwblokken en woonwijken tot het opstellen van grootschalige (gebieds)visies: jouw bijdrage maakt het verschil.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Voor deze vacature breng jij mee:

  • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van landschapsarchitectuur.

  • Je zoekt een meewerkstage van minimaal 15 weken.

  • Je hebt kennis van Adobe programma’s, AutoCAD en Sketchup

We zijn benieuwd naar wat je maakt, ontwerpt en bedenkt. Daarom ontvangen we graag een portfolio bij je sollicitatie.

Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomen we namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar verbinden met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren.
En ook als lid van Young Movares, onze jongerenvereniging, staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer, je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, en je krijgt volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en een goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je:


• Een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;
• Ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans;
• Leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Den Bosch.
En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook:
• Bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat;
• Lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s.

Jouw team bij Movares

Voor jou als meewerkstagiair(e) Landschap is er plek in team Stedenbouw en Landschap. Ons team werkt vanuit de hub 's-Hertogenbosch aan projecten die de kwaliteit van de leefomgeving verbeteren. We combineren creativiteit met technische kennis om integrale oplossingen te ontwerpen voor stedelijke en landschappelijke vraagstukken. Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team van ontwerpers en adviseurs, waarin intensief wordt samengewerkt met specialisten op het gebied van onder andere planologie, mobiliteit en ecologie. We zijn een hecht team waarin we op locatie samenwerken en elkaar helpen vanzelfsprekend is. Kortom, je komt in een omgeving waar vakinhoudelijke uitdaging en een fijne werksfeer hand in hand gaan. Samen zorgen we voor een toekomstbestendige en inspirerende leefomgeving.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

This may not be the right role for you if:

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

In this role, you will:

  • This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
