title: Mixed-signal IC Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design, integrate, and deliver high-performance digital subsystems within mixed-signal ICs, enabling control, calibration, and high-speed data movement in analog-centric environments — owning the flow from RTL to physical implementation and tape-out.

Responsibilities

  • Design and verify digital subsystems that interface directly with high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits — including calibration engines, control FSMs, data converters, and multiplexing logic.

  • Contribute to the design of analog components at the digital-analog interface: calibration circuits, DACs/ADCs, comparators, and others.

  • Integrate and customize external IP blocks (e.g., GPIOs, LVDS I/Os, serial interfaces), ensuring compliance with analog signal and timing requirements.

  • Lead the digital implementation flow for mixed-signal blocks: from RTL to synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, timing closure, physical signoff, and tape-out.

  • Collaborate closely with analog, layout, and system teams to co-optimize digital-analog boundaries, resolve cross-domain issues, and ensure robust high-speed performance.

  • Contribute to the development of high-speed serial I/O subsystems — experience in the design and implementation of SerDes blocks is a significant advantage.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in digital RTL design (Verilog/SystemVerilog), particularly for mixed-signal systems involving high-speed calibration/control loops, converters, multiplexers, and serial/parallel data paths.

  • Experience with analog IC development environments (Virtuoso or equivalent).

  • Deep understanding of digital-analog integration challenges, including timing closure, noise coupling, clock domain crossing, and analog-aware floorplanning in high-speed environments.

  • Proven ability to drive digital blocks from design through verification, synthesis, floorplanning, P&R, and tape-out, especially in the context of analog or RF ICs.

  • Skilled in integrating and adapting external IPs such as GPIOs, LVDS, SPI/I²C interfaces; experience with high-speed serializers/deserializers (SerDes) is a highly valued plus.

  • Proficient with industry-standard EDA toolchains for both front-end (design/verification) and back-end (physical implementation), with a strong grasp of mixed-signal layout constraints.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

descriptionHtml:
English version

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s'engager au sein d'une institution où la science et l'innovation construisent un avenir plus durable. C'est une école d'excellence où chacun a la possibilité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d'ingénieurs de France et reconnue à l'international, notre école, membre de l'Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en s'engageant activement face aux grands enjeux industriels, numériques et environnementaux. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 membres du personnel et 2 500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : allier excellence académique, recherche de pointe et impact sociétal positif.

L'Institut Mines-Télécom rassemble les plus grandes Écoles françaises pour relever les grands défis industriels, numériques, énergétiques et environnementaux. Avec ses huit Grandes Écoles publiques et ses deux Graduate Schools affiliées, il constitue le premier institut public dédié à la formation des ingénieurs et des managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable en formant les leaders qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Le département d'électronique flexible développe des connaissances technologiques et scientifiques dans le domaine de l'électronique souple. Le département dispose d'une solide expertise dans la caractérisation électrique et mécanique des matériaux et des interfaces. Ses activités sont regroupées au sein d'une plateforme de 660 m². Cette plateforme technologique rassemble des installations et des équipements technologiques dédiés aux activités de R&D en micropackaging, micro- et nano-électronique, au sein d'une salle blanche de 220 m² en classe 1000 et de 400 m² en classe 10 000.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire, le/la candidat(e) réalisera des innovations et des activités de recherche dans le domaine de l’électronique. Au sein du département d’électronique flexible (FEL) du Centre de Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), le/la candidat(e) combinera passion des science et désir d’impact sociétal.

Ce stage fait partie du projet de recherche Sens-CO qui met en partenariat l’Université Gustave Eiffel, l’Ecole polytechnique et l’Ecole des mines de Saint-Etienne. Ce projet vise à développer un capteur de gaz NOx et COx portable pour un monitoring environnemental en continu. La résistance interne du capteur varie avec la concentration de gaz mesurée. Le rôle du CMP est d’obtenir précisément la valeur de cette résistance à travers un circuit électronique et de permettre la corrélation avec la concentration en gaz ainsi que le traitement et l’envoi des données par communication sans contact. Ce circuit doit permettre une mesure portable et nécessite donc d’être réalisé sur un substrat flexible.

Le/la candidat(e) devra ainsi, à partir d’un design réalisé sur PCB rigide, transposer cette interface de capteur de gaz sur un substrat souple en tenant compte des enjeux liés à ces méthodes. Compte tenu de la grande valeur des résistances à mesurer, le PCB final devra permettre :

· Une mesure précise de grandes valeurs de résistance

· Un faible-bruit et résistance aux interférences électromagnétiques, en tenant compte de l’agencement des composants pour permettre de garantir une flexibilité maximale.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons :

Vous êtes actuellement en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur en spécialisation génie électrique, électronique, systèmes embarqués ou domaines associés.

Vous devez :

· Présenter un fort intérêt pour l’électronique, les systèmes embarqués et la fabrication (soudure, routage et réalisation de circuits électronique).

· Présenter une expérience avec les outils de conception de circuits électriques ainsi qu’en conception de PCB et qu’en compatibilité électromagnétique.

Une approche expérimentale et une connaissance de conception de circuits imprimés sont essentielles.


🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre les Mines de Saint-Etienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l'excellence, avec la conviction qu'ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c'est l'opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un cadre de travail accueillant et un solide réseau international (T.I.M.E., EULiST).

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle représentant 11 millions d'euros par an, principalement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique, La Rotonde, engagé depuis 25 ans dans la médiation scientifique et accueillant plus de 50 000 visiteurs par an.

  • Frais de transports en commun pris en charge à hauteur de 75% (sous conditions),

  • Foyer du personnel (activités sportives, culturelles, avantages CE sur des loisirs et temps de convivialité),

  • 1 jour de congé par mois (à poser sous réserve de l'accord du tuteur)

Opto-mechanical Engineer

This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: People Enablement Lead
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

Neko Health is scaling fast across Europe, and our People Enablement function needs to scale with it. As a People Enablement Lead, you'll own payroll and the employee lifecycle end to end for Sweden and Germany, including staying ahead of compliance and statutory updates as they land in either market.

You'll work hands-on inside our core People function, partnering closely with HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Rewards, and Finance. You'll operate inside our Trigger/Approve/Execute model: HRBPs trigger and approve people decisions, you execute them with speed, accuracy, and a clean audit trail. We want a problem solver and a doer: someone who takes ownership and drives initiative, not someone who waits to be told what to fix.

We're not just talking about AI in People, we're building it into how the work gets done. Everyone on the team is empowered to build their own artifacts, skills, and automations: a live payroll reconciliation tracker, a scheduled compliance check, a dashboard that answers a recurring question before it reaches the inbox. If you can see the manual work, you're expected to build the tool that removes it, not wait for someone else to.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

  • Own payroll and the employee lifecycle end to end for Sweden and Germany, coordinating with local providers on the published cutoff schedule.

  • Track and act on compliance and statutory updates across both markets before they become a problem.

  • Reconcile payroll inputs and outputs against Workday, catching discrepancies before payday, not after.

  • Own day-to-day administration of onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, and mobility cases across Sweden and Germany.

  • Coordinate right-to-work checks, relocation logistics, and entity/contract implications with HRBPs.

  • Execute approved Workday data changes, maintaining accurate records and a clean audit trail.

  • Build, document, and maintain scalable operating procedures and playbooks for Sweden and Germany, replacing manual workarounds with structured process that scales as Neko scales.

  • Build your own AI-powered tools and automations, trackers, checks, dashboards, to remove manual work in payroll, mobility, and Workday, and share them with the team.

  • Identify recurring queries and operational inefficiencies, and propose better ways of working, including where HRBP self-serve can take on routine data entry.

  • Contribute to the quarterly request-volume audit and SOX-relevant controls.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR Operations, or HR Administration in a fast-growing company.

  • Hands-on Swedish payroll and HR/employment operations experience, at L3 practitioner level.

  • Workday experience, essential to this role.

  • Working knowledge of the Employer of Record (EOR) market, including how EOR arrangements affect payroll processing and compliance ownership.

  • Strong knowledge of employment law and payroll practice, and confidence keeping that knowledge current as regulations change.

  • A European outlook: you think across markets, not just one.

  • A strong sense of ownership: you drive initiative rather than wait for direction, and build improvements that scale as Neko scales, not one-off fixes.

  • Exceptional attention to detail: you reconcile, double-check, and don't let things slip.

  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to create clear, repeatable operational procedures.

  • Curious about AI tools and comfortable experimenting with them to remove manual work, even without a technical background.

Nice to Have

  • Germany or other European market payroll/HR experience.

  • Experience with implementations or transformations.

  • Experience building agentic or automated workflows into People processes.

  • Comfortable building from scratch, without established process to lean on.

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on.

title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
descriptionHtml:
Prevention Analyst - Pentesting

About this role


We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next.

That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go.

This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on.

This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end.

What you will do

  • Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective.

  • Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect.

  • Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice.

  • Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact.

  • Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on.

  • Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together.

  • Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients.

What you will need

  • Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications.

  • The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why.

  • Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one.

  • The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy.

  • A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player.

  • Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel.

  • Fluent English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS.

  • A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience.

  • Experience working with SMEs or mid market customers on security topics.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission, protecting organisations across Europe from real world cyber threats.

  • Work with top tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • A remote friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats, for example in Spain, Portugal, or Italy.

  • Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

About Eye Security


Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organisations across Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally, having secured our Series C funding of 60 million.

We combine cutting edge technology with hands on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission, to make enterprise grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you will work on projects with an international footprint, solving real world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.

Key tasks and accountabilities

Build and ship

  • Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production
  • Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation
  • Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call
  • Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails

Shape direction

  • Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured
  • Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit
  • Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used

Architecture and design

  • Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity
  • Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin
  • Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs

Spread what works

  • Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding

Ways of working

  • Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes
  • Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires

Skills & Expertise

AI-native engineering

  • Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace
  • Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows
  • Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release
  • Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails
  • Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders
  • Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do

Engineering foundations

  • Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating
  • Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)
  • Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores
  • Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry
  • Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible

Ways of building

  • Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop
  • Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

Soft skills

  • Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets
  • Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value
  • Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer
  • Clear communicator: explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person
  • Influences without authority: gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated
Our Offer
  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
  • Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
  • Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
  • Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

About the Role

As a Product Designer at Kpler, you will play a key role in shaping how global decision-makers interact with complex energy, maritime, and commodity trade intelligence. Working within a collaborative cross-functional product squad, you will craft intuitive end-to-end user journeys, turn intricate data workflows into elegant interfaces, and champion design quality across our web and terminal platforms. Leveraging Figma and our design system, your work will directly empower thousands of analysts and traders around the world to extract instant, actionable insights.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive product experiences: Conceptualize, prototype, and deliver user-centered design solutions in Figma for new product capabilities and core workflow enhancements.

  • Translate complex data into clear interfaces: Distill intricate data flows, geospatial mapping tools, and market analytics into simple, human-centric user interfaces.

  • Evolve and leverage our design system: Adhere to and contribute to Kpler’s shared design system (Atlas) to maintain visual consistency, component quality, and usability standards.

  • Craft 3–6 month product design visions: Partner with Product Managers and Engineering leads to define user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes for upcoming product milestones.

  • Validate designs through research and feedback: Gather user feedback, analyze interaction patterns, and iterate rapidly to refine interaction details, micro-copy, and edge-case behaviors.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work seamlessly with engineers and product stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure design intent and quality are preserved in production.


    • Experience & Background
    What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • Product design experience: 2–4 years of professional experience as a Product Designer crafting web applications, complex dashboards, or data-intensive B2B software products.

  • Figma proficiency: Advanced mastery of Figma, including auto-layout, interactive components, design tokens, responsive layout rules, and prototyping best practices.

  • End-to-end UX/UI craft: Demonstrated ability to drive design projects from discovery and user flow mapping through to pixel-perfect visual design and developer handoff.

  • Problem-solving mindset: Strong knack for simplifying dense, multi-step workflows into clear, frictionless user journeys.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English to articulate design rationale and align with product and engineering peers.

    • Nice-to-haves

  • Data-dense or B2B platforms: Experience designing interfaces for SaaS, analytics, financial terminals, supply chain, or maritime tools.

  • Design system contributions: Prior experience maintaining or scaling a shared component library in a multi-team environment.

descriptionHtml:
Product Engineering Intern (m/w/d) mit Option auf Übernahme

Wir bauen das KI-native ERP-System für Sanitär-, Heizungs- und Klimabetriebe (SHK). Unsere Pre-Seed-Runde ist abgeschlossen. Seit dem Go-Live haben wir 10+ Kunden für uns gewonnen. Für die nächste Phase suchen wir eine Person für das Product Engineering im Praktikum.

Du arbeitest eng mit dem Gründerteam und übernimmst von Beginn an echte Verantwortung in einer Rolle, die du selbst mitgestaltest.

Aufgaben

  • Du baust Produktfeatures von Anfang bis Ende. Vom konkreten Kundenproblem über den ersten Prototyp bis zum ausgerollten Feature verantwortest du den gesamten Weg.

  • Du entwickelst die KI-Agenten und Automatisierungen, die unser Betriebssystem antreiben. Du baust die Systeme, mit denen wir wiederkehrende Abläufe bei unseren Kunden zuverlässig automatisieren.

  • Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Produktentscheidungen. Du bist nah an den Nutzern, verstehst ihre Arbeitsabläufe im Detail und leitest daraus ab, was wir als Nächstes bauen.

  • Du integrierst dich tief in die Branche. Wir bauen kein generisches SaaS, sondern verzahnen das Produkt eng mit den realen Abläufen unserer Kunden. Dieselbe Tiefe erwarten wir in deinem technischen Verständnis dieser Abläufe.

Qualifikation

  • Du studierst (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, ein vergleichbares Fach oder hast einen entsprechenden Abschluss. Du denkst strukturiert und lieferst trotzdem schnell.

  • Du kannst bauen. Du hast bereits eigene Projekte umgesetzt oder Praktikumserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt und bringst Dinge zuverlässig zum Laufen.

  • Du nutzt moderne KI-Werkzeuge, um schnell und in hoher Qualität zu entwickeln.

  • Du fühlst dich im direkten Kontakt mit unseren Kunden wohl. Du kannst technische Themen verständlich erklären und Feedback aus Gesprächen in konkrete Verbesserungen übersetzen.

  • Du sprichst sehr gutes Deutsch, da unsere Kunden ausschließlich auf Deutsch arbeiten.

  • Du suchst Ownership und großen Gestaltungsspielraum statt eng definierter Vorgaben.

Benefits

  • Die Möglichkeit, nach dem Praktikum in Vollzeit übernommen zu werden.

  • Eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Bei einer Übernahme in Vollzeit kommen Equity Options dazu, denn du baust das Unternehmen mit auf und wirst entsprechend daran beteiligt.

  • Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche gemeinsam im Office in Berlin.

  • Eine direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau eines Produkts und Teams aus der ersten Reihe mitzugestalten.

title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Location: This role is based at our Geneva, Switzerland office, with the option to work two days a week remotely.
Travel: Up to 10%
Job ID: 1771

The Role: 

As a Product Manager within the Quantum Platform – Devices division, you will play a key role in supporting a growing portfolio of cutting-edge products by taking ownership of day-to-day product operations. You will ensure product features are clearly defined, tracked throughout every stage of the product lifecycle and delivered successfully across cross-functional teams. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing, you will translate market and customer insights into product features for refinement by engineering teams, while leading the triage, planning and coordination of special customer projects. You will help optimise product lifecycle processes, ensuring efficient collaboration, smooth feature delivery and successful execution from concept through to launch.
    • Own product operations, ensuring features are defined, tracked throughout the product lifecycle and delivered across cross-functional teams.
    • Translate market and customer insights into product features, while triaging, planning and coordinating special customer projects.
    • Partner with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production and Marketing to optimise product lifecycle processes and drive efficient product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

You will take ownership of the operational delivery of product management, ensuring products and features progress efficiently from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation. Acting as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, you will drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate delivery across multiple teams to ensure products are launched on time and to a high standard. This role is integral to enabling the Product team to scale effectively, providing operational ownership and supporting the successful delivery of an expanding product portfolio.
    • Own the operational delivery of product management, ensuring features progress from validated requirements through development, industrialisation and commercialisation.
    • Drive cross-functional alignment, maintain product data integrity and coordinate timely delivery across the product lifecycle.
    • Act as the day-to-day product decision-maker within defined boundaries, enabling the Product team to scale beyond a single Product Manager.

What you'll bring:

In this role, you will take ownership of feature delivery from end to end, defining requirements and acceptance criteria, coordinating engineering handovers, validating delivery and supporting successful commercial launches. You will manage non-standard sales opportunities by assessing feasibility, making configuration decisions within agreed boundaries and documenting exceptions, while ensuring full traceability from customer requests through to delivered capability. Working closely with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, you will coordinate cross-functional activities to remove blockers, maintain an accurate and prioritised Jira backlog, and respond to product enquiries from Sales. You will also prepare products for launch through documentation, training, pricing and sales enablement, maintain up-to-date product documentation, communicate complex photonic, cryogenic and networking architectures to a range of stakeholders, and represent the product in customer-facing activities including pre-sales support, technical discussions and trade shows.
    • Own end-to-end feature delivery, from requirements definition and engineering handover through to delivery validation, commercial launch and ongoing product documentation.
    • Coordinate cross-functionally with Engineering, Industrialisation, Production, Marketing and Sales, while managing Jira backlog integrity, product enquiries and non-standard sales opportunities.
    • Support successful product adoption by communicating complex technical architectures, ensuring launch readiness, providing pre-sales support and representing the product in customer discussions and at trade shows.

You'll be a great fit with:

The ideal candidate will hold a Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, combined with an action-oriented mindset and the confidence to make decisions in an environment of uncertainty. You will be able to understand and reason about complex hardware products involving photonics, cryogenics and networking technologies, while communicating effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders. You will be comfortable representing products in customer-facing situations, including technical discussions, pre-sales meetings and trade shows, and have a strong understanding of manufacturing environments, including industrialisation constraints, production realities and supply chain considerations. You will also be confident resolving conflicting priorities, negotiating with stakeholders and developing deep expertise in quantum technologies, supported by advanced Jira proficiency, including workflow configuration, automation rules and custom field management.
    • Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Microengineering or a related technical discipline, with the ability to make product decisions autonomously within defined boundaries.
    • Strong technical, commercial and customer-facing communication skills, with experience discussing complex hardware products and representing products in pre-sales meetings and trade shows.
    • Advanced Jira expertise, manufacturing and industrialisation knowledge, excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, and a genuine curiosity for deep-tech and quantum technologies.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.
 
We are committed to equity and justice. title: Product Manager II - Financial Crime Operations
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Compliance Operations teams, including the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), investigations and enhanced due diligence, are the front line of how Kraken detects and responds to financial crime. The systems they run on sit within Core Services Product, alongside the engineering teams who build them. That covers alert ingestion, case management, investigator tooling and a growing set of automation and AI tools.

This role owns the product for that investigation platform. That means how an alert is created, enriched, grouped and suppressed. How it becomes a case. How an investigator reaches and documents a decision. And how every step is evidenced to a regulator or auditor. You'll start with the FIU, where the workflows are most complex and the audit bar is highest, then extend the platform across Compliance Operations.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the investigation-platform roadmap end to end. Sequence it and defend it, and re-sequence it when a regulator or the RCO raises a P0.

  • Define "done" before build starts. Write phased deliverables and acceptance criteria that Compliance signs off, and hold the line when scope moves.

  • Get requirements in before engineering starts. Build the intake between Compliance policy, monitoring rules and case management so that changes don't reach investigators before their workflows are ready.

  • Understand the process before building. Reconcile policy and SOPs against what investigators actually do and what the system actually does. Know the difference between a process fix and a technical one, and say which requests are in scope for engineering.

  • Understand the pipeline well enough to challenge it: ingestion, profile and transaction resolution, suppression and grouping logic, and reconciliation between vendor output and case management. Be able to walk an auditor through it with live examples.

  • Make auditability a first-class requirement: audit trail, data lineage, evidence retention, reviewer attribution, change-management controls, and validation of filtering and suppression logic.

  • Ship automation and AI into regulated workflows with controls that hold up in Compliance, IT and privacy audits. That means human-in-the-loop design, explainability and ongoing monitoring.

  • Run the operating rhythm: a shared forum with engineering and adjacent product managers, a regular stakeholder update, and one delivery status that everyone reads the same way.

 

What you bring

  • 4+ years of product management, including 2+ years on financial-crime systems such as transaction monitoring, investigations, case management, KYC/EDD or sanctions screening.

  • Working knowledge of how an AML programme is examined, including the questions regulators, internal audit and model validation ask about monitoring, filing and control systems.

  • The technical fluency to go deep on data flows and system design with engineers, and to spot when a design won't meet the requirement.

  • A track record of shipping internal tools or operational platforms that measurably changed how an operations team works.

  • Clear, concise writing, from PRDs and phase plans to audit walkthroughs and executive updates.

  • The judgement to tell a senior stakeholder a timeline isn't realistic because the requirements aren't written yet, and to keep the relationship intact.

  

Nice to haves

  • Direct FIU experience, such as alert disposition, SAR/STR filing or leading investigators.

  • Crypto or digital-asset experience, such as blockchain analytics, wallet-level transaction analysis or focal vs counterparty logic.

  • Experience shipping AI or ML into a regulated investigative workflow, including the control design.

  • Build-vs-buy and vendor evaluation for monitoring or case-management tooling.

  • Experience with programmes that span jurisdictions (UK, EU/MiCA, US).

   

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Buying and selling a car should feel like one seamless motion for a dealer, not two separate systems. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual.

For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less.

This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. This team sits across our ambitions to make car changing a seamless journey, this role's job is the handover itself: the operational moment between buying and being ready to sell again. This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Dealers are already asking for smarter scheduling, less manual chasing, and tools that reduce the overhead of running a business. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise. If you want to own an operational product area end to end, work with some of the most sophisticated buyers in UK retail, and build things that have a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Own the product direction for Carwow's dealer-facing product, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with dealers, interviews, on-site visits, data analysis to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into dealer workflows: smarter recommendations, vehicle pricing, performance insights that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with Tech Lead, Designer, and Engineers to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness prioritising work that drives engagement, retention, and revenue, not just activity

  • Partner Engagement & Insight:

    • Build relationships with key dealer partners and use those relationships to validate product direction before we build

    • Work with Account Management and Sales to understand what's driving churn, what's blocking adoption, and what would make carwow stickier

    • Translate qualitative partner feedback into structured product insight; don't just collect opinions, turn them into decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team on partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 1.5+ years of product management experience in a B2B or SaaS environment, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, you follow what's happening, you have a point of view on where it adds real value, and you're eager to experiment

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve

  • Strong stakeholder instincts, you can build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, and senior stakeholders without losing your own point of view

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace, or dealer-facing products

  • Familiarity with gamification or engagement loop design in a B2B context

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

  • Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call (30 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min)

  • Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

title: Product Manager - Security
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Security Product Manager to join our team. Security Product Manager is responsible for conveying the company’s security strengths to customers, partners and the market at large. This includes participating in relevant security partnership initiatives, influencing security positioning and branding, and working closely with internal teams to ensure company’s security posture and security products is communicated effectively to all stakeholders. By combining expertise in compliance requirements with a customer-centric approach, Security Product Manager helps position security as a competitive advantage rather than just an internal obligation. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

1. Product Management 

  • Define the vision and roadmap for Nebius’ security products. 
  • Owning the ideation, postmortem, prioritization, backlog, and customer feedback processes. 
  • Guiding new features, systems and services from inception to launch, while keeping customers at the center of everything. 

2. Customer-facing communications 

  • Lead public-facing communications around security updates or changes in compliance status. 
  • In the event of a security incident, coordinate user messaging (email notifications, press releases, FAQs) with support from the Head of Security Products and CISO. 
  • Gather user feedback on user experience and security to guide continuous improvements. 

 3. Competitive analysis and market research 

  • Conduct ongoing research on industry benchmarks, emerging security standards and technologies, and competitor certifications. 
  • Identify gaps and opportunities in organization’s product security posture; propose strategic initiatives that differentiate the company’s security story in the market. 
  • Stay informed about new regulations or frameworks that may influence future product certifications or transparency requirements (e.g., privacy laws, data sovereignty standards). 

 4. Certification and audit support, service ownership 

  • Collaborate with the CISO office to gather technical evidence or make necessary product enhancements that satisfy certification requirements. 
  • Take ownership of some security-related services of Cloud platform. 
  • Track and maintain a certification roadmap (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPPA, etc.), working closely with CISO, GRC & Compliance, Corporate Security departments. Communicate timelines, goals and status updates to leadership and sales representatives. 

5. Cross-functional collaboration 

  • Coordinate with multiple Product Managers to align security goals with other product roadmaps, ensuring a consistent narrative between product security and external messaging. 
  • Work with Platform Security, GRC & Corporate Security and legal teams to gather essential information for security products enhancements (e.g., penetration test summaries, compliance reports). 
  • Work with Customer-facing teams to address client inquiries about security posture and guide them on using security features optimally. 

We expect you to have: 

  • 3+ years of Product Management or Program Management experience with a focus on security initiatives. 
  • Basic knowledge of compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) and familiarity with how they translate into business value. 
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear, customer-friendly manner (e.g., writing content, speaking at webinars or conferences). 
  • Stakeholder management skills to align with other Product Managers, CISO staff, engineering, marketing, and customer-facing teams. 
  • Analytical mindset: comfortable defining success metrics (e.g., security feature adoption, NPS around trust, certification progress) and making data-driven decisions. 
  • Project management skills: demonstrated ability to manage inter-team collaboration within company-wide projects, ensuring timely delivery of cross-functional tasks and alignment with compliance goals. 

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  •  Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or PMP; prior experience in regulated industries; prior experience working for Cloud Service Provider.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training. 

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).  

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East. 

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius AI cloud – from hardware to UI – to be built in-house, distictly differentiating Nebius AI from the majority of specialized clouds: Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners. We’re growing and expanding our products every day. 

If you’re up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Product Marketing & Growth Manager – 6-month contract (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
About Pysae

Pysae is a French SaaS company building real-time fleet supervision (AVM / SAEIV) and workforce management software for public transport operators. Bus networks, coach operators and transport authorities in France and across Europe rely on our platform every day to run their services, inform passengers and manage their drivers. We are a team of around 40 people based in Rennes, Paris and Italy, and we are expanding fast internationally.

Pysae has grown from a set of products into a full platform. We now need someone to tell that story, put it in front of the right people, and turn it into growth.

The role

Reporting to our Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will own product marketing and growth: generating demand through the product itself and by showcasing the value of the Pysae platform.

This is an international role. You will work on France, Italy and our new markets across Europe and beyond, with sales teams and customers in several countries and languages.

This is not a classic marketing job. Our market (public transport operators and authorities) has long been sold to in the same way: tenders, trade shows and long sales cycles. We want to break that pattern. Your mission is to invent, test and deploy new ways of selling and growing, using the product, content, data and AI as levers. You will have a blank page, direct access to the CRO and the founders, and the freedom to try things that have never been done in our industry.

It is a very exciting position, and a demanding one: you will need to come up with ideas, prove quickly whether they work, drop what doesn't and scale what does.

Your missions

Invent new sales & growth methods

  • Imagine new ways to reach, engage and convert transport operators and authorities, beyond the traditional tender-driven playbook

  • Design and run fast experiments (new channels, formats, offers, outreach sequences, product-led motions), measure the results and turn the winners into repeatable playbooks for the sales team

  • Bring fresh ideas from other industries and from the latest AI and growth practices, and adapt them to our market

Product marketing & positioning

  • Sharpen the positioning and messaging of the Pysae platform and its modules for each segment (urban networks, interurban and school transport, on-demand transport, rail) and each country

  • Turn product releases into launches: release notes, feature pages, demo videos, customer-facing announcements

  • Build sales enablement material with the sales team, in French and English: pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, battlecards, ROI arguments

International growth

  • Support our expansion into new countries: market-entry campaigns, localised messaging and content, lead generation for our international sales team

  • Design and run product-led growth initiatives: onboarding, in-app messaging, feature adoption, upsell and cross-sell across our customer base

  • Create and run campaigns (LinkedIn, email, webinars, international trade shows, content) that generate qualified pipeline for the sales team

  • Produce creative content that showcases the platform and our customers: case studies, articles, videos, social posts

  • Track and report on what works (traffic, leads, conversion, adoption) and double down on it

AI & automation

  • Use AI tools intensively to create and translate content, personalise outreach, analyse data and run campaigns at scale

  • Automate as many marketing and sales workflows as possible (CRM, emailing, reporting, content production), and document them so they keep running after your contract

Practical details

  • Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract (CDD)

  • Location: Paris, Rennes or Florence

  • Languages: French and English required

  • Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer

  • Start date: as soon as possible


  • Fluent French and English (both required), written and spoken; Italian or another European language is a plus

  • Business or marketing school degree, ideally a Master's (business school or equivalent)

  • A first experience (internships included) in product marketing, growth or digital marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS and/or in an international environment

  • A truly creative mindset: you love inventing new approaches, you are not afraid of a blank page, and you would rather test a bold idea than copy a playbook

  • An entrepreneurial, hands-on attitude: you turn ideas into experiments quickly, learn from failures and keep going

  • An international mindset: you enjoy working across countries and cultures, and adapting your message to each market

  • A strong AI user: you already use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Notion AI, Make/Zapier or similar to work faster, and you are curious about what comes next

  • Data-driven: you measure, test and iterate

  • Autonomous, organised and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving scale-up

  • An interest in mobility, public transport or tech for the public good is a plus

Product Owner

Amsterdam - Lijkt het jou interessant om als product owner aan een applicatie voor miljoenen gebruikers te werken waarbij je grote invloed hebt op de architectuur en technische ontwikkelingen? Lees dan snel verder!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Product Owner bij Reclamefolder.nl ben je de operationele rechterhand van de Product Manager en zorg je ervoor dat het productteam altijd weet wat er gebouwd moet worden, waarom dat belangrijk is en hoe succes wordt gemeten. Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Daarmee lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat 872000 unieke bezoekers per maand ontvangt. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Dit doe je onder andere door:

  • Productkeuzes en inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek te vertalen naar goed uitgewerkte features met heldere user stories, acceptatiecriteria, edge cases en meetpunten.

  • Refinements voor te bereiden, de backlog actueel en overzichtelijk te houden en ervoor te zorgen dat web-, iOS-, Android- en backendteams altijd vooruit kunnen werken.

  • Het eerste aanspreekpunt te zijn voor developers, UX en de Tech Lead bij functionele vragen en binnen de gestelde kaders zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen over scope en uitwerking.

  • De scope tijdens development te bewaken, functionele validaties voor te bereiden met testscenario's en acceptatiechecks en opgeleverde features te controleren op iOS, Android en web.

  • Verzoeken van DPG Media, sales en andere interne stakeholders te analyseren, samen te werken met de UX'er en data-analist aan de juiste KPI's en meetpunten en advies te geven over prioritering.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Reclamefolder.nl. Wij geloven dat het mogelijk is om mensen te helpen besparen op hun dagelijkse uitgaven. Onze website en apps ontvangen wij maandelijks 875000 unieke gebruikers en onze ambitie reikt verder. We bevinden ons midden in een transformatie waarin de digitale folder volledig wordt vernieuwd en het platform opnieuw wordt opgebouwd.

Reclamefolder.nl heeft een ondernemende cultuur met ongeveer 25 collega's binnen IT, marketing en sales. Hoewel we onderdeel zijn van DPG Media, opereren we zelfstandig. Hierdoor heb je veel invloed op de productontwikkeling en bedrijfsvoering, terwijl je tegelijkertijd profiteert van de kennis en expertise van een grote mediaorganisatie.

Je werkt in een multidisciplinair productteam bestaande uit een Product Manager, webdeveloper, iOS-developer, Android-developer, backenddevelopers, een UX'er, een data-analist en een Tech Lead. In deze rol geef je de Product Manager ruimte om zich te richten op discovery, strategie en klantcontact, terwijl jij zorgt voor een backlog met features die klaar zijn om ontwikkeld te worden.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?

  • 2 jaar ervaring als Product Owner

  • Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal en ervaring met het werken in multidisciplinaire productteams.

  • Ervaring met het zelfstandig uitwerken van backlog-items voor een digitaal product en samenwerking met developers, bijvoorbeeld als Product Owner, Business Analyst of in een vergelijkbare rol.

  • Ervaring met het schrijven van duidelijke user stories en acceptatiecriteria die zonder aanvullende toelichting door ontwikkelaars kunnen worden opgepakt.

  • Het vermogen om stakeholderverzoeken te vertalen naar een helder probleem met een duidelijke scope en prioriteit, waarbij je waar nodig duidelijke keuzes maakt.

Pré
