  • Ervaring binnen retail media, advertising, e-commerce of marketplaces.

  • Basiskennis van tracking en analytics, zoals events, funnels en dashboards.

  • Ervaring met het opstellen van een meetplan voor nieuwe features.

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier!

Wat krijg je van ons?

Bij ons krijg je een inspirerende werkomgeving die continu in beweging is. Collega’s die denken in mogelijkheden, het glas halfvol zien en we geven jou de kans je dagelijks te ontwikkelen. Dit doen we onder andere door onze DPG Academy. Dit geeft jou alle mogelijkheid het beste uit jezelf te halen en een echte mediamaker te zijn!

Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken

Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl, Tweakers, Libelle, VTM en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen. We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega’s te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquizteam of een sportteam is.

title: Product Owner Gemeentepas
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.

In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.

Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

  • Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

  • Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

  • Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

  • Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

  • Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

  • Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

  • Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

  • Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Hier starten jouw kansen
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners.

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Wil jij bouwen aan het verschil? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature Product Owner Gemeentepas. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

title: Public Sector Partnerships Lead - France
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs' public sector business across France. The Public Sector Partnerships Lead will identify and build relationships with government institutions across France, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs' products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. The role also involves building strategic partnerships with policymakers, industry associations, and coalitions, as well as monitoring regulatory developments and supporting policy campaigns and impact initiatives.

In this role, you will:

Drive government adoption and revenue (primary)

  • Identify government partnership opportunities across France — from healthcare and education to transport, public banks, and other state-owned enterprises — and bridge the gap between government institutions and the GTM team to drive adoption and deployment of ElevenLabs' products.

  • Build and maintain a wide network of relationships across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs — not limited to regulatory or policy counterparts.

  • Promote government adoption of ElevenLabs products and services in partnership with the GTM team.

Build strategic partnerships (secondary)

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, industry associations, and civil society groups.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at conferences and industry events, advancing the company's public policy goals.

Monitor and advise on policy (tertiary)

  • Lead ElevenLabs engagement with government bodies and officials across France, with a focus on AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and/or digital rights.

  • Monitor, analyze, and advise on emerging regulations impacting the company — including EU-level developments given France's influence in shaping EU AI policy.

  • Support the development of internal policies by our Legal, Safety, Security, and other teams.

  • Provide strategic counsel to company leadership on regional policy trends and their business implications.

  • Define and implement policy campaigns and impact initiatives that advance company objectives.

Who you are:

  • You're genuinely interested in the future of AI and emerging technologies, bringing curiosity and enthusiasm to your role.

  • You stay up-to-date on AI regulation and industry trends, and are eager to apply this expertise to cutting-edge products.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment, working cross-functionally with teams across the organization to support and scale a growing business.

  • You're comfortable working independently and handling ambiguity, excelling in situations where you must make informed decisions quickly.

  • You bring a proactive, solution-oriented approach to each project, focused on moving the business forward.

What you bring:

Primary requirements

  • 10+ years' experience in public and private sector (in-house, firm) roles, with a track record of building relationships with government that led to commercial or technology-adoption outcomes — not solely policy or regulatory roles.

  • A wide, current network of contacts across French government institutions — spanning ministries, agencies, établissements publics, and SOEs, including in healthcare, education, and transport. Prior government or grands corps experience is a plus but not required if network breadth is strong.

  • Experience identifying and opening doors for technology partnerships with government institutions is strongly preferred.

  • Contacts or experience navigating EU institutions or other major European markets is a plus.

Also required

  • Strong knowledge of the French and EU AI policy landscape, including general AI governance, safety, copyright, privacy, transparency, data protection, competition, and digital rights.

  • Demonstrated success in designing, advocating for, and influencing policy outcomes, as well as coalition building.

  • Public policy experience across France.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including when briefing government officials and other policymakers.

  • Fluency in English and French.

Location

This role is located in France.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

descriptionHtml:

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

What you'll do
  • Design and maintain IREG-based test campaigns for roaming partners, network changes and service launches across Data, Voice and SMS.
  • Manage the test SIM and eSIM fleet, remote test probes, campaign configuration, scheduling, execution, reporting and coverage history.
  • Build repeatable test pipelines, integrate smoke and regression suites into CI/CD, and provide clear release gates; so that core network changes and Steering of Roaming adjustments never quietly break the existing footprint.
  • Define the KPIs, baselines and thresholds that tell us the service is healthy. Correlate synthetic test results with production KPIs and real customer journeys, and turn what you find into alerts and runbooks the Operations team can act on.
  • Design and run the tests that show our geo-redundancy behaves as designed, i.e. site failover and failback, Diameter and GTP path recovery, session survival, data consistency after a switch; and verify that our core platforms deliver the capacity they were dimensioned for, under sustained load and under signalling bursts.
  • Analyse PCAP, MAP/SS7, Diameter, GTP and DNS traces alongside monitoring data to isolate failures, support root cause analysis, validate fixes and strengthen regression coverage.

    • What you'll bring
  • You've worked in telecom QA, network testing, service assurance or roaming validation.
  • You know how LTE/EPC fits together. Give you a registration or session flow and you'll find where it broke.
  • Wireshark is where you go first, not last.
  • You write your own automation in Python or something close, and you keep regression suites running in CI/CD.

  • Experience at a roaming hub, IPX provider, mobile operator or MVNO, including partner interoperability testing.

  • Working knowledge of GSMA roaming procedures and documents, including IR.21, IR.24, IR.35, IR.38 and IR.92.

title: Chief Information Security Officer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team
  • Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
  • Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

title: Growth Acquisition Operator (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Glow25!

At Glow25, we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty.

For our continued growth, we're looking for people with substance: reliable, motivated, and genuinely invested in building something meaningful together. At Glow25, you'll find ambitious goals and an environment that fosters ownership and values performance—regardless of which role you take on.

We look forward to getting to know you.

These are our current challenges and future goals:

Five years ago, Glow25 started from zero. Today we are one of Europe's fastest-growing collagen brands, built to a large extent on Meta and Paid Social, and our international business keeps growing. We want to get more out of every channel and every market, and we never want to become boring while doing it.

To do that, we are looking for a hands-on Growth Acquisition Operator who works alongside our existing teams. New-customer acquisition is the heart of this role: with Meta and Paid Social at the core, the role steers all channels, decides where our goals sit and where the next euro is best spent, and builds complete funnels and advertorials across several countries. We are looking for a clear track record of growing a channel largely alone, paired with fresh ideas and the joy of working with colleagues who know Glow25 well.

This is an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving it together with the teams is not just welcome, it is encouraged.


This is where we need your support:

  • Paid Social Ownership: Deep hands-on expertise in Meta and Paid Social as the engine for new-customer acquisition and brand building, with real budget responsibility.

  • Cross-Channel Steering: The ability to steer Meta, Google, Native and new channels as one system, setting clear goals per channel and deciding where the next euro performs best.

  • Full-Funnel Building and Localization: Hands-on skill in setting up complete funnels yourself, from hooks, offers and advertorials to landing pages, checkout and the post-click experience, with a feel for what works in different markets, shown in localized offers, funnels and creative rather than copied campaigns.

  • Creative Testing and Fresh Impulses: Experience in running creative testing as a system, with concepts, scripts, formats, creators and fast iteration together with our creative team, driven by the curiosity to question the status quo and bring new ideas, formats and channels that keep Glow25 from ever getting boring.

  • Analytics and AI Workflows: A sharp, analytical mindset that connects channel results to contribution margin, new-customer payback, cohort quality and incrementality, paired with the talent to build AI workflows and agents that make testing, decisions and reporting faster.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Strong teamwork with Product, Creative, E-Commerce, Analytics and Retention, sharing learnings so the teams get faster too.

You have the following experience:

  • Personally grown a paid channel, ideally Meta or Paid Social, plus Google, Native or similar, in D2C, ideally in a high-repeat category such as supplements, beauty or food, with a clear before, after, timeframe and own contribution.

  • Experience in new-customer acquisition at scale, including building full funnels and advertorials from scratch, with the ability to explain the hypothesis, the failure and what changed the result.

  • Largely autonomous way of working, for example as an agency operator, founder or the senior performance person in a lean setup.

  • A working AI tool, agent or automation for marketing built in the last 12 months, shown rather than just described as a vendor stack.

  • Ease with unit economics such as contribution margin, payback and incrementality. A strongly analytical profile is a welcome bonus, but not a must.

  • A collaborative style: clear explanations of decisions and openness in sharing learnings. Fluent English; German is a plus.

That's something you can look forward to:

  • Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.

  • Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.

  • Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.

  • Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.

  • Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.

  • Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.

  • Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!

  • Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.

  • Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.

  • Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.

  • Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.

  • Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

Yay! You've made it this far!

But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

title: GTM Enablement - Product
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring our first Product Enablement specialist. You will join the Product & Technical Enablement team and help our go-to-market teams get ready for every product launch, across Agents, APIs, and Creative.

You will support our global go-to-market teams. Your mission: help sellers understand, demo, and sell each new launch with confidence, with preparation that starts well before launch day.

What sets this role apart: we’re looking for someone who knows our products well enough to demo them and sell them. You have used agents, APIs, or creative tools hands-on, and you can explain how they work and why they matter to customers. You blend that with sales, solutions engineering, or product marketing experience, so you can teach sellers how to use a product, how to demo it, and how to pitch it.

This role sits within GTM Enablement and reports to the Product & Technical Enablement Lead. You will work in close partnership with:

  • Product marketing and engineering teams (keeping content accurate as the platform ships)

  • GTM enablement (aligning on shared onboarding infrastructure)

You will support product enablement for our go-to-market teams across Agents, APIs, and Creative, with the most day-to-day focus on API and Creative launches. This is a full-stack role on a lean team: you’ll build content, deliver training, design practice environments, and flex across products as needed.

What you’ll do

  • Support new product launches: get an early heads-up from product marketing, research, and engineering, follow releases from alpha through GA, and have training ready before launch day, not the week of

  • Build launch workshops: go beyond what shipped and why it matters, with hands-on workshops on how to use the product, how to demo it, and how to pitch the value

  • Support competitive enablement: turn product marketing battlecards into trainings, simulations, and demo workshops, so sellers can answer parity, differentiation, and value questions with confidence

  • Support product certification: help define what “product certified” means for GTM teams, and build the playbooks and training content that raise product confidence across the whole field, not only new hires

  • Support everboarding and onboarding: keep training tied to new releases and capabilities, and keep content current as products ship

  • Craft realistic practice environments: demo certifications, role-play scenarios, and customer simulations with scored feedback, built on our own agent technology

  • Operate AI-natively: use ElevenLabs’ own voice and agent technology to build training and practice environments; default to AI tools to build faster, and teach others to do the same

  • Measure what matters: define and track the percent of sellers certified within 2 weeks of GA, demo and pitch quality scores, and win rate and stage progression against named competitors, and use the data to improve each launch

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who knows our products well and can teach sellers to demo and sell them. You’ll thrive here if you:

  • Have 4-7+ years as an enterprise seller or solutions engineer, or as a seller who moved into product marketing or enablement, at a SaaS, platform, or API-first company

  • Are hands-on with agents, APIs, or creative tools, and understand at a conceptual level how they work

  • Have demoed and pitched technical products to customers, and can explain the value, not only the features

  • Have a track record of teaching, mentoring, or building training, in addition to your customer-facing work

  • Are comfortable building a program from scratch, with no playbook to inherit

  • Have credibility with sellers, built from time in the seat or supporting sellers directly, and work well with product marketing, research, and engineering teams

  • Communicate clearly and can adapt product material for different audiences without diluting it

Bonus

  • Experience at a high-growth AI/ML, developer tools, or API-first company

  • Background in voice AI, conversational AI, or contact center technology

  • Vertical depth in financial services, healthcare, telecom or CCaaS, or at other AI companies

  • Hands-on experience with competing voice and agent platforms

  • Experience running workshops or labs for sellers or customers

  • Experience building role-play, simulation, or demo practice environments

Location

Remote-first, globally distributed role. Expect occasional travel to team hubs and onboarding sessions. Candidates should be able to work effectively across US and European time zones.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: iOS Developer
descriptionHtml:
At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an iOS Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an iOS Developer, you will help us build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role

As iOS Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and optimize our iOS applications using Swift, with a focus on performance, reliability and user experience.

  • Contribute to application architecture, technical design and the continued development of our modular codebase.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical solutions early.

  • Create intuitive user interfaces and experiences tailored to iOS devices.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, review code and help colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

  • Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including SwiftUI, and assess how they can improve our applications.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as an iOS or mobile developer.

  • You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment.

  • You have experience writing unit tests and/or UI tests for mobile applications.

  • You understand object-oriented software design and architectural patterns such as MVVM.

  • You have experience with web services, cloud technologies and APIs, and are comfortable debugging issues involving memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. title: Principal Security Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Principal Security Software Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As a Principal Security Software Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on technical leader, driving the design and development of the security foundations of our AI cloud, including identity and access, secrets and key management, tenant isolation, and policy enforcement across the control plane and network and data plane.

You’ll set the standard for security engineering excellence, working closely with other principal engineers to align on strategy and drive technical leadership. You’ll partner with Engineering and Product teams to build security into every layer of the stack, and mentor engineers across multiple squads. You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping security direction, design decisions, and cross-team collaboration.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for security systems and platform capabilities, and lead their design and implementation.

  • Design and build core security services across IAM, RBAC, workload identity, secrets, encryption and key management, audit logging, network controls, and policy enforcement.

  • Translate product, customer, and regulatory requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with the Security Product Manager.

  • Drive automation of policy enforcement, configuration hardening, detection, remediation, and software supply chain security.

  • Ensure strong tenant isolation and least-privilege access across the control plane and network and data plane.

  • Act as a senior technical voice in enterprise customer security reviews, audits, and incident response.

  • Raise the security engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, code review, and technical standards.

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with significant depth in cloud and network security, IAM, or security infrastructure.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Identity & access: IAM, RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, federation, mTLS, workload and service identity

  • Security controls: applied cryptography, encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, KMS/HSM, key rotation, policy engines

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes internals, containers and runtime isolation, cloud networking, compute, storage

  • Security operations: audit logging pipelines, detection engineering, vulnerability management, incident response

  • Automation: policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD security, software supply chain (signing, SBOMs, provenance)

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Vault/OpenBao, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kubernetes admission control and security tooling, Sigstore, SIEM platforms, cloud KMS, or similar.

  • Deep understanding of multi-tenancy, least privilege, zero-trust architecture, threat modelling, and shared-responsibility models.

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001, and how they translate into technical controls.

  • Able to balance security, performance, reliability, operational complexity, and developer experience.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What You Bring

  • Security mindset: Think like an attacker and design systems that fail safely, without making them painful to use.

  • Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems that are hard to change once built.

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how controls interact across the full cloud platform, from network and infrastructure up to APIs and user experience.

  • Ownership: Drive security capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Exercise → Final.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.


In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.


This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.



What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Location: UK / Europe

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on technical contributor, driving the design and development of our most critical systems, including our GPU orchestration layer, inference-serving infrastructure, and core platform APIs.

You’ll set the standard for engineering excellence across the team, working closely with other principal engineers to align on strategy and drive technical leadership. You’ll partner with peers in infrastructure and machine learning to deliver high-performance AI systems, and mentor engineers across multiple squads. While you won’t have direct reports, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping engineering direction, design decisions, and cross-team collaboration.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Build systems for your team's part of the platform, from provisioning and cluster management to telemetry, ML training and serving, networking, storage, and security.

  • Implement secure, reliable APIs (gRPC/REST) and backend systems

  • Design and develop Kubernetes Operators to manage compute and networking resources

  • Improve performance, resilience, and efficiency, including how workloads use GPUs, storage, and networks.

  • Translate customer and product requirements into clear technical designs.

  • Own the reliability of the services you build

  • Work with Product Managers to understand how our customers run AI workloads on our platform.

  • Contribute to design and code review across the team.

Your Profile

  • Solid experience building and running production software, ideally distributed systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in Go or similar.

  • Depth in at least one of our team areas: infrastructure and cluster management, observability, ML training or serving, networking, storage, or security.

  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes internals: operators, deployments and reconciliation loops.

  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying distributed systems and APIs (gRPC, REST) in production environments

  • Understanding of GPU infrastructure and multi-tenant cloud platforms, and how they behave at scale.

  • Comfortable working in Linux and with Kubernetes and containers.

  • Clear communicator who takes ownership of their work.

What You Bring

  • Domain depth: Bring real expertise in your team's area, and keep building it.

  • Engineering quality: Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and review others' work with care.

  • Ownership: Take features from design through production, and stay accountable for how they run.

  • Pragmatism: Ship what matters, simply, and improve it from real-world feedback.

  • Collaboration: Work openly with product, infrastructure, SRE and customers, and share what you learn.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two engineers) → Final.

title: Research Engineer - Cybersecurity (RL Environments)
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely.

The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists.

Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios.

  • Build the pipelines and infrastructure that generate synthetic cybersecurity training instances at scale — thousands of scenarios, not one hand-crafted exercise.

  • Conduct experiments and evaluations of model capabilities on these environments, from quick prototypes to controlled benchmark runs.

  • Own the infrastructure behind the environments: containers, sandboxes, VMs, cloud deployments, and orchestration (Kubernetes), all managed as code.

  • Partner with researchers and security specialists across Mistral, distilling their domain expertise into reproducible environments and datasets.

  • Write clear, efficient code in Python and enforce strong software-design practices: testing, code review, CI/CD.

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on expertise in offensive and/or defensive cybersecurity: vulnerability analysis, web/network/cloud security, secure coding practices, and SOC.

  • Strong software engineering skills: clean, reliable, well-tested code — not just exploit scripts.

  • Fluency in Python plus comfort reading lower-level languages (C/C++) for vulnerability analysis.

  • DevOps experience: Docker, Kubernetes, cloud deployments, sandboxed or simulated environments.

  • A pragmatic research-to-engineering mindset: ship a working first version, then refine and scale it.

  • Working knowledge of RL techniques and LLM training methodologies, or strong motivation to develop it.

  • Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative — comfortable working across research and engineering.

Nice-to-haves

  • CTF, cyber-range, or bug-bounty experience — as a player, challenge author, or platform builder.

  • A research background in cybersecurity, academic or industrial, or in another experimental discipline.

  • Prior experience building RL environments or large-scale ML training infrastructure.

  • Relevant open-source contributions and projects.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

title: Research Scientist: Post-Training
descriptionHtml:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role

You will build the base intelligence layer for robotics, training large-scale force-aware foundation models to unlock dextrous manipulation, generalizing across tasks and environments.

  • Design and execute large-scale pre-training runs for robot foundation models, defining the architectures, objectives, and training curricula that push AI-driven manipulation beyond pixels to actions.

  • Own experiments end-to-end, from data specification through training to real-robot evaluation, to understand scaling laws, data quality effects, and architecture tradeoffs.

  • Build data mixes and evaluation sets to train and assess robots on novel, high-precision tasks, across real-world and simulated settings.

  • Research methods for improving sample efficiency and robustness, ensuring learned policies generalize reliably from training to real-world deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience developing large-scale predictive or generative models - including RSSM-style, JEPA, transformer, or diffusion/flow-based architectures.

  • Strong probability, statistics, and ML fundamentals, paired with the ability to design rigorous experiments and separate real signal from noise or bugs in experimental data.

  • PhD or equivalent research experience with a proven record of research accomplishments in machine learning, computer vision, data-science, robotics and other related fields

  • Strong fundamentals in ML computing frameworks like PyTorch or JAX, with familiarity in optimizing for performance and efficiency at scale.

  • Motivated to see general-purpose robotic intelligence deployed in the real world.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Prior experience working with real robot hardware

  • Led or made significant contributions to multi-node, multi-GPU distributed training efforts.

  • Experience designing or scaling data collection, annotation and mixing pipelines

  • Track record of open-source contributions or released models/datasets.

  • Publications at top robotics or ML venues (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

title: SAP Koordinator (m/w/d) – Schnittstellen, Berechtigungen & Dienstleistersteuerung
descriptionHtml:
Sie kennen SAP aus dem laufenden Betrieb, bis in Tabellen, Logs und Transporte?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit stabilen Systemen tragen.

Warum diese Rolle?

Das SAP-System läuft auf ECC 6.0, ist über Jahre gewachsen und soll auf S/4HANA umgestellt werden. Die Basis betreibt ein externer Dienstleister, in den Fachbereichen entsteht ein Key-User-Konzept. Gesucht wird die Person, die das Ganze technisch zusammenhält.

• Weil Sie die Verantwortung für ein SAP-Backend tragen, das zuverlässig läuft.

• Weil Sie den Weg von ECC zu S/4HANA von Anfang an begleiten.

• Weil Sie Zuständigkeiten klären und Strukturen schaffen, die bleiben.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie behalten Hintergrundjobs, IDoc-Verarbeitung, RFC-Verbindungen, EDI-Strecken und angebundene Drittsysteme im Blick. Fehler analysieren Sie über Dumps, Logs und Traces und verfolgen sie bis zur Lösung.

• Sie koordinieren den Basis-Dienstleister bei Upgrades, Patches und Performance-Themen, später auch beim Wechsel auf S/4HANA, und fordern Ergebnisse ein.

• Sie prüfen Anforderungen und legen fest, ob Sie selbst umsetzen, den Dienstleister beauftragen oder die Aufgabe an den Fachbereich geben.

• Sie unterstützen die Fachbereiche beim Aufbau ihrer Key-User-Rollen.

• Sie erledigen selbst Benutzer und Rollen, SAPscript- und Smartforms-Anpassungen, Jobeinplanung, Systemnachrichten und kleinere technische Änderungen.

• Sie halten Systemlandschaft und Abläufe schriftlich fest, sodass Wissen im Unternehmen bleibt.

Zur Einordnung: Installation, Datenbank und Betriebssystem verantwortet der Basis-Dienstleister. Sie steuern ihn und sind die Ansprechperson für alles im SAP-Umfeld, wofür es noch keine klare Zuständigkeit gibt.

Das bringen Sie mit

• Eine IT-nahe oder kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium

• Mehrere Jahre SAP-Erfahrung im Inhouse-Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit ECC 6.0

• Technischen Tiefgang: Sie lesen Dumps und Traces, kennen Jobs, Transporte und Tabellen und sprechen mit dem Basis-Dienstleister auf Augenhöhe

• Praxis mit IDocs, RFC und EDI sowie mit Rollen und Berechtigungen (PFCG, SU53)

• Erfahrung in Projekten und in der Steuerung externer Partner, dazu Ausdauer beim Nachhaken

• Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

• Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Middleware und erste Berührungspunkte mit S/4HANA

Das erwartet Sie

• Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung

Interesse?

Wenn Sie sich in dieser Rolle wiederfinden, senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.
