title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials.

  • Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations.

  • Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure.

  • Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment.

  • Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team.

  • Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams.

  • Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them.

  • Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions.

  • Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates.

  • Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes.

  • Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures.

  • Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result.

  • Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor.

  • Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection.

  • Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners.

  • Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science & Engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in materials engineering, preferably in aerospace, battery systems, or other safety-critical industries.

  • Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and ceramics.

  • Proven ability to select the best material for a given application, based on data and first principles.

  • Experience with material characterization methods such as mechanical testing, DSC, TGA, DMA, cone calorimetry, and microscopy.

  • Experience planning tests, interpreting results, and correlating them with design requirements.

  • Strong knowledge of thermoset and thermoplastic composites, adhesives, and elastomers.

  • Knowledge of high-temperature material performance and fire, smoke, and toxicity behaviour is desirable.

  • Experience leading technical work with material suppliers.

  • Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, and CMH-17 is beneficial.

  • Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical curiosity, and attention to detail.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. German is a plus.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Senior Modelling and Simulation Engineer
department: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Undersea Dominance - Engineering & Operations
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

At Anduril Australia we are developing un-crewed maritime and air domain systems that leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require Senior Modelling and Simulation Engineers with deep experience with platform simulation. The Senior Modelling and Simulation Engineer strives to leverage their experience to support the rapid design, delivery, support, and evolution of next generation autonomous vehicles through the entire product life-cycle.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead the design, development, integration and support of next-generation modeling and simulation architecture that enables the continuous delivery of capability orders of magnitude faster than the competition
  • Act as the subject matter expert for design and implementation of engineering level simulation of Anduril platforms, including physical interaction with the environment, as well as platform, system, subsystem, component and device level models.
  • Simulate solutions for Guidance, Navigation and Control algorithm and Vehicle Management System component implementations.
  • Collaborate with vendors and/or customers to integrate external models within the Anduril engineering simulation architecture.
  • Create models and test and simulation fixtures that operate with both software- and hardware-in-the-loop
  • Contribute to the design and development of other software systems and sub-systems
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of robotic software, including full lifecycle testing
  • Support vehicle manufacturing and deployment
  • Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary software team, including as a mentor for Software Engineers from differing backgrounds

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience
  • Extensive experience with platform physics based modelling and simulation.
  • Experience writing C, C++ or Python
  • Systems and/or application programming skills including algorithms, data structures, concurrency and optimization
  • Capacity to work holistically on software enabled capabilities up and down the software stack and through lifecycle through design, implementation, operation and sustainment
  • Capacity to act as the technical owner for a software service, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution
  • Capacity learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in a senior role for the simulation and delivery of a robotic system, particularly in the air, maritime or space domains
  • Experience with flight dynamics and platform physics and control
  • Experience with MATLAB and Simulink
  • Familiarity with communications busses and protocols such as CAN, CANFD, ARINC-825, ARINC-429, MIL-STD-1553, UART/RS232/RS422/RS485, SPI, QSPI, I2C, Ethernet, etc
  • Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.
  • Familiarity with System Engineering concepts
  • Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Senior Software Engineer, such as Principal Software Engineer and/or Engineering Manager
  • Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

title: Senior Partnership Manager Payments
descriptionHtml:
Opleiding: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met een achtergrond in bedrijfskunde, economie, finance, commerciële economie of vergelijkbaar.
Ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships of business development.
Kennis: Van card schemes, issuing, acquiring en de werking van het internationale betalingsverkeer.
Persoonlijkheid: Je bent communicatief sterk, organisatiesensitief, zelfstandig en overtuigend op senior niveau.
Salaris: € 7.000,- en € 8.000,- p/m.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

Elke dag checken 6,5 miljoen Nederlanders in om te reizen met het OV. Met de OV-chipkaart, OV-pas, betaalpas, creditcard of mobiel. En dat werkt simpel en soepel. Kaart voor de lezer en … ‘bliep’. Reizen maar! Maar achter die ‘bliep’ gaat een complexe wereld schuil. Welkom in de wereld van Translink!

Met de introductie van nieuwe betaalmogelijkheden onder de vlag OVpay is Translink dichter komen te staan bij de bredere financiële sector. In- en uitchecken met de bankpas vereist goede afstemming met banken. Maar ook de bredere inzet van EMV-technologie met OVpay maakt dat we als bedrijf te maken hebben met bestaande card schemes.

Als Senior Partnership Manager Payments - Card Schemes & Banken, ben jij het externe gezicht van Translink binnen het paymentecosysteem. Je onderhoudt strategische relaties met onder andere Visa, Mastercard, banken en andere belangrijke partijen in het betalingsverkeer. Je begrijpt hun belangen en ontwikkelingen en weet deze te verbinden met de ambities van Translink en OVpay.

Je beweegt je gemakkelijk op senior niveau en voert gesprekken met zowel inhoudelijke experts als directies en bestuurders. Daarbij begrijp je niet alleen de commerciële kant van partnerships, maar ook hoe de paymentketen inhoudelijk werkt. Je weet wat ontwikkelingen binnen issuing, acquiring en card schemes betekenen voor Translink en kunt deze vertalen naar concrete keuzes en afspraken.

Intern werk je nauw samen met onder andere Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations en IT. Daarnaast vorm je samen met collega’s die zich meer richten op ontwikkeling en data een sterk team: jij richt je primair op de externe relaties en strategische partnerships.

Waar ga je dagelijks mee aan de slag:

  • Je bouwt en onderhoudt strategische relaties met Visa, Mastercard, Nederlandse banken, issuers en andere relevante partijen binnen payments.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor externe stakeholders en vertegenwoordigt Translink in strategische en inhoudelijke gesprekken.

  • Je ontwikkelt een duidelijke partnershipstrategie en meerjarige agenda voor de samenwerking met card schemes en banken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer, scheme rules en marktstandaarden en vertaalt deze naar impact en concrete acties voor Translink.

  • Je voert inhoudelijke en commerciële onderhandelingen over voorwaarden, kosten, dienstverlening en gezamenlijke verbeterinitiatieven.

  • Je verbindt externe marktontwikkelingen met interne technische, financiële en datagedreven inzichten.

  • Je adviseert management en directie over kansen, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en ontwikkelingen binnen het paymentecosysteem.

  • Je zorgt voor afstemming tussen Product, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, IT en externe partners bij complexe trajecten rondom payments en scheme compliance.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere professionalisering en mogelijke organisatorische ontwikkeling van de paymentactiviteiten binnen Translink.


WIE ZOEKEN WE?

We zoeken een ervaren paymentprofessional die zijn of haar sporen in de sector heeft verdiend. Je begrijpt hoe banken, issuers, acquirers en card schemes met elkaar samenwerken en weet wat er nodig is om binnen dat complexe speelveld duurzame partnerships op te bouwen.

Je voelt je comfortabel aan tafel met senior stakeholders en bestuurders. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen helder uitleggen en weet de vertaalslag te maken tussen de buitenwereld en de interne organisatie. Tegelijkertijd ben je pragmatisch. Je bouwt niet alleen relaties, maar zorgt ook dat afspraken daadwerkelijk leiden tot resultaat.

Voor een ervaren professional biedt deze rol bovendien iets bijzonders: je werkt aan een maatschappelijk relevant betalingssysteem dat dagelijks door miljoenen reizigers wordt gebruikt.

WAT ZIT ERIN JOUW TAS?

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen payments, banking, fintech, strategic partnerships, business development of relatiemanagement.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met partijen zoals card schemes, banken, issuers, acquirers, paymentnetwerken of andere organisaties binnen het betalingsverkeer.

  • Je hebt kennis van onderwerpen zoals scheme rules, scheme economics, fees, incentives en ontwikkelingen binnen het internationale betalingsverkeer.

  • Je bent gewend om complexe relaties en onderhandelingen op senior niveau te voeren.

  • Je kunt marktontwikkelingen, financiële belangen en inhoudelijke vraagstukken vertalen naar heldere voorstellen en concrete resultaten.

  • Je communiceert overtuigend met zowel inhoudelijke experts als senior management en externe bestuurders.

  • Je bent organisatiesensitief, analytisch en zelfstandig en weet mensen mee te krijgen zonder formele hiërarchie.

  • Je beheerst zowel het Nederlands als het Engels uitstekend.

WAT BIEDT TRANSLINK JOU?

Translink is een leuke, uitdagende werkplek. We werken in een dynamische, veelzijdige omgeving met een hoog ontwikkeltempo. Samenwerken, Wendbaarheid en Zelfregie zijn onze kernwaarden en dat proef je op de werkvloer.

Translink biedt een prettige kantooromgeving met fijne werkplekken. Onze werksfeer is informeel, open en behulpzaam. Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn aantrekkelijk. Vrij bewegen is ons motto. Je kunt in goed overleg hybride werken en we bieden bewegingsruimte om balans aan te brengen tussen je werk- en privéleven. Zo kun je met onze thuiswerkregeling ook thuis een fijne werkplek inrichten.

title: Senior Photonics Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at significantly reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards real-world deployment, you’ll have genuine ownership of your area, working alongside a highly technical team of physicists, engineers and software specialists on one of the hardest problems in AI infrastructure.

Job Overview

This role will focus on the design, optimisation, and development of high performance photonic components for next generation Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), contributing directly to our future tape-outs and core IP roadmap.

You will work closely with photonics designers, layout engineers, and testing teams to improve the performance of integrated photonic devices through theoretical analysis, simulation, modelling, and design innovation.

This is a highly technical role suited to someone who enjoys solving difficult physics and engineering problems in a collaborative deep-tech environment. You will take a lead role in the development of key building blocks within our optical switching and photonic systems roadmap, and other integrated photonic components critical to future high port count architectures.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the design and optimisation of integrated photonic components for silicon photonics and related PIC platforms

  • Perform electromagnetic simulations, modelling, and theoretical analysis to improve device performance

  • Validate simulation results against experimental measurement data

  • Develop innovative component designs informed by current research and emerging techniques

  • Collaborate with layout engineers to integrate components into PDK libraries and tape-out flows

  • Work closely with fabrication and testing teams to iterate on device performance

  • Lead the development roadmap for future photonic components and architectures

  • Drive long term improvements in PIC loss, manufacturability, and scalability

  • Lead technical discussions, design reviews, and cross functional problem solving

  • Mentor and guide other engineers in photonic design and simulation practice

  • Stay current with advances in integrated photonics through research literature and conferences

What we’re looking for

  • PhD, or equivalent industry experience, in Photonics, Physics, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

  • Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in integrated photonic device design, including taking designs through to tape-out and measurement

  • Strong theoretical understanding of guided optics and photonic device physics

  • Hands-on experience designing and simulating integrated photonic components

  • Experience working with silicon photonics or InP photonic platforms

  • Strong analytical and mathematical problem solving capability

  • A track record of meaningful technical contributions, whether through publications, patents, or shipped technology

  • Experience using photonic simulation tools and modelling workflows

  • Python programming experience for simulation, analysis, or automation

  • Deep understanding of Photonic IC design and fabrication flows

  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes

  • Experience working in commercial R&D or product development environments

  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers

  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams

You will join a highly ambitious deep-tech company operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and photonics. We are building foundational technology with the potential to reshape the performance envelope of future AI systems.

Alongside a collaborative and research-driven environment, you will have the opportunity to work on genuinely difficult engineering problems with direct impact on product direction and company growth.

If you’re excited by integrated photonics, advanced device design, and solving hard engineering problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Engineer

 

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

About the Role

This is a Senior Product Engineer role in Fleek's product engineering team, working across the stack. You'll report into our CTO, Sanket Agarwal (ex-Google, Postmates), and work embedded with a product manager and designer in a small, senior squad focused on the core marketplace experience.

Why This Role Stands Out

Fleek is digitising an industry that has never had technology. There are no existing playbooks for building an ecommerce experience around secondhand fashion at wholesale scale, where every item is unique, inventory is unpredictable, quality is graded by AI, and the supply chain spans three continents. You will be designing how the transaction layer works for a market that hasn't existed before.

You will be on our Growth team, owning the ecommerce journey from discovery to checkout, payment and credit systems, order management, and seller tools. Your systems will handle 500,000+ items a month today and million+ by the end of the year.

AI is at the core of everything we do, so you'll work closely with our data and AI teams to build the product features and services that connect FleekSort's classification engine to the marketplace experience.

We're looking for a product engineer who can think about how systems affect buyers and sellers at scale. You'll be expected to understand the business problems your code solves, and challenge whether we're solving the right ones.

What Makes You a Fleek Product Engineer?

  • Product-Obsessed Builder: You think about what the seller sees when their inventory goes live, or why a buyer drops off at checkout. You instinctively connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: We're building systems for workflows that didn't exist before Fleek. You thrive when the problem is undefined and collaboration is key.

  • Customer-Focused Thinker: You understand the dynamics of customer platforms and can understand how technical choices affect customers and our broader marketplace.

  • Owner, Not Renter: You take a feature from problem definition to production and monitor it afterwards.

  • Startup Pace: You've worked in environments where shipping matters more than perfection, where you deploy daily, and where velocity is a competitive advantage.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Ecommerce Journey: Design and build the features and systems powering Fleek's core marketplace, across frontend and backend, from item discovery and search through to checkout, payment, and post-purchase. These are product features that directly drive GMV.

  • Integrate AI into the Product: Build the features and services that connect FleekSort's AI classification engine to the marketplace experience, ensuring grading, pricing, and categorisation flow seamlessly into listings, search, and buyer workflows.

  • Design for Scale: Architect systems that handle 500K+ items per month today, with a clear path to millions. Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed of delivery and long-term scalability.

  • Shape Technical Direction: Contribute to architectural decisions across the stack. Challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and help define engineering standards for a fast-growing team.

  • Mentor and Elevate: Support the growth of more junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. Help raise the technical bar across the team.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work embedded with your product manager and designer to define what gets built. Partner with data, AI, and operations teams to turn complex real-world logistics into reliable, scalable software.

What You Bring

  • A track record of shipping product: You've built and owned user-facing features end to end, at a marketplace, fintech or consumer company; we care more about what you've shipped than how many years it took.

  • You start from the user: You talk to buyers and sellers, watch where they get stuck, and can explain why what you're building matters to the person using it.

  • You think like a PM: You shape the problem as well as the solution, push back when something doesn't feel right, and tie your work to GMV, conversion or retention.

  • You ship fast and learn: You'd rather put a working version in front of users this week than a perfect one next quarter, and you're used to deploying daily.

  • You measure what you build: You define success before you start and use data, user feedback and experiments to decide what to build next.

  • You build AI-native: You use AI tools every day to move faster, and you've shipped features on LLMs or ML models, with evals to know they work.

  • You work across the stack: You're strong in TypeScript and Node.js and comfortable enough on the frontend and in the data layer to ship a feature end to end, whichever way you lean.

  • You have sound judgement: You make sensible trade-offs between speed and scale, think about failure modes in systems that move real money, and know when good enough is good enough.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketplace dynamics: two-sided platforms, pricing, trust, supply-demand matching

  • Familiarity with international systems and distributed teams across multiple time zones

A genuine excitement for building something from scratch in a category that didn't exist three years ago.

This Role Isn't for You If You Want:

  • Narrow, siloed ownership where you only touch one service and never see the user

  • Detailed specs handed to you before you start, we define problems together

  • A slow-moving, highly structured environment with long release cycles

  • Fully remote work, this team is on-site in London 3-4 days per week

  • Pure infrastructure or platform work with no product exposure

Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ, Commercial St, E1 (Liverpool St / Aldgate East)

  • Work model: On-site

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan

  • Stack: TypeScript and Node.js across frontend and backend, AI/ML integration

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

What's In It for You?

Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for a $350 billion market that has never been digitised. Joining now means you'll be part of the team that defines how the secondhand economy works, at scale, globally.

Why people join Fleek

  • The problem is real: 9 million items saved from landfill since 2022. Your work has tangible, measurable impact.

  • The AI is genuinely novel: FleekSort is an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, turning an opaque manual trade into a structured global inventory layer. This isn't a GPT wrapper.

  • The growth is exceptional: Tripling year-on-year, ~$50M raised, Series B closed. Backed by a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, with advisors from Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

  • The timing is perfect: The secondhand market is projected to reach $350B by 2027. EU regulation is mandating the infrastructure Fleek builds. You're catching a wave.

  • You'll have real ownership: 100-person company, no bureaucracy. You'll shape decisions and see the impact of your work immediately.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines.

In deze sleutelrol duik jij in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers. Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk, staat dicht bij de klant en verdiept je in de stappen en randvoorwaarden voor hun productieproces. Door regelmatig klanten in binnen- en buitenland te bezoeken, krijg je scherp inzicht in de productieprocessen, knelpunten en kansen voor optimalisatie. Hierbij doorgrond je welke stappen bepalend zijn, welke beperkingen een limitatie vormen en waar liggen kansen om slimmer te werken? Deze inzichten vertaal je naar generieke, herbruikbare product-capabilities die in verschillende processen waarde toevoegen – van 3D-modeling tot machinebewegingen. Vervolgens werk je initiatieven uit tot concrete productrequirements waarmee Product Owners aan de slag kunnen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met multidisciplinaire teams om te zorgen dat software, processen en machines naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. In deze rol houd je continu grip op de voortgang, kwaliteit en impact van LogicSteel-oplossingen, en stuur je waar nodig bij om het beste resultaat te behalen.

Maar dat is nog niet alles. Als Product Manager LogicSteel bewaak jij de samenhang binnen het platform. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en product-capabilities goed worden vastgelegd en gecommuniceerd, zodat Product Owners, engineering en consultancy vanuit hetzelfde beeld werken. Je communiceert helder over de gemaakte keuzes, stemt af met betrokken teams en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een samenhangend LogicSteel-platform. Daarnaast draag je actief bij aan productintroducties en de doorontwikkeling van onze software-oplossingen.

Samenvattend bestaan jouw verantwoordelijkheden uit het:

  • doorgronden en structureren van complexe productieprocessen bij staalverwerkende organisaties;

  • bezoeken van (internationale) klanten om processen te begrijpen en nieuwe kansen te identificeren;

  • vertalen van pijnpunten en klanbehoeften naar generieke herbruikbare product-capabilities, van 3D modeling tot machinebewegingen;

  • identificeren waar vergelijkbare capabilities in verschillende processen kunnen worden toegepast;

  • bepalen welke functionaliteiten en innovaties worden ontwikkeld;

  • opstellen van een helder werkpakket met productrequirements voor de Product Owners en het bewaken van de voortgang;

  • intensief samenwerken met Product Owners, Engineers en Consultants om software, processen en machines optimaal op elkaar te laten aansluiten;

  • bewaken van de samenhang binnen LogicSteel en het consistent vastleggen van klantprocessen, knelpunten en capabilities;

  • bijdragen aan succesvolle productintroducties en doorontwikkeling.

Wat maakt deze functie zo bijzonder?

“Je bent een ondernemer binnen onze onderneming”, aldus collega Luc. Jij verdiept je in de productieprocessen van staalbouwers en ontdekt waar complexe stappen, beperkingen en afhankelijkheden om slimme oplossingen vragen. Je weet die processen te doorgronden en te vertalen naar herbruikbare capabilities die niet alleen één klant helpen, maar binnen het gehele LogicSteel-platform van waarde zijn. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende disciplines en bouw je dagelijks aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen!

Warm en professioneel bad

Bij ons werk je niet zomaar voor een bedrijf, maar voor een familiebedrijf waar mensen centraal staan. Je merkt het in alles: de korte lijnen, de betrokkenheid en de ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen. Ondernemerschap zit in het DNA van de organisatie. Heb je een goed idee? Dan krijg je de vrijheid en het vertrouwen om dit verder te brengen en écht impact te maken.

Daarnaast kennen we elkaar, nemen we verantwoordelijkheid en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Dat zie je terug in de manier waarop we samenwerken: teams trekken veel met elkaar op, denken over domeinen heen en zoeken actief de verbinding. Die open en ondersteunende houding zorgt niet alleen voor sterke resultaten, maar ook voor een werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis voelt. Zoals een collega het mooi zegt: “Doordat we er voor elkaar zijn, kunnen we kwaliteit leveren én zorgen we voor een prettige werksfeer – met ruimte voor een gezonde dosis humor en gezelligheid.”

Tegelijkertijd is er veel aandacht voor jouw persoonlijke groei. We kijken naar talent, potentie en kwaliteit, en bieden ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en stappen te zetten. Of zoals collega Luc het verwoordt: “Ik ben als stagiaire begonnen en heb de kans gekregen om door te groeien tot eindverantwoordelijke voor de business unit LogicSteel. Kortom, binnen ons bedrijf is veel mogelijk.”

Wij vragen

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Industrial Engineering & Management / Technische Bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Software Engineering, Business IT & Management of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Het vermogen om complexe (productie)processen te ontrafelen, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken;

  • Een sterk abstractievermogen en het talent om generieke capabilities te herkennen die ook in andere processen bruikbaar zijn;

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en het vermogen om processen en afhankelijkheden te vertalen naar heldere, concrete productrequirements;

  • Het vermogen om de samenhang tussen verschillende onderdelen van een softwareplatform te overzien en te bewaken;

  • Het talent om overzicht te behouden omtrent de productontwikkeling;

  • Het vermogen om helder af te stemmen, intern draagvlak te creëren en effectief samen te werken met Product Owners, engineers en consultants;

  • Kennis van productieprocessen in de staalbouw, werkvoorbereiding en/of calculatie is een sterke pre;

  • Een nieuwsgierige, proactieve mindset en de drive om complexe processen steeds slimmer in te richten;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal;

Wij bieden

  • Een brutosalaris tussen €5.301 en €7.460 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 40 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Flexibele werktijden voor een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze commerciële productstrategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

  • Ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven binnen een ambitieus team;

  • Dagelijks een heerlijke lunch in bedrijfsrestaurant Steely’s;

  • Uitstekende doorgroeimogelijkheden en ontwikkelkansen.

Ben jij dé Senior Product Manager MRP die we zoeken? Solliciteer dan nu en bouw mee aan onze producten! title: Senior Product Manager - Product Led Growth- Nantes (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Product team at Doctolib.

Your mission: scale Doctolib's acquisition engine into a measurable, lower-cost growth driver across France, Germany and Italy. You will own the end-to-end product-led and marketing-led growth funnel, from freemium offer design to subscription and in-product upsell, contributing directly to growing ARR while bringing the cost to acquire new practitioners down.

Building at Doctolib means shipping products that change how care teams and patients experience healthcare every day.


What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own Doctolib freemium offer: define what is free, metered, or demo-only, and design the conversion paths that move practitioners to a paid plan

  • Own and improve the subscription funnel for new business and upsell, across web and in-product surfaces, including checkout and sign-up unification

  • Design and improve every in-product flow that moves an existing customer to a higher-value plan

  • Define acquisition-side packaging: offer catalogue, eligibility rules, and contract signature flows across France, Germany and Italy

  • Lead marketing-led growth initiatives, including lead generation, B2B website conversion, and lifecycle marketing, connecting them to the core product funnel

  • Set the direction for cross-team delivery (along with the PMMs and other counterparts), deciding offer by offer and country by country when conversion is the right path, and when to route a user to sales as a warm, product-qualified lead


Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

 

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • You have owned a PLG conversion, ARR or CAC metric as your primary objective in B2B SaaS at scale, and can quantify what it moved, from what baseline, over what period

  • You have scaled product-led growth alongside a sales motion, and can explain how you chose between autonomous conversion and handing sales a warm lead, offer by offer

  • You read data yourself, define funnel measurement from scratch, and make decisions with experiments rather than opinion

  • You have solid product judgement on pricing, packaging, eligibility and freemium boundaries, and can work within a regulated environment with consent and country-specific constraints in mind

  • You set direction for teams you do not manage and move a metric across a cross-functional chain

  • You are fluent in English

 

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have owned both product-led and marketing-led growth, connecting lifecycle, attribution or lead scoring to the product funnel

  • Have worked across multiple countries with different pricing or packaging constraints

  • Have experience in a regulated or healthcare context


What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training


Our interview process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (Maxime)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (Louis Durteste) 

  • Case Study with Product Panel

  • Behavioral Interview

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

title: Senior Projektleiter Design & Build Innenausbau (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Überblick

München | Realisierung | Hybrid (in der Regel 3 Tage Office, 1-2 Tage Homeoffice) | Planbare Reisetage: Ø 20/Jahr | 2-3 Umsetzungsprojekte parallel | Projektvolumen: 0,8-3,0 Mio. EUR/Projekt | Unbefristete Festanstellung

Über BelForm
BelForm gestaltet seit über zehn Jahren deutschlandweit Micro Living und Hospitality Konzepte und damit die Zukunft des urbanen Wohnens. Unsere Projekte reichen von 1.000 m² bis 35.000 m² und vereinen Apartmenthäuser, Living Lobbys, Lernräume, Coworking Spaces, Bars, Cafés, Delis, Fitness und Community-Flächen. Bereits mehrere zehntausend Menschen haben ein Zuhause auf Zeit in von BelForm realisierten Projekten gefunden.

Deine Mission
Du sorgst dafür, dass beauftragte Leistungen im Innenausbau inklusive Möblierung und FF&E genau so vor Ort umgesetzt werden, wie sie geplant und beauftragt sind. Am Ende funktioniert alles: wirtschaftlich tragfähig, termingerecht und qualitativ sauber - und als Apartment-Produkt, das Mieter lieben und das im Betrieb zuverlässig läuft.

Auch passend für Projektleiter:innen (m/w/d) aus dem GU-Geschäft (Schlüsselfertig/Ausbau), aus dem Innenausbau oder aus der Projektsteuerung (Ausführung).

Sicherheit und Planbarkeit

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in einem familiengeführten Unternehmen mit Fokus auf nachhaltiges Wachstum und Stabilität.
  • Stabile Projektpipeline und sehr langfristige Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Eingespieltes Design & Build und Realisierungsteam (aktuell 15 Mitarbeitende) - kurze Wege, klare Verantwortlichkeiten.
  • Projektsteuerung aus dem Headquarter in München (Bauleitung verantwortet die operative Umsetzung vor Ort).
  • Planbare Reisetätigkeit: im Durchschnitt ca. 20 Tage pro Jahr - nur zu ausgewählten Meilensteinen.
  • Realistisch 2-3 Umsetzungsprojekte parallel; in Planungsphasen können es punktuell mehr sein - mit klarer Priorisierung und Verantwortlichkeiten.
  • Projektvolumen: ca. 0,8 bis 3,0 Mio. EUR pro Projekt.

Aufgabenspektrum

  • Du steuerst Innenausbauprojekte mit Hotelcharakter (inkl. FF&E) ganzheitlich – vom Kick-off bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe.
  • Dabei trägst Du die Verantwortung für Budget-, Termin- und Qualitätsziele bei einem Projektvolumen von ca. 0,8–3,0 Mio. € pro Projekt.
  • Projekt-, Logistik- und Montagekonzepte werden von Dir aufgesetzt und strukturiert zur Umsetzung gebracht.
  • In enger Abstimmung mit dem Einkauf übernimmst Du die Vergabe- und Beauftragungssteuerung – inklusive klar definiertem Leistungsumfang, Vergleichbarkeit der Angebote und sauberer Dokumentation.
  • Die Termin- und Kostensteuerung erfolgt durch Dich auf Basis eines belastbaren Forecasts (Soll-/Ist-Abgleich, Risikologik, Meilensteine); Abweichungen erkennst Du frühzeitig und leitest gezielt Gegenmaßnahmen ein.
  • Gemeinsam mit Bauleitung und internen Fachbereichen koordinierst Du die beteiligten Gewerke und sorgst für klare Schnittstellen sowie einen reibungslosen Projektablauf.
  • Änderungen und Nachträge steuerst Du strukturiert und transparent – inklusive Bewertung der Kosten- und Terminwirkungen und Aufbereitung fundierter Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
  • Über alle Projektphasen hinweg stellst Du eine verlässliche und professionelle Kundenkommunikation sicher – von Statusberichten über Entscheidungsprozesse bis zur Abnahme.
  • Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen, Standards und unserer Serienfertigung identifizierst Du eigenständig und setzt diese nachhaltig um.
  • Du arbeitest nicht nach Bauchgefühl, sondern mit Standards: klare Templates, regelmäßige Steuerungsroutinen, saubere Forecasts und frühe Risikoerkennung.
  • Du nutzt unsere Projektdatenbank-Tools, die den Projektalltag spürbar erleichtern (Transparenz, Dokumentation, Nachverfolgbarkeit).
  • Zusätzlich arbeitest du mit einer Projektmanagement-Software; wir bauen laufend Automatisierungen aus, damit Datenflüsse zwischen Teams und in Projekten sauber zusammenlaufen.Was du bei uns nicht machst:
  • Keine Dauerreiserei - Deine Steuerung passiert aus München; Vor-Ort-Termine sind gezielt und planbar.
  • Kein "jeder macht alles" - Die Bauleitung verantwortet die operative Umsetzung vor Ort - du steuerst, priorisierst und triffst Entscheidungen.
  • Keine sechs Projekte parallel - Realistisch 2-3 Umsetzungsprojekte - mit klarer Priorisierung.

Profil

Im Design & Build Ansatz werden Planung und Umsetzung eng verzahnt. Das reduziert Reibung an Schnittstellen, macht Verantwortlichkeiten klarer und gibt dir ein Projektsetup, in dem du steuerst statt ständig zu improvisieren. Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde, Planung, Einkauf, Serienfertigung, Bauleitung und Partnern.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn Du aus einem der folgenden Kontexte kommst:

  • GU-/Schlüsselfertig- oder Ausbauumfeld – Du kennst Vergabeprozesse, Nachunternehmersteuerung, Nachtragsmanagement sowie die Logik von Termin- und Kostensteuerung.
  • Innenausbau/FF&E – Detailqualität, Schnittstellenmanagement, Lieferketten und strukturierte Abnahmen sind Dir vertraut.
  • Projektsteuerung in der Ausführung – Du arbeitest stark strukturiert, beherrschst Controlling und Reporting, denkst in Risiko- und Änderungslogiken und möchtest näher an die operative Umsetzung heranrücken.

Entscheidend ist: Du steuerst komplexe Umsetzungen strukturiert, wirtschaftlich und termintreu – mit klarem Qualitätsanspruch.

Darüber hinaus bringst Du mit:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Innenausbau, Holztechnik, Bauingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Projektleitung im Objektausbau (z. B. Hotel-, Hospitality-, Laden- oder Messebau).
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrerer Gewerke sowie komplexer Nutzungskonzepte.
  • Ausgeprägtes Kosten- und Qualitätsbewusstsein – Zahlen, Transparenz und belastbare Forecasts sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
  • Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise: saubere Dokumentation, Nutzung klarer Standards und Souveränität auch unter Termindruck.
  • Verbindliches und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und Projektbeteiligten mit klarer, lösungsorientierter Kommunikation.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel und ERP-Systemen; Kenntnisse im VOB- und Werkvertragsrecht sind von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

Arbeitsumfeld & Kultur:

  • Wertschätzendes Miteinander in einem kollegialen Team aus kreativen und technischen Expert:innen, das dich vom ersten Tag an herzlich aufnimmt.
  • Modernes Familienunternehmen mit echter Augenhöhe, offener Kommunikation und regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen.
  • Gemeinsame Erlebnisse durch regelmäßige Team-Events wie Brunches, Wiesn-Besuche, Weihnachtsfeiern oder Firmenausflüge.
  • Inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld im charmanten Altbau mit hohen Decken, Meetingräumen, Gemeinschaftsküche und direktem Blick auf die Isar.
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsstarken Segment mit renommierten Kunden.

Flexibilität & Arbeitsweise:

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und klare Verantwortungsbereiche mit sichtbarem Impact ab Tag eins.
  • Hybridmodell: in der Regel 3 Tage Office, 1-2 Tage Homeoffice sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Kernzeiten.
  • Transparentes Zeiterfassungssystem sowie fairer Überstunden-Ausgleich – wahlweise in Freizeit oder monetär.
  • 28 Urlaubstage; Betriebsferien zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr.

Vergütung & Sicherheit:

  • Marktgerecht Bezahlung abhängig vom Verantwortungsgrad sowie jährlicher Gehaltsreview (transparent und planbar).

title: Senior RAM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Destinus Engineering is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Reliability Engineer to ensure that our defense systems and products perform dependably in demanding operational environments. You’ll lead reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) efforts across Destinus systems and products covering the full product lifecycle, from early design trade studies through qualification, fielding, and sustainment. You will work closely with system design, test, and supply chain teams as well as customers. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with good social and leadership skills to continuously coordinate with the peers of the respective engineering disciplines and teams.

Key Responsibilities

· Develop and execute reliability program plans in line with contract requirements and applicable standards (e.g., MIL-STD-785, MIL-HDBK-217, MIL-STD-1629, IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L or customer-specific equivalents)

· Perform reliability predictions, FMEA/FMECA, fault tree analysis, derating and worst-case analyses, and reliability block diagram modeling

· Define and run reliability test programs, including HALT/HASS, environmental stress screening, accelerated life testing, and reliability growth testing

· Contribute to design reviews (PDR, CDR) and influence design for reliability and maintainability early in development

· Support sustainment engineering, including obsolescence and parts-quality assessments, and supplier reliability oversight

· Prepare reliability documentation and present findings to internal leadership and government customers

· Availability modelling and allocating RAM requirements down from the system to subsystems

· Maintainability analysis plus testability and BIT coverage analysis

· Input to the maintenance and logistic support analysis, working with ILS

Requirements

Required Qualifications

· BSc or MSc in engineering (electrical, mechanical, systems, or related)

· [7+] years of reliability engineering experience preferably in the defense sector

· Experience in a tier 1 defense supplier company interacting directly with the military customer is a plus

· Hands-on experience with FMEA/FMECA, reliability prediction, and statistical life data analysis

· Experience with Air Defence and / or Strike systems is a plus

· Experience with modern European RAM standards: IEC 60812, FIDES, ANSI/GEIA-STD-0009, ASD S3000L

· Familiarity with military reliability and environmental standards (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461) and DoD acquisition or equivalent processes

· Experience using RWB Isograph or similar RAMS software.

· Proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities

· Ability to work autonomously and as part of a fast-paced, dynamic, international and multidisciplinary development team.

· Fluency in English is required; German is a plus.

descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll be doing

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.

  • Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.
  • Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.
  • Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.
  • Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.

  • You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.
  • You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.
  • You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.
  • You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps

The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Platform and Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Security Engineer, AI Platform and Infrastructure for our Engineering and Technology team. Customers provision GPU compute through API and console, software engineers build against it, our infrastructure engineers build the bare metal, virtualisation layer and Kubernetes clusters behind it, and our operators run the platform through the same control plane. You own both layers of Firmus AI Cloud: the platform control plane that engineering teams built, and the bare-metal infrastructure it runs on. Automation is how you scale that ownership. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Automation and secure delivery 

  • Own the security controls in platform delivery pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, hardware lifecycle, and Kubernetes deployment. Ship them as paved roads that engineering teams and delivery partners inherit. 
  • Build the systems that do the repeatable work: posture management, configuration validation, firmware and attestation checks, bulletin-driven fleet upgrades, evidence collection, and infrastructure risk detection.  
  • Write and review code, infrastructure-as-code, and policy-as-code that enforce security outcomes at scale. 

Security architecture and standards 

  • Set the standard for platform identity, workload identity, privileged access, and secrets: short-lived credentials, federation, least-privilege access to infrastructure APIs and Kubernetes, and audit trails for administrative and control-plane actions. 
  • Define the security baseline for Kubernetes and the container workloads the platform admits: control-plane isolation from worker and tenant networks, admission controls, policy-as-code, network policy, encrypted cluster secrets, no privileged containers or host mounts, least-privilege service accounts, and only trusted, pinned images. 
  • Lead threat modelling and secure design review for infrastructure, platform, and shared-service changes. Define what an attacker can do and what must be true before it ships. 
  • Design isolation in layers, so a single misconfiguration or outdated component cannot yield cross-tenant data access or code execution. Cover cluster, host, network, storage, control plane, and telemetry rather than relying on containers, namespaces, or dashboard filters alone. 
  • Separate the infrastructure management plane from tenant workloads: out-of-band and BMC access, device and attached-NIC management, and shared network device administration. 
  • Define how the platform is exposed and protected: default-deny at the edge, private endpoints for administrative and cluster APIs, enforcement placed in the path so volumetric and application-layer attacks are blocked or mitigated before it reaches services, encryption in transit and at rest, and automated certificate lifecycle. 
  • Set the standard for hardware roots of trust, remote attestation, secure and measured boot, firmware lifecycle, and sanitisation of GPU, host, attached device, and storage state before hardware is reassigned. Apply those controls across sites. 

Assurance and vulnerability management 

  • Own platform and infrastructure security posture: what is covered, what is open, what is accepted with a named owner and an expiry, and what is overdue. 
  • Prioritise fixes on exploitability and exposure alongside CVSS, hold them to the Firmus vulnerability SLAs, and drive remediation with the teams that own the platform components, so issues close at the source. 
  • Extend SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the infrastructure lifecycle as platforms and sites grow. Evidence that a control ran should be a query, not a spreadsheet exercise. 

Enablement and escalation 

  • Coach engineers so secure infrastructure decisions get made without waiting for you. 
  • Provide platform and infrastructure security expertise during incidents and convert recurring failure modes into controls, guardrails, standards, or automation. 
  • Give engineering leadership a straight read on infrastructure risk and operational security readiness. Join customer conversations when the question is platform and infrastructure security. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 
  • 7+ years in infrastructure security, platform security, cloud security, site reliability engineering, or platform engineering with a strong security focus. 
  • Has secured production bare-metal and on-premises infrastructure used by multiple teams or customers, including Linux hosts, out-of-band management, and the hardware lifecycle from commissioning through sanitisation and reassignment. 
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Kubernetes and container security for a multi-tenant platform: control-plane isolation, admission controls, policy-as-code, network policy, cluster secrets, container privilege and host-access restrictions, and admitting only trusted images. Has threat modelled production infrastructure using STRIDE or an equivalent method. 
  • Has run platform and workload identity in production: federation, short-lived credentials, privileged access management, secrets platforms, and least-privilege access to infrastructure APIs. 
  • Has designed and tested isolation so a container or VM escape, an outdated GPU or container toolkit, or a shared control plane cannot become a cross-tenant incident. 
  • Understands hardware roots of trust, secure and measured boot, signed firmware, and remote attestation, and can specify how out-of-band and device management interfaces stay separated from tenant workloads. 
  • Has secured public network exposure and platform cryptography: default-deny edge controls, private endpoints for administrative APIs, encryption in transit and at rest, and automated certificate lifecycle. 
  • Writes production-quality code in at least one of Python or Go and has replaced manual security work with automation that engineers trusted and kept on. 
  • Has kept production host, container runtime, GPU, and firmware software current against published security bulletins. 
  • Has worked under SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001 and can produce evidence that a control ran. 
  • Willing to join incident response for platform and infrastructure security. 
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it. 
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English. 

Bonus Points 

  • Experience securing AI infrastructure platforms, GPU clusters, or large-scale compute environments, including RoCE fabrics or automated hardware sanitisation. 
  • Experience securing large scale hypervisors and the boundaries between guests, hosts, and assigned devices, including dedicated GPU-node architectures. 
  • Experience with NVIDIA BlueField DPUs and DOCA or equivalent DPU platform software, including restricted host mode and device attestation. 
  • Experience with GPU confidential computing, remote attestation, or attestation-gated workload identity. 
  • Security certifications such as CISSP, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), or equivalent. 

LOCATION 

Singapore or Australia

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara’s investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
