title: Senior Social Commerce Strategist (Permanent)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Senior Social Commerce Strategist needed to join our Global Social Commerce Team on a permanent basis.

We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Social Commerce Strategist to join our Global Social Commerce Team. This is a senior role for someone who thinks like an operator as much as a strategist: you will own the strategic and commercial thinking behind how some of the world’s biggest brands build, launch, trade and scale on social – with TikTok Shop at the centre – and you will be accountable for the quality of that thinking in front of senior clients. 

You will translate client business objectives into social commerce strategies that hold up commercially: channel economics that work, forecasts that are defensible, measurement that proves incrementality, and operating models that can be exported market to market. You will be the connective tissue between strategy, creative, media, data and platform partners – and the person clients call when they need a point of view on where social commerce goes next. 

You will also lead people: line-managing a small team of strategists, setting the standard for the craft, and raising the commercial literacy of everyone around you. Depth across the social platforms and their commerce ecosystems – TikTok Shop above all, alongside Meta, YouTube and emerging AI-led discovery – is essential. 

What you’ll be doing: 

Commercial strategy & value creation 

Channel Economics & Business Case: Build and own the commercial case for social commerce investment – channel P&L modelling, unit economics (COGS, commission, fulfilment, returns, promotional depth), contribution margin and payback – so recommendations are grounded in what actually makes money for the client. 

Trading & Forecasting: Set and pressure-test the numbers behind the plan: GMV, AOV, conversion, basket and attach rate, CAC, ROAS/MER and repeat rate. Build forecasts and scenario models across always-on trading, LIVE, affiliate and peak moments, and diagnose performance against them. 

Investment & Mix Strategy: Advise clients on where budget works hardest across paid, organic, affiliate/creator and platform tooling (GMV Max, Spark Ads, retail media), making the trade-offs explicit – including what to stop doing. 

Margin & Pricing Discipline: Protect client margin as volume scales – promotional architecture, discount dependency, bundling and pack strategy, and repeat-purchase mechanics. 

Strategic leadership 

Channel & Category Strategy: Develop social commerce strategies aligned to client business objectives and category dynamics – defining role of channel, audience and demand strategy, portfolio and SKU selection, and the route from discovery to conversion. 

Operating Model & Market Expansion: Design the operating model that makes the strategy deliverable – crawl/walk/run sequencing, roles and responsibilities across client, agency and platform partners, governance, and blueprints that export into new markets rather than being rebuilt each time. 

Launch & Commerce Readiness: Own the go-to-market gate: fulfilment and 3PL models, dispatch SLAs, customer service, returns and Shop Health – ensuring commercial ambition is matched by operational readiness. 

Paid & Organic Integration: Build strategies that unify paid, organic, creator and affiliate activity into a single commercial system rather than parallel channels with separate objectives. 

Content & Creator Strategy: Work with client editorial, creative and marketing teams to define content-to-cart strategies, creator and affiliate programmes (including commission architecture and creator economics), and LIVE formats that convert. 

Platform & Ecosystem Expertise: Maintain authoritative depth across TikTok Shop, Meta, YouTube and emerging social and AI-led commerce surfaces – including partner ecosystems, betas and platform roadmaps – and translate it into first-mover advantage for clients. 

Client & business leadership 

Senior Client Counsel: Act as trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders up to Marketing Director, Commercial Director and GM level – as credible in a commercial conversation as a creative one, and able to disagree well when the data says so. 

Scoping & Commercial Shaping of Work: Interrogate and shape briefs, define scope and approach, input into resourcing, estimates and statements of work, and ensure what we sell is what we can brilliantly deliver. 

Growth & New Business: Identify and shape opportunities to extend the work – new markets, brands and workstreams – and bring senior strategic firepower to pitches, RFPs and capability sessions. 

Presentation & Persuasion: Build and deliver arguments that land in the room – clear narrative, sharp commercial framing, and the confidence to present to senior executives and defend the recommendation. 

Thought Leadership: Develop points of view, frameworks and IP that position VML as the leading end-to-end social commerce partner, and represent the agency externally with clients, platforms and at industry events. 

Team & delivery leadership 

People Leadership: Line-manage and develop a small team of strategists – setting objectives, coaching, reviewing work, and raising the commercial literacy and craft standard across the team. 

Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead multi-discipline pods across creative, media, data, technology and delivery, ensuring social commerce strategy is integrated with the wider marketing and commerce agenda. 

Delivery Accountability: Lead projects end to end – on time, on budget and to the standard we want to be judged by – managing dependencies, risk and scope in a fast-moving environment. 

Client Location Work: Willingness to work at client locations and travel to key markets as the work requires. 

What we want from you: 

  • Substantial experience in social, digital or commerce strategy – typically 7+ years, with meaningful time spent on social commerce specifically, agency or brand side. 
  • Genuine commercial fluency: comfortable building and defending a channel P&L, unit economics and a forecast, and as confident in a model as in a deck. 
  • Demonstrable experience setting KPIs and being held to them – you have owned the performance of a channel or programme, not just the plan for it. 
  • Deep, current expertise across social platforms and their commerce ecosystems, with hands-on TikTok Shop experience (Seller Centre, Affiliate Centre, GMV Max, LIVE, Shop Health) strongly preferred, alongside Meta. 
  • Experience designing operating models and launching or scaling a social commerce programme, ideally across more than one market. 
  • Experience line-managing or formally mentoring strategists, and raising the standard of a team rather than only your own output. 
  • Track record with global brands and senior client stakeholders, leading workstreams independently and owning relationships at a senior level. 
  • Experience in consumer packaged goods or a related sector (personal care, household, food & beverage) is highly desirable – including the realities of regulatory constraints, retailer relationships, brand reputation and margin pressure. 
  • Strong measurement and analytical instincts: able to interrogate data, find the story, and be honest about what a number does and does not prove. 
  • Excellent presentation and written communication skills, making complex commercial and technical concepts land with non-specialist audiences. 
  • Proven ability to digest, interpret and respond to briefs at pace, and to bring structure to ambiguity. 
  • Consultative, pragmatic and creative – sees challenges as opportunities and brings solutions, not just analysis. 
  • Customer-first mindset, with the maturity, judgement and initiative expected of a senior member of the team. 
  • Degree qualified, ideally in Marketing, Business, Economics, Communications or a related field (subject specific is not essential). 
  • Passionate about social, commerce and the possibilities of reinventing how people discover and buy. 

If you know this, even better: 

  • Experience with retail media and marketplace channels (Amazon, Tesco and other grocers) and how they coexist with social commerce. 
  • Experience with social listening and analytics platforms (Sprinklr, Brandwatch, NetBase Quid, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics). 
  • Experience with social advertising and commerce platforms (TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GMV Max) and affiliate or creator management tooling. 
  • Working knowledge of ecommerce and fulfilment infrastructure – Shopify, Commercetools, 3PL models and the operational realities behind them. 
  • Experience with influencer and creator marketing, including commercial models and contracting. 
  • Understanding of search, SEO and emerging AI-led discovery and agentic commerce. 
  • Experience with structured test-and-learn programmes, A/B testing and optimisation. 
  • Multi-market or multi-language experience across EMEA. 
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a senior team. 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only:
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. title: Senior Software Engineer - Typescript & Go (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
At go-e, we are shaping the future of e-mobility and the global energy transition with passion, speed, and technical excellence. Operating in an environment defined by rapid growth and breakthrough innovation, we combine regional strength with international reach to build intelligent, reliable energy solutions.

Our IoT infrastructure operates at massive scale:

  • 100+ PB of raw telemetry data stored across our infrastructure
  • 250k+ requests per second flat, not a peak; and growing
  • 130+ TB of network traffic managed monthly

To drive our next phase of platform scale, we are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/x). In this role, you will lead high-impact architectural initiatives: modernization of our API ecosystem, architecting privacy-first telemetry solutions for enterprise markets, and establishing a unified, Zero Trust security model across all our backend systems.

Your area of responsibility

  1. Scale the backend and its data: Own the scaling strategy for Go and TypeScript services handling 250k+ requests per second, optimize ingestion pipelines into ClickHouse and PostgreSQL, and design partitioning, retention, and hot/cold tiering for the multi-year telemetry dataset.
  2. Unify the API landscape: Lead the evolution of go-e’s APIs into one long-term platform for internal microservices and external B2B/B2C users, with contract-first design (OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL), clear governance, and backward-compatible versioning.
  3. Build the API gateway: Design high-performance routing, rate-limiting, and transformation layers that securely expose core services under strict authorization policies.
  4. Own backend security: Act as the architectural owner for identity, authentication, and authorization as a shared foundation across APIs, telemetry, CI/CD, and observability, including RBAC, fine-grained access policies, Zero Trust service-to-service communication, and tenant isolation.
  5. Create a white-label telemetry platform: Architect a modular ingestion and processing engine that runs multi-region, single-tenant, or at the edge to meet data residency requirements, and can be rebranded and configured for OEM and partner solutions.
  6. Lead technically: Drive key architectural decisions through RFCs and ADRs, build consensus across backend, mobile, and other teams, and mentor senior engineers through coaching, architectural code reviews, and delegated ownership of core sub-systems.)

What you bring

  • Proven Senior-Level Leadership: Track record as a Strong Senior Engineer driving cross-cutting architectural vision across multiple teams and complex domains.
  • Security & Identity Mastery: Extensive experience engineering distributed security models, including OAuth2/OIDC, PKI, JWT, fine-grained authorization, and RBAC within high-scale platforms.
  • Unified API Design Expertise: Strong experience designing, deploying, and maintaining unified, public-facing and internal API ecosystems with strict backward-compatibility and security requirements.
  • Multi-Tenant & Sovereign System Design: Hands-on experience architecting multi-tenant or white-label platforms, with direct knowledge of data sovereignty constraints, localized data storage, and regional data compliance (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws).
  • High-Throughput Backend Mastery: Expert-level mastery of Go and TypeScript/Node.js in high-concurrency, event-driven distributed environments.
  • Data Engineering at Scale: Deep experience with OLAP-optimized databases (e.g. ClickHouse) and high-scale relational datastores (PostgreSQL), emphasizing high-write ingestion, query tuning, and schema migration strategies.

It would be even better if you have

  • IoT & Fleet Management Protocols: Direct experience with EV/IoT standards such as OCPP, MQTT, or ISO 15118, paired with high-volume device telemetry processing.
  • Edge & Hybrid Deployments: Experience designing applications that deploy seamlessly across public cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), localized private clouds, and edge computing environments.
  • Applied Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Proven track record applying strategic and tactical DDD to untangle complex business and physical domains: establishing bounded contexts, codifying ubiquitous language across product and engineering, and defining clean interfaces that decouple services.
  • Systems-Level & Low-Latency Engineering: Hands-on experience with compiled, non-garbage-collected languages (Rust, C++, or Zig) for compute-heavy workloads, memory-constrained environments, zero-allocation networking, or performance-critical telemetry processing

What we offer

  • Be one of the key drivers of our core technologies
  • Influence in our fast-growing organization
  • A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects
  • Flexible working hours
  • Mental well-being support
  • Employee discounts on our products
  • Corporate discounts on a variety of brands
  • Free coffee, snacks and fresh fruit

The role is based in Graz or Berlin. Preference is given to candidates based within the European Union and available to relocate.


About us

go-e GmbH is a fast-growing, successful company in the field of e-mobility and is on its way from being a start-up to becoming an internationally recognised player. From our headquarters in Carinthia, we have already expanded into around 20 countries across Europe. With bold ideas driven by our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing the technologies of the future. As a green-tech company, environmentally conscious processes are particularly important to us, which is why we place them at the heart of everything we do. go-e employees contribute to a positive working atmosphere through their personalities; their individuality forms the foundation of our shared success.

title: Sicherheitsingenieur (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst als Sicherheitsingenieur nicht verwalten, sondern Entscheidungen prägen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als externer Dienstleister betreuen wir Produktionsbetriebe in Arbeitsschutz, Arbeitssicherheit und Brandschutz. Wir wachsen schneller, als unser Team neue Kunden aufnehmen kann. Deshalb suchen wir für unseren Standort München einen Sicherheitsingenieur, der Betriebe eigenverantwortlich betreut und Arbeitsschutz dort verankert, wo er bisher nur nebenher lief.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du bist nicht die Stabsstelle, die am Ende einer langen Freigabekette steht. Du bist die Fachperson, die die Geschäftsführung fragt, bevor eine neue Halle eingerichtet oder eine Maschine angeschafft wird. Du betreust mehrere Betriebe parallel, kennst ihre Anlagen, Prozesse und Risiken und setzt die Prioritäten selbst. Was du erreichst, siehst du direkt: weniger Unfälle, bestandene Begehungen und Kunden, die dich weiterempfehlen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust deine Kundenbetriebe als externe Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit nach DGUV Vorschrift 2 und planst deine Einsätze selbst: Woche, Route und Schwerpunkte.

  • Du bewertest Arbeitsplätze, Maschinen und Anlagen sicherheitstechnisch, erstellst Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und leitest Maßnahmen ab, die wirklich umgesetzt werden.

  • Du berätst die Geschäftsführung bei Neu- und Umplanungen von Arbeitsbereichen, damit Sicherheit von Anfang an mitgedacht wird.

  • Du verantwortest den betrieblichen Brandschutz: Brandschutzordnungen, Flucht- und Rettungswegpläne, Räumungsübungen und die Ausbildung von Brandschutz- und Evakuierungshelfern.

  • Du moderierst ASA-Sitzungen, analysierst Unfälle und Beinaheunfälle und bist Ansprechpartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Betriebsrat und Berufsgenossenschaft.

  • Du hältst Unterweisungen, die hängen bleiben, und dokumentierst so, dass deine Kunden ihre Fortschritte sehen und verstehen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossene Sifa-Ausbildung auf Basis eines Ingenieur-, Techniker- oder Meisterabschlusses.

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Praxis im Arbeitsschutz, idealerweise in der Industrie oder als externe Sifa.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ArbSchG, BetrSichV, ArbStättV/ASR und dem DGUV-Regelwerk, aus der Praxis und nicht nur aus dem Lehrbuch.

  • Erfahrung im Brandschutz ist ein Plus. Die Qualifikation zum Brandschutzbeauftragten kannst du im ersten Jahr auf unsere Kosten erwerben.

  • Du erklärst technische Risiken so, dass Lagerleiter und Geschäftsführerin gleichermaßen handeln und du bleibst freundlich, aber klar, wenn ein Mangel sicherheitskritisch ist.

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau und Führerschein Klasse B.

Was du bekommst

  • Sehr gutes Jahresgehalt, unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag.

  • Dienstwagen (auch zur Privatnutzung)

  • Direkter Einfluss auf die Realität in den Betrieben, ab Tag 1, mit einem Mentor aus dem Team in den ersten 6 Monaten.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir sind im Wachstum. Wer hier gut ist, baut Strukturen mit und bekommt mehr Verantwortung; bis zur Leitung eines eigenen Teams.

  • Betriebliche Weiterbildung, die du dir aussuchst: BSB-Lehrgang, BG-Fortbildungen, Umwelt- oder Gefahrstoffqualifikation bekommst du von uns.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Gleitzeit, Homeoffice, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebsarzt, kostenloser Parkplatz, Mitarbeiter-Rabatte uvm.

So geht’s weiter

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Danach folgen ein kurzes Telefonat, ein Fachgespräch per Video mit jemandem, der den Job selbst macht, ein Kennenlernen vor Ort und ein halber Tag bei einem Kunden.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
LiveRamp is shaping the future of responsible data collaboration between the world’s leading brands, retailers, financial services providers, and healthcare innovators. As consumers embrace new AI-driven experiences, the LiveRamp data collaboration network exponentially expands the breadth and accuracy of the data on which marketing AI capabilities operate, powering deeper customer insight and measurable performance on a global scale. LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.

The Global SRE team is responsible for supporting deployments of global products and providing first-line operational support. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who is eager to learn modern SRE and cloud engineering practices while helping maintain reliable and scalable production systems.

This role is ideal for someone early in their SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Systems Engineering career who enjoys troubleshooting, automation, and working closely with engineering teams in a fast-paced global environment.

You will:

  • Own and support the deployment of global products, including provisioning, configuring, and maintaining production and internal environments.

  • Provide 24/7 first-line engineering support through a globally distributed follow-the-sun support model, ensuring timely incident response and resolution.

  • Monitor and improve system health, availability, performance, and reliability through observability, alerting, and proactive operational practices.

  • Independently troubleshoot production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.

  • Develop and maintain automation solutions to reduce manual intervention, improve operational efficiency, and minimize human error.

  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, secure, and efficient software deployments.

  • Manage cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, ensuring consistency, scalability, and repeatability.

  • Support and optimize containerized workloads and orchestration platforms, including Kubernetes.

  • Identify and address reliability risks, performance bottlenecks, and infrastructure scalability challenges.

  • Contribute to incident management processes, post-incident reviews, operational runbooks, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, DevOps, QE, Security, and Product teams to ensure production readiness and reliable product delivery.

  • Drive improvements in operational excellence through automation, monitoring enhancements, and adoption of SRE best practices.

  • Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and production readiness assessments to ensure systems meet operational and reliability requirements.

  • Share technical knowledge, contribute to engineering standards, and support the development of junior team members.

  • Work closely with SRE team members and Engineering organizations based in California, Paris, Nantong, Singapore, Australia, and other global locations.

Required Skills:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Production Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, and production infrastructure operations.

  • Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Practical experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting containerized applications using Kubernetes and Docker.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or ArgoCD.

  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Strong scripting or programming skills in Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages, with the ability to develop operational automation.

  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms.

  • Solid understanding of incident management, troubleshooting methodologies, root cause analysis, and production support practices.

  • Familiarity with distributed systems, high availability, scalability, and reliability engineering principles.

  • Experience identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing automation or process improvements.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to independently investigate complex technical issues.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with cross-functional and globally distributed engineering teams.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision.

  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide operational support as part of a follow-the-sun model.

title: Social Media Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Sharing this story with the world is just as important as the science and engineering behind it.

We're looking for a creative, proactive, and digitally savvy Social Media Manager to build and grow our social media presence, starting with LinkedIn. As our first dedicated social media hire, you'll have the opportunity to establish our social media strategy, develop a consistent content engine, and bring Focused Energy's innovations, people, and progress to life for audiences around the world.

You'll work closely with our Communications team and subject-matter experts across science, engineering, and business to turn complex technical developments into engaging, accessible content. From employer branding and thought leadership to company milestones and community engagement, you'll help shape how the world sees and connects with Focused Energy.

This is an exciting opportunity to build something from the ground up, take ownership of growing digital channels, and help amplify the story of a company working at the forefront of clean energy innovation.

What You'll Do

  • You're curious, adaptable, and excited by the opportunity to help tell the story of a company pushing the boundaries of science, technology, and clean energy.

What We Offer

title: Software Product Assurance Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job description

Team & Reporting Line: Program Management Team | Reports to Lead Project & Procurement Manager

Our Mission 

At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth – where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.

From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.

Your Role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-driven team player to join our Product and Quality Assurance (PQA) team, with a strong focus on Flight Software Product Assurance.

In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality, safety, and reliability of both flight and ground software across our growing satellite constellation. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality, and operations, helping to shape how we build and deliver software in a fast-moving, mission-critical space environment.

The PQA team defines and maintains the company’s quality and Product Assurance standards. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring our software meets the highest levels of robustness, compliance, and reliability, supporting mission success in both orbit and ground operations.

This is a role for someone who thrives in complex, technical environments, enjoys working across disciplines, and is comfortable balancing structured quality processes with the pace of a rapidly scaling space organisation. You will be trusted to take end-to-end ownership, bring clarity to ambiguity, and help embed strong engineering discipline across the software lifecycle.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve a robust Software Product Assurance (PA) programme, reporting directly to the Product Assurance Manager.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of Software Product Assurance across both flight and ground software for our satellite constellation.

  • Ensure rigorous application of software configuration management and release processes, maintaining strong version control, traceability, and engineering discipline.

  • Enforce compliance with safety-critical and mission-critical software standards, with a strong focus on risk reduction and failure prevention.

  • Define and oversee software testing, verification, and validation strategies across all development and delivery phases.

  • Investigate, manage, and resolve software anomalies throughout development, testing, integration, and operational phases.

  • Support Spacecraft Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) activities, ensuring software readiness and compliance at every stage.

  • Coordinate and lead software deliveries from suppliers, ensuring alignment with internal standards, schedules, and quality expectations.

  • Participate in subcontractor reviews and key technical meetings, working closely with procurement engineers and Product Assurance stakeholders.

  • Balance the demands of rapid development cycles with the need to maintain strong Product Assurance and software quality standards in a fast-paced space environment.

Job requirements

About you 

Required: 

  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

  • Proven experience in Flight Software Product Assurance within the space industry.

  • Strong understanding of software testing, verification, and validation in safety-critical environments.

  • Experience with embedded flight software for satellites, spacecraft platforms, or payload systems (experience with FDIR highly desirable).

  • Strong proficiency in software configuration management tools and processes.

  • Familiarity with ECSS standards, particularly ECSS-Q-ST-80C (Software Product Assurance) and ECSS-E-ST-40C (Software Engineering).

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with experience in risk management and anomaly investigation.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines, with a proactive approach to risk identification and escalation.

  • Strong team mindset, with a desire to help build and shape a growing organisation.

  • Comfortable working independently, taking ownership and delivering in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience with automation, scripting, or AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g. prompt-based workflows).

  • Exposure to high-growth or start-up aerospace environments.

  • Broader understanding of end-to-end spacecraft systems engineering lifecycles.

Why join constellr?

  • High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.
  • Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.
  • Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.
  • Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.
  • Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.

  • Schnittstellen & Standards: Implementierung und Test gegen TRDP, MQTT, REST. Anpassung an Fahrzeug- und Kundenumgebung.

Qualifikation

✅ Du Embedded Linux, Datenbanken und Backend-Technologien (z. B. Flask oder Node.js, dazu MQTT, REST) zusammenführen kannst. Full-Stack vom Sensor bis in die Cloud.

title: Solutions Architect (Pre Sales) - Defence
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role


Are you looking to make a real impact on national security and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company? As a Solutions Architect for Defence at Elastic, you will serve as the technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, Ministry of Defence (MoD) customers, defense primes, and the broader intelligence community. You will understand and solve complex, mission-critical data challenges using the Elastic Stack—enabling secure, resilient, and scalable search, observability, and security solutions. A successful SA at Elastic will be focused on excellence; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning, while confidently navigating the unique compliance, architectural, and operational landscapes of the Defence sector.


What You Will Be Doing
  • Serving as the primary technical point of contact for MoD accounts, defense systems integrators (Primes), and account managers within your assigned territory.
  • Developing a deep understanding of defence mission goals, operational requirements, and digital transformation initiatives (such as Multi-Domain Integration and Cloud-First strategies), articulating how Elastic offerings securely address these needs.
  • Creating and owning value-based relationships at all levels within customer organizations, from front-line technical operators to senior digital commands and stakeholders.
  • Navigating complex procurement and technical assurance frameworks, actively participating in all phases of territory execution from initial discovery to achieving the technical win.
  • Demonstrating the value of Elastic offerings in secure environments, at industry events (e.g., defence technology days), and within closed community forums.
  • Advising the sales team on effective ways of positioning Elastic products, solutions, and services specifically for high-assurance, tactical, and enterprise defence environments.
  • Onboarding, educating, and enabling defense partners and Primes, supporting them through joint architectures and complex sales cycles.
  • Creating targeted collateral, technical architectural blueprints (including hybrid, air-gapped, and cross-domain solutions), and collaborating with other Elasticians to meet stringent client requirements.
  • Being the voice of the Defence customer to communicate specific compliance, security, and feature enhancements back to our engineering and leadership teams.
  • Deepening your sales, defence-domain, and technical skills through self-driven education while taking advantage of professional development opportunities provided by Elastic.

What You Bring

  • The ability to inspire groups, both large and small, ranging from technical engineers to high-ranking military officials.

It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

title: Solutions Architect, Voice - London
descriptionHtml:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Role

Decagon is seeking a Solutions Architect – Voice, a technical hire who will define how enterprises deploy Decagon's AI agents into live voice and contact center environments. This role sits at the intersection of pre-sales engineering, telephony architecture, and enterprise contact center strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex, ambiguous voice deployment conversations—from SIP trunking and call routing to media handling and real-time transcription—ensuring Decagon integrates seamlessly into their existing contact center platforms while meeting latency, reliability, and compliance requirements.

As an early hire in this function, you will define best practices for voice deployment solutioning, partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering, and set the standard for how Decagon engages with enterprises running mission-critical contact center operations. You will establish technical credibility with stakeholders across the C-suite, telephony and network teams, contact center operations, and CX leadership.

In this role, you will

  • Partner with Account Executives to discover, qualify, and design voice deployment solutions that address customer telephony constraints and deliver measurable containment and CX outcomes.

  • Navigate ambiguous conversations about a customer's contact center landscape, translating diverse environments (Genesys Cloud CX & Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco UCCE/CVP, Google CCAI) into clear integration and deployment strategies for Decagon's voice platform.

  • Design SIP integration approaches—BYOC trunking, REFER-based transfer, header propagation, and media/streaming paths (Websockets, Audio Connector, External Voice Transfer)—tailored to each customer's topology and security posture.

  • Diagnose complex, multi-leg call flows down to the packet level, and establish repeatable methods for tracing and resolving SIP and media issues in production.

  • Establish scalable pre-sales processes, deployment playbooks, and reusable reference architectures to support growth.

Your background looks something like this

  • 8–10+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Manager) with a focus on voice, telephony, or contact center platforms.

  • Deep fluency in enterprise contact center platforms—Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, or Google CCAI—and the SIP/telephony fundamentals underneath them (trunking, transfer semantics, codecs, SRTP, DTMF).

  • Hands-on experience with CPaaS infrastructure such as Twilio or Telnyx, including BYOC configuration and programmable voice.

  • Demonstrated success navigating ambiguous technical conversations with enterprise customers, asking the right discovery questions, and collaborating through uncertainty.

  • Strong ability to engage diverse stakeholders—from network engineers to CX and contact center leaders—and translate voice requirements into actionable deployment strategies.

Even better if you have

  • 2+ years selling or architecting AI/ML or conversational voice solutions in enterprise environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup where you built pre-sales practices from the ground up.

  • Hands-on packet-level SIP diagnostics experience (pcap analysis, Wireshark/Scapy) and comfort reading raw signaling.

  • Familiarity with real-time speech stacks (STT/TTS), call recording and compliance patterns (SIPREC), and multi-leg call correlation.

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

Compensation: £144.3K – £216.4K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

title: Solutions Engineer (CS)
descriptionHtml:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

We are looking for a hands-on Solutions Engineer to help customers and internal teams explore what Cirrus Logic’s technologies can do in Automotive and Industrial applications. You will turn product capabilities and emerging customer needs into working solutions, proofs of concept, and compelling technical demonstrations.

This role, based in our Edinburgh office, combines electronic design, software, system integration, and practical problem-solving. You will develop and deliver working solutions that demonstrate the benefits of Cirrus Logic technologies, taking ownership of technical work from concept and prototyping through system integration, evaluation, and demonstration. You will collaborate with design, applications, systems, marketing, customers, and external partners


Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop system-level solutions and demonstrations using Cirrus Logic products across Automotive and Industrial applications.
  • Translate customer needs, use cases, and product capabilities into practical technical concepts and proofs of concept.
  • Design, prototype, bring up, and debug electronic hardware, including PCBs, evaluation boards, and supporting circuitry.
  • Integrate ICs, sensors, embedded software, signal paths, communications interfaces, and mechanical components into complete working systems.
  • Develop or adapt software, scripts, and basic user interfaces to configure, control, test, and demonstrate systems.
  • Plan and carry out evaluations, investigate system-level issues, and use measurements and hands-on assessment to guide improvements.
  • Work with internal engineering teams and external partners to define requirements, coordinate technical work, and deliver functional prototypes and demonstrations.
  • Prepare clear setup guides, technical documentation, and presentation materials so others can evaluate, operate, and explain the solutions.
  • Support customer engagements, internal reviews, and industry events by demonstrating solutions and explaining their technical value.
  • Travel internationally to support customers, tradeshows, and other business activities, expected to be approximately 4–6 weeks per year.
  • Contribute to the mechanical design and integration of prototypes and demonstrations, working with internal specialists or external partners where needed.

Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • A degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience developing and debugging electronic systems that combine hardware and software.
  • PCB design experience, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, prototype bring-up, and verification.
  • Confidence using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, power supplies, and signal generators.
  • Practical software skills sufficient to get prototypes and demonstrations working, including writing or adapting scripts, configuring embedded platforms, integrating APIs, and debugging hardware–software interactions.
  • The ability to use AI-assisted software development tools effectively, while reviewing, testing, and troubleshooting the resulting code.
  • Familiarity with common hardware interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, and audio interfaces such as I²S or TDM.
  • A methodical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to move from a system-level symptom to a practical solution.
  • The ability to take ownership of deliverables, manage competing priorities, and make sound engineering decisions.
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical work to people from different disciplines.
  • A willingness to learn new technologies and work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners to develop practical solutions.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Experience with Automotive or Industrial electronic systems, semiconductor products, or mixed-signal applications.
  • Familiarity with one or more relevant technology areas, such as audio, haptics, sensing, clocking and synchronisation, or power management, and their integration into practical systems.
  • Experience developing prototypes, proofs of concept, evaluation platforms, or customer-facing demonstrations.
  • Knowledge of networking and communications technologies used in Automotive or Industrial systems, such as Ethernet, CAN, LIN, EtherCAT, or PROFINET.
  • Familiarity with single-pair Ethernet technologies, such as 100BASE-T1, 10BASE-T1S, or 10BASE-T1L.
  • Experience working with OEMs, system integrators, Tier 1 suppliers, or external development partners.
  • Familiarity with relevant functional safety, qualification, or electromagnetic compatibility standards, such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, AEC-Q100, or CISPR 25.
  • Experience with mechanical design and integration, including basic CAD, enclosures, fixtures, mounting arrangements, and rapid prototyping techniques such as 3D printing.
  • Experience with system architecture, product definition, feasibility studies, teardowns, or competitive analysis.

This role is based in our Edinburgh, UK office.

This is a hybrid position and will follow a 2+ day in-office work schedule, with in-office days based on business needs and team preference. descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.

Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :

  • à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ;

  • au dépôt de capital ;

  • à l’encaissement de leurs clients ;

  • aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ;

  • au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers.

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne.

Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients.

Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers.

Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Lorsque cela est nécessaire, tu transmets la demande aux équipes internes ou aux partenaires concernés et assures son suivi jusqu’à sa résolution.

  • assures le suivi de chaque demande jusqu’à sa résolution ;

  • veilles à maintenir une communication claire avec le client à chaque étape.

Tu traites les demandes en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et tu collabores avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu développes tes connaissances sur le compte professionnel, le dépôt de capital, l’encaissement et les moyens de paiement.

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu apprécies les échanges avec des partenaires externes et sais maintenir une communication professionnelle et efficace.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re a hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right.


Building a neobank means earning people’s trust in the moments that matter: getting started, moving money, making a payment, or understanding what’s happened when something goes wrong. You’ll help make those experiences clear and reliable, bringing the same care to everyday interactions as you do to the overall product vision.


The Opportunity

  • Own the design direction for Krak, connecting onboarding, accounts, payments, and spending into one coherent experience.

  • Make everyday banking clear and intuitive, from understanding balances and fees to tracking payments and resolving problems.

  • Shape product strategy and roadmap decisions with product, engineering, and leadership.

  • Lead hands-on design and prototyping, setting the standard for interaction design, visual craft, and accessibility.

  • Work with compliance, risk, and operations to make verification, security, and account recovery straightforward for customers.

  • Evolve Krak’s design system and align teams around consistent patterns.

  • Use research and data to improve the product, and mentor designers through critique and collaboration.What You’ll Bring

 

What you bring

  • 7+ years in product design, with a strong portfolio of shipped consumer mobile experiences.

  • Experience operating at Staff level or above, leading design across a product or several connected teams.

  • Strong interaction and visual design skills, with the ability to work through complex financial journeys and their edge cases.

  • Advanced prototyping skills and experience building or evolving design systems.

  • Evidence of influencing product strategy, resolving competing priorities, and guiding work through delivery.

  • Clear communication, sound design judgment, and experience mentoring other designers.

descriptionHtml:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London / UK Remote | 💰 Staff Backend Engineer (L60) £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity + Benefits | Technology - Engineering  

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blogis a good place to learn even more about what we do!

What you’ll be working on: 

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:

  • Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)
  • Cassandra for most persistent data storage
  • Kafka for our asynchronous message queue
  • Envoy Proxy for RPC
  • Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services 
  • AWS for most of our infrastructure
  • React for internal web dashboards
  • We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties

Your day-to-day   

This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! 

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). Our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront - from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. 

We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. 

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

The Interview Process:

Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability. 

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

descriptionHtml:
About this role

We are looking for a Staff Cyber Security Specialist (f/m/x) to strengthen our Incident Response and Security Operations capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced incident responder who enjoys solving complex security challenges and helping organizations navigate critical cyber incidents.

In this role, you will lead incident response engagements from investigation through recovery, working directly with customers during some of their most challenging moments. You will act as a trusted technical authority within the team, mentor less experienced responders, and help drive improvements across our security operations.

This gives you the opportunity to work at scale, leverage large security datasets, and contribute improvements that strengthen protections across our entire customer base.


You will work with state-of-the-art security tooling while collaborating with security professionals from intelligence, military, consulting, national CERT, and technology backgrounds.

Alongside operational response work, you'll have opportunities to contribute to internal research initiatives, Bug Bounty Fridays, Capture The Flag events, and other technical projects that help push our capabilities forward.

This position reports directly to the Director of Security Operations.

What you will do

  • Act as a leading technical authority within Security Operations, taking ownership of strategic improvement initiatives and helping shape the future direction of our incident response and security operations capabilities.

  • Lead cyber incident response engagements from intake through recovery.

  • Mentor junior and medior responders and help raise the technical maturity of the team.

What you will need

Nice-to-have

What we offer

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 170 FTEs and continue to grow internationally.

 

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

 

At Eye, you’ll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

title: Staff Fraud Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Fraud Strategy Analyst at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.


Your Role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer at bunch, you will shape the architecture, quality, and developer experience of the product surfaces our customers and internal teams rely on every day. You will work across product teams to make our frontend systems scalable, reliable, accessible, and fast — while helping engineers ship with clarity and confidence.

This is not only a delivery role. Your decisions will influence how frontend engineering at bunch evolves: the standards we adopt, the patterns we reuse, the quality bar we hold, and the way product, design, and engineering collaborate to build excellent user experiences.

How the role contributes to our vision

bunch is building the backbone of private markets, combining exceptional expertise, operational excellence, and frictionless technology. Our platform enables funds and private investors to seamlessly and securely set up and manage their investment entities.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in turning complex workflows into intuitive, robust, and scalable product experiences. You will help ensure our frontend foundation enables rapid delivery across teams while maintaining high standards for usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

Top priorities

  1. Lead our migration from Svelte to React. Hold the architectural picture across both stacks, sequence the work against product delivery, and land it without stalling teams.

  2. Maintain and evolve our design system, together with the frontend guild, so product teams ship consistent, accessible UI faster.

  3. Support and guide frontend initiatives across teams, with the frontend guild — application architecture, performance, testing strategy, developer experience, and technical debt reduction — from diagnosis through measurable delivery.

  4. Be the bar raiser for UX and UI quality, raising the standard through design reviews, reusable patterns, mentoring, and thoughtful technical writing.

  5. Advance how we build with AI — find where agentic tooling genuinely improves engineering practice, and shape the codebase (module boundaries, API contracts, documentation) so it works well for people and agents alike.

Your first 90 days

  • 30 days: map the frontend architecture, product domains, design system, team workflows, and the main bottlenecks affecting delivery and quality.

  • 60 days: publish a structured problem analysis and proposal for one cross-team frontend initiative with clear trade-offs, stakeholders, and success measures.

  • 90 days: lead a systemic improvement from kickoff to measurable progress across teams, while helping Senior Engineers grow through collaboration, reviews, and shared ownership.

About you

  • Track record — You have already operated at Staff scope, with or without the title, and have shipped systemic frontend or product-engineering improvements across multiple teams. People listen to you because of what you have delivered, how clearly you think, and how effectively you collaborate.

  • Frontend craft — Deep expertise in modern frontend engineering, with strong command of TypeScript, component architecture, state management, design systems, accessibility, performance, testing, and maintainable application architecture.

  • AI-native practice — You use AI coding tools daily and have gone past autocomplete into agentic workflows. You have a considered view on where they genuinely help, where they don't, and what a codebase needs to be a good place to work in with agents.

  • Product judgment — You care about the user experience as much as the technical solution. You can translate ambiguous workflows and business constraints into pragmatic, elegant product experiences.

  • Systems thinking — You are comfortable reasoning across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, observability, security, and compliance when the problem requires it.

  • Operating style — You think in quarters and years, not only sprints. You drive cross-team change through credibility, clear writing, architectural reasoning, and strong stakeholder alignment — not through authority.

  • Collaborative Leadership: A proactive relationship-builder who can set technical direction and influence without formal authority, manage diverse stakeholders and build alignment on difficult technical decisions, while mentoring engineers.

  • Language — Fluent English, written and spoken. You can make complex technical decisions legible to engineers, product partners, design partners, and leadership alike.

Our tech stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Svelte — we are consolidating on React, and this role leads that migration.

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js

  • Database: MySQL

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes on AWS

  • Source Control & CI/CD: GitHub

  • Authentication: FusionAuth, Okta

  • Internal Tools: Retool

  • Messaging: Twilio, SendGrid

  • Forms: Tally

Workplace & Benefits

  • Customizable benefits package covering wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid setup

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 130+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  1. Initial screening with Talent Acquisition (30 min): get acquainted with bunch, explore your motivation, and understand whether what we offer matches what you are looking for.

  2. Hiring Manager call — Engineering (60 min): a conversation with Engineering leadership focused on your scope, frontend leadership, product-engineering mindset, and how you diagnose and lead systemic improvements.

  3. Technical Interview (60 min): a hands-on technical conversation focused on frontend engineering craft, TypeScript, component design, maintainability, testing, and pragmatic problem-solving.

  4. Technical Interview — System Design (60 min): a frontend/system design conversation focused on architecture, data flow, performance, accessibility, reliability, and trade-offs in complex product systems.

  5. VP Product conversation (45 min): a cross-functional conversation focused on product thinking, customer empathy, business acumen, and how you partner with Product and Design on ambiguous problems.

  6. Final round (45 min): a closing conversation to align on what we heard across the process, answer remaining questions, and discuss expectations for the role and trial period.

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

Design systems are an important part of this role, but not the whole role. You will use systems, patterns, accessibility standards and reusable components to connect product experiences while still leading original, customer-centered design work for high-impact product areas.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align teams through customer insight, business rationale, data, prototypes and craft

How You Work

descriptionHtml:

title: Stage Customer Success Manager (H/F)
descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative.
