  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audience

Contexte
Notre plateforme de jeu repose sur des microservices stateless : chaque traitement est une fonction pure appliquée à un message et à un état. Sur le papier, c'est le rêve pour débugger. En pratique, l'outillage n'existe pas, et CloudWatch devient vite chronophage dès qu'il faut analyser les interactions entre services. Comment rejouer les messages et les changements d'états pour reproduire un dysfonctionnement à l'identique ?
Objectifs du stage
Concevoir et déployer un outil réellement opérationnel, en trois briques :
  • Ingestion et indexation à l'échelle : capter les messages et les transitions d'états, définir un modèle de stockage scalable sans impacter la production
  • Générateur de tests local : isoler une séquence, reconstruire l'arbre d'états, et en sortir des tests de non-régression automatisés
  • Replayer : une API et un back-office minimaliste pour visualiser graphiquement les états et les interactions inter-services
    • Les points d'attention : la volumétrie, la fidélité de la reconstruction chronologique, la corrélation d'événements en environnement distribué, et l'industrialisation de l'outil (CI/CD, tests, documentation).

title: Stagiaire Chargé de mission - Gestion de projet européen en santé numérique H/F
descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous intégrerez le Domaine Innovation et International, au sein d’une équipe de six personnes, et assisterez la cheffe de projet Sesali. L’ANS est le point de contact national français pour la e-santé (National Contact Point for eHealth – NCPeH) au sein de l’infrastructure européenne MyHealth@EU. Elle opère le service Sesali, qui permet aux professionnel·les de santé en France de consulter de manière sécurisée la synthèse médicale de patient·es (Patient Summary) provenant d’autres pays de l’Union européenne. Le service évolue également pour intégrer la consultation des prescriptions électroniques (ePrescription). Dans la perspective de ces évolutions, de l’ouverture de nouvelles connexions avec des pays européens et de la mise en œuvre de l’Espace européen des données de santé (EHDS, European Health Data Space / EEDS), vous contribuerez au suivi du projet, à la coordination des parties prenantes et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles du service.

🎯 Missions principales

Coordination du projet européen

  • Appuyer le suivi du projet et vous familiariser avec la gestion de projets européens de grande envergure.

  • Participer à certains groupes de travail européens, représenter les positions françaises et échanger avec les homologues des autres États membres.

  • Contribuer à la coordination des parties prenantes françaises, notamment la CNAM et le ministère chargé de la Santé.

Déploiement et suivi opérationnel

  • Participer à l’ouverture de nouvelles connexions en production entre Sesali et d’autres pays : échanges avec les professionnel·les de santé, tests métier de bout en bout et coordination européenne.

  • Assurer le suivi des sprints avec les équipes de maîtrise d’œuvre : avancement, backlog et livrables.

  • Approfondir la connaissance du règlement EHDS/EEDS et analyser ses implications pour Sesali.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, dans un cursus en lien avec le numérique, les systèmes d’information ou la gestion de projet.

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.

  • Vous maîtrisez l’anglais à l’oral comme à l’écrit

  • Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour le numérique, les nouvelles technologies et la e-santé.

  • Vous faites preuve de rigueur et d’un bon sens de l’organisation, avec une capacité à prioriser.

  • Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse, êtes curieux·se et force de proposition.

  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les échanges avec des interlocuteurs français et européens.

title: Strategic Account Executive (UK / Ireland)
descriptionHtml:
Everseen: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.

The Role

Are you a builder who wants to be part of a world-class, destination sales team? Do you thrive on creating value and understanding the real-world impact AI can have on a business's efficiency and bottom line?
As a Strategic Account Executive (UK / Ireland) with our EMEA team, you will be at the core of our growth and customer success. We are looking for highly motivated, solution-oriented sellers who are eager to learn and are passionate about building something truly special. At Everseen, you won't just be selling a product; you'll be a trusted partner to the world's leading retailers, helping them solve challenges with cutting-edge Vision AI.
What You'll Do
  • Drive Revenue & Growth: Define, develop and execute strategic sales campaigns to win new logos within the UK and Ireland retail market. Build frameworks for account segmentation and performance tracking.
  • Be a Strategic Partner: Act as the primary relationship owner and serve as the trusted advisor for key, high value enterprise accounts. You will ensure customers recognize the value of our solutions, manage their expectations, and establish yourself as their trusted advisor for all day-to-day needs and strategic reviews.
  • Expand Our Footprint: Masterfully position our solutions, Checkout Intelligence, Store Intelligence and Data Intelligence, into our existing customer base, using sophisticated, ROI-driven SaaS selling methodologies.
  • Build new markets: Identify new markets, alliances, and partnership opportunities to drive new business and customers for Everseen. Collaborate with senior leadership to align market expansion with corporate objectives.
  • Orchestrate the Win: Lead the entire sales cycle, from securing initial Proof of Concepts that demonstrate clear business value to negotiating and closing complex enterprise deals.
  • Collaborate to Win: Serve as the "on the ground" voice of the customer, collaborating closely with Everseen's Product, Engineering, and Operations (Customer Delivery) teams to ensure seamless rollouts and exceptional customer satisfaction. Drive process innovation across business development and account management.

    • Collaborating With

    Senior leadership team, product, engineering, operations (customer delivery) teams


    Profile and Skills
  • You have 10+ years of experience in an enterprise SaaS sales role, with a demonstrated history of landing new logos and expanding existing accounts with retail and grocery customers in the UK / Ireland region. You are willing to travel to meet with customers and collaborate with our global Everseen team.
  • You are comfortable with building relationships with customers across the UK / Ireland region. You speak English fluently and you additionally speak either French, German or Italian.
  • A Builder: You're not just looking for a job; you're looking to make an impact. You have a passion for building territories, developing strategic accounts, and contributing to a winning team culture. You have experience building and managing a robust sales pipeline, with accurate forecasting and a consistent record of meeting and exceeding revenue targets.
  • Value-Driven: You excel at solution-based selling. You dig deep to understand a customer's business, identify their core challenges, and articulate a clear vision for how our technology will deliver a significant return on investment.
  • A Student of the Game: You are naturally curious and constantly learning. You have a keen interest in AI, retail technology, and you're motivated to become a true expert in the Everseen platform.
  • Customer-Obsessed: You put the customer at the center of everything you do. You are dedicated to building long-term, strategic relationships and being an indispensable resource for your clients. You have exceptional communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging C-level executives.
  • Tenacious & Driven: You have a proven track record of exceeding targets and a relentless drive to win. You see challenges as opportunities and are motivated by the chance to build a dominant presence EMEA.
  • One Team: You collaborate exceptionally bringing crossfunctional leadership skills to the fore to build and close revenue.

    • About Everseen

    Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. We are a leader in vision AI, transforming business operations for global retailers by reducing shrink, improving operations, and delivering a better customer experience. Supporting 11 of the top 20 global retailers, Everseen’s AI innovations help retailers save millions of dollars every month. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. Everseen operates at unmatched scale, processing over 15 million transactions, and more than six petabytes of video data, daily. Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world - including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths - we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain. We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver.

    Our Culture

    Our culture is built on ownership and accountability, we own outcomes, not tasks. We stay relentlessly customer-first, letting their needs shape our priorities and decisions. We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact. Our Values We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses. We ARE CUSTOMER-FIRST. They guide our decisions. We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit. We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality. We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact.

    Our Commitment

    Everseen is committed to creating an environment where everyone can succeed. Our employees should feel a sense of belonging, have an opportunity to grow their careers, and feel free to be their most authentic selves. Everseen takes great pride in the diversity of its global workforce, and insists upon a safe, inclusive workplace where our differences are our collective strength. We treat each other with dignity, and respect, and require all employees, officers, and directors to seek to understand the importance and value to Everseen of diversity, and inclusion. Everseen is committed to creating a safe environment for all employees and has a zero tolerance policy for bias and discrimination of any kind. Our work environment is one without offensive, hostile, or intimidating conduct, whether verbal, written or physical, in nature. Everseen will not tolerate prejudice or discrimination of any kind including without limitation, where based on aspects such as, race, colour, sex, gender, religion, age, family status, disability of any kind, sexual orientation.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - Italian Speaking
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager for our Italian-speaking market, you’ll own a book of enterprise accounts across Europe, acting as a trusted advisor who drives adoption, retention and growth. You’ll partner closely with Sales to deliver a seamless onboarding experience and educate clients on a completely new way to create video content. Engaging stakeholders from day-to-day users through to the C-suite, you’ll make sure customers see clear ROI and become true champions of Synthesia.

What You'll do

  • Reporting to the Director of Customer Success of Southern EMEA and focusing on Italian accounts in Europe - you are energetic, driven, and care deeply about the success of our customers

  • As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will drive Synthesia’s future growth by building relationships with clients and turning them into happy users

  • You will be helping educate clients on a totally new way to create video content, and work very closely with sales to create a cohesive onboarding experience for new users

  • You are capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organisation, including the C-suite

  • Ideal for an individual who wants to expand their career with a fast-growing software company

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • Customer-facing experience in Customer Success Management / Client Service / Account Management / Technical Account Management / Implementation or similar ideally in B2B SaaS

  • Experience in managing a Book of Business along with KPIs

  • A track record in managing risk, forecasting, and identifying growth opportunities

  • Establishing a trusted advisor relationship with our clients, driving value from Synthesia products and services

  • Successfully onboarding new clients and building key relationships in the first critical months and beyond

  • Coordinating and leading regular client check-ins with clear outcomes on client health and opportunities with senior stakeholder attendance

  • Light video editing using the Synthesia platform

  • Retention and growth of our enterprise clients

  • Ensuring ROI and value is understood by clients, proactively looking for risks and opportunities

  • You need to be fluent in Italian and English

  • You are based in Europe and can sit remote.

We’d be particularly excited if

  • Experience at a fast-growing technology company

  • Familiarity with AI or video tools

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

title: Strategic Project Manager Italy
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Join us as a Strategic Project Manager – Country Support (Italy) to help shape Qonto’s strategy in Italy and turn local priorities into action. Working with Fanny, our Strategy Director, and Italy’s country leadership, you’ll combine market insights, strategic planning and hands-on project leadership to support growth in the Italian market.

You’ll join a Strategy talent pool where you can learn quickly, collaborate across teams and potentially grow into another function over time, such as Growth, Operations, Product or Tech.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Understand the Italian market: Analyze market trends, customer needs, regulation and competition to anticipate their impact on Qonto and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Shape the country strategy and plan: Work with Italy’s country leadership to identify opportunities and define and refresh the country strategy and priorities, connecting local opportunities with Qonto’s wider strategic plan. Track progress against the plan with the Finance Business Partner.

  • Develop the strategy per segment: Analyze the market and customer base to define and refresh strategies for different customer segments and identify new business opportunities.

  • Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Assess the potential, scope, business case and strategic rationale of key initiatives supporting Italy’s priorities and OKRs. Lead or coordinate execution where needed, and hand projects over to country teams when ready. Projects will vary with country priorities and could include exploring a company-creation offering. Strong stakeholder management is essential.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Experience: You have around 4–5 years or more of relevant experience in strategic project management, consulting and/or a hands-on role in a startup or company. Consulting experience is useful but not required; experience in banking, payments or fintech is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • Analytical mindset: You enjoy exploring complex questions, researching markets and turning insights into clear, structured recommendations and action plans.

  • Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present your ideas to a range of stakeholders.

  • Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects, build alignment across teams and break down silos to move priorities forward.

  • Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for your projects, from planning through execution, and follow through on delivery.

  • Collaboration: You’re a team player who builds constructive relationships and energizes the people you work with.

  • Curiosity & AI: You’re interested in financial services and eager to learn and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

  • Languages: Fluency in Italian and English is required.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Team & impact: Join the Strategy team and play a key role in shaping Qonto’s strategy and driving strategic projects in Italy.

  • Exposure & collaboration: Work closely with country leadership, senior management and international teams across Growth, Product, Tech, Finance, Operations and Compliance.

  • From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business, with opportunities to move from market analysis and strategic decisions to concrete local initiatives and outcomes.

  • Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

  • AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Fanny De Vesinne-Larüe, our Strategy Director.

  • Her background: Fanny has been at Qonto for four years, spotting new opportunities and driving key projects to help Qonto accelerate. Before joining Qonto, she held roles across strategy, marketing, venture and e-business at financial institutions including AXA and BNP Paribas, working with fintechs and startups.

  • What she brings to the team: Fanny supports team members through coaching, exposure to different functions and conversations about their development and potential future moves within Qonto.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst - Germany 🇩🇪
descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du den Alltag von Millionen Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern in Frankreich und Europa nachhaltig verbessern?

Arbeitest du gerne in einem vertrauensvollen und dynamischen Umfeld?

Dann könnte Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich sein und du die perfekte Ergänzung für unser Team 🙂

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste Finanzbetriebssystem für europäische KMU werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern, den Zeitaufwand für Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu reduzieren. Gleichzeitig erhalten sie Zugang zu wichtigen Informationen, die ihnen helfen, bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Steuerkanzleien. Mit Pennylane können sie manuelle und repetitive Aufgaben reduzieren und mehr Zeit darauf verwenden, ihre Mandantinnen und Mandanten zu beraten und zu begleiten.

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintech-Unternehmen Frankreichs. Derzeit beschleunigen wir unsere Expansion nach Deutschland 🇩🇪

In sechs Jahren haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als innovative Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerkanzleien etabliert.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro an Finanzierung eingeworben, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem bekannten Venture-Capital-Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal investiert hat.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von sieben Mitgründern zu einem Team von über 1.200 zufriedenen Mitarbeitenden gewachsen. Heute gelten wir als einer der besten Arbeitgeber in Frankreich und als attraktiver Arbeitgeber für Remote-Arbeit. Auf Glassdoor haben wir eine Bewertung von 4,6 von 5.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 vertretenen Nationalitäten geschaffen. Unsere Kultur ist stark auf Remote-Arbeit ausgerichtet, und bereits 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden arbeiten aus verschiedenen Ländern Europas.

🤝 Wir genießen das Vertrauen von Tausenden Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Steuerkanzleien und erhalten hervorragende Bewertungen.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1,3 Millionen kleine und mittlere Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich.

Strategy & Operations bei Pennylane

Teil des Strategy-&-Operations-Teams bei Pennylane zu sein bedeutet, die operativen Realitäten genau zu verstehen. Während wir unsere deutsche Gesellschaft aufbauen, entwickeln und implementieren wir effiziente und skalierbare Lösungen, die Pennylane dabei unterstützen, seine ambitionierten Expansionsziele zu erreichen.

Deine Rolle wird entscheidend dazu beitragen, lokale Abläufe von Grund auf zu strukturieren, bestehende Prozesse zu skalieren und unser Operating Model an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes anzupassen.

Um diesen Markteintritt erfolgreich zu gestalten, arbeiten unsere Strategy-&-Operations-Teams täglich eng mit den Business-Teams, beispielsweise in Sales und Customer Success, den Tech-Teams, darunter Entwicklerinnen, Entwickler und Product Managerinnen und Product Manager, sowie den Data-Teams, darunter Data Scientists und Data Analysts, zusammen.

Dein Ziel

Du steigerst die Produktivität unserer Teams deutlich, indem du die Nutzung unserer Tools optimierst, Prozesse vereinfachst und operative Strukturen aufbaust, die den Aufbau und die Expansion unserer deutschen Gesellschaft unterstützen.

Dein täglicher Beitrag

Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bist die zentrale Ansprechperson und treibst Veränderungen in den Business-Teams für den deutschen Markt voran.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den operativen Verantwortlichen aus den Bereichen Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support und Account Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Transformation vorantreiben und den Status quo hinterfragen: Du beobachtest, hörst zu, stellst bestehende Strukturen infrage und schlägst kontinuierlich Optimierungen vor, um den Zeitaufwand für manuelle administrative Aufgaben und die Datensuche zu reduzieren. Du schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum in Deutschland, strukturierst die Abläufe einer neuen Gesellschaft und dokumentierst alle Prozessänderungen.

  • Operative Verbesserungen umsetzen: Du setzt lösungsorientierte Initiativen durch die Einführung neuer Informationssysteme, die Anpassung bestehender Anwendungen oder organisatorische Veränderungen um. Dabei leitest du Projekte und nutzt das Know-how verschiedener Teams, darunter Data, Sales und Finance. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört außerdem, eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit sicherzustellen, Zeitpläne einzuhalten und die relevanten KPIs der Implementierung zu überwachen.

  • Prozesse skalieren und lokalisieren: Du passt globale operative Strukturen an die Besonderheiten des deutschen Marktes an und stellst gleichzeitig sicher, dass sie mit den zentralen Pennylane-Standards übereinstimmen.

  • Benchmarking und Innovation: Du beobachtest andere Abteilungen, trittst einen Schritt vom Tagesgeschäft zurück, führst Benchmarks durch und sammelst Erkenntnisse, um unsere operativen Strategien weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Teams befähigen und die Akzeptanz neuer Lösungen fördern: Du etablierst klare Kommunikationswege und praxisnahe Unterstützung für die deutschen Teams, damit sie sich reibungslos in neue Methoden und Arbeitsweisen einfinden, beispielsweise durch optimierte Tools, Schulungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen. Du stellst sicher, dass Tools im Alltag genutzt und Prozesse eingehalten werden.

  • Die Schnittstelle zwischen Operations und Unternehmensstrategie bilden: Du entwickelst ein übergreifendes Verständnis für die Herausforderungen des Unternehmens, um frühzeitig zu erkennen, wie sie sich auf unsere lokalen Aktivitäten in Deutschland auswirken. Mithilfe datenbasierter Erkenntnisse schaffst du mehr Transparenz über unsere operativen Abläufe.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit mit nachweislicher Erfahrung in der organisatorischen Transformation, der Steigerung der Produktivität, im Projektmanagement und im Aufbau operativer Strukturen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

Deine Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du verfügst über mindestens vier Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Business-Transformation und in der Steigerung operativer Effizienz durch die Implementierung von Systemen und Tools.

  • Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit Markteintritten, dem Aufbau neuer Gesellschaften oder der Skalierung operativer Strukturen gesammelt oder bringst eine starke Motivation für diese Themen mit.

  • Du zeichnest dich durch natürliche Neugier und den Wunsch aus, einen echten Beitrag zu leisten. Du hörst aktiv zu und beobachtest genau.

  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung im End-to-End-Projektmanagement. Du kannst Probleme schnell erfassen, zügig Lösungen umsetzen und iterativ arbeiten, ohne auf Perfektion zu warten.

  • Du kannst zwischen detaillierten Einzelheiten und einer übergeordneten strategischen Perspektive wechseln.

  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Geschäftsverständnis.

  • Du besitzt sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zusammenfassen.

  • Du interessierst dich für künstliche Intelligenz, No-Code-Tools und Prozessautomatisierung oder hast bereits Erfahrung in diesen Bereichen gesammelt.

  • Du verfügst über starke analytische Fähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in SQL sind von Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung mit SaaS-Geschäftsmodellen sowie Tools wie Salesforce und Intercom ist von Vorteil.

Was wir dir bieten

🏢 Diese Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. Du arbeitest an einigen Tagen pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43-45.

💵 Wir bieten ein attraktives Vergütungspaket. Die Details besprechen wir im Laufe des Bewerbungsprozesses.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile und kannst so am Erfolg teilhaben, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Homeoffice sowie eine monatliche Pauschale für die Nutzung eines Coworking-Spaces, wann immer du möchtest.

⛹️ Über unseren Partner Gymlib erhältst du Zugang zu 8.000 Fitness- und Sporteinrichtungen in Europa sowie zu mehr als 300 Wellness- und Freizeitaktivitäten.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu verbessern.

💻 Du erhältst modernste Apple-Ausstattung.

🎉 Regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen: Wir legen großen Wert darauf, Zeit miteinander zu verbringen, zum Beispiel bei unseren vierteljährlich stattfindenden Tech Days, unserem jährlichen Company Seminar sowie bei Team-Treffen etwa einmal im Monat in unserem Berliner Büro in der Rosenthaler Straße 43-45.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

  • Erstes Gespräch: 30-minütiges Videogespräch mit Thomas, unserem Recruiter.

  • Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager: 45-minütiges Videogespräch mit Alexandre, Chief of Staff Germany.

  • Case Study:

    • Praktische Übung mit zwei Strategy-&-Operations-Managerinnen oder -Managern von Pennylane in einem 60-minütigen Videogespräch.

    • Gespräch vor Ort zum gegenseitigen Kennenlernen: Gespräch mit einer Person aus dem Sales- oder PSM-Team.

  • Finale Runde: Treffen mit dem Team vor Ort, gefolgt von einem 30-minütigen Videogespräch mit Eric Scaramozzino, VP Strategic Initiatives, und Tobias Janiesch, General Manager.

Wir arbeiten zügig. Der gesamte Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwischen 15 und 25 Tagen.

Wir haben versucht, dir so viele Informationen wie möglich über die Ziele, Aufgaben und das Umfeld dieser Position zu geben. Jetzt bist du an der Reihe: Zeig uns, ob du glaubst, dass diese Position dir die Möglichkeit bietet,

a) Spaß an deiner Arbeit zu haben und

b) einen wertvollen Beitrag zu unserem Unternehmen zu leisten.

Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Im schlimmsten Fall investierst du ein paar Minuten, im besten Fall ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten außerdem betonen, dass wir Vielfalt voll und ganz unterstützen und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und inklusives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderung oder anderen persönlichen Merkmalen ein. Vielfalt macht Pennylane zu einem noch besseren und angenehmeren Arbeitsplatz.

Als konkretes Beispiel für unser Engagement haben wir kürzlich den Pacte Parité unterzeichnet, um in den kommenden Jahren konkrete Ziele für einen besseren und inklusiveren Arbeitsplatz zu setzen.

Pennylane fördert Vielfalt in all ihren Formen und setzt sich für ein inklusives, wertschätzendes und erfüllendes Arbeitsumfeld ein, sowohl in unseren Büros als auch im Rahmen der Remote-Arbeit. title: Supply Chain Lead
descriptionHtml:
Build the supply chain behind technology that is already operating at scale.

We’re partnering with a fast-growing defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.

This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.

The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As production and international operations expand, they are now building a more resilient and scalable electronics supply chain across Europe.

We’re looking for the Supply Chain Lead to build and own this function.

The Role:

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll take ownership of the electronics supply chain end-to-end from EMS strategy and semiconductor sourcing to BOM resilience, logistics and cross-border operations.

This is not a procurement coordination role or an established function to simply maintain.

You’ll help determine where and how products are manufactured, how critical components are secured, which EMS and semiconductor partners the company builds around, and how the supply chain scales with production.

For someone coming from the European semiconductor, electronics or EMS ecosystem, this is an opportunity to move from owning one part of a mature supply chain to building one with significant autonomy and direct access to decision-makers.

Responsibilities:

  • Source and manage EMS partners

  • Manage BOM risk, including allocation, EOL, pre-buys and alternates

  • Build and maintain relationships with semiconductor manufacturers and distributors

  • Manage logistics from suppliers and EMS partners to the company

  • Manage logistics to customers in the EU and Ukraine

  • Manage customs and export compliance

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in electronics supply chain on the OEM or EMS side

  • Hands-on experience through a component shortage cycle

  • Supplier and distributor relationships you actively use

  • Working knowledge of EU customs and dual-use rules

Highly relevant: defence, UAV, robotics or other complex electronics environments; hands-on SMT manufacturing experience.

Why This Role:

  • The interesting part is not the title, it’s the level of ownership.

  • You’re joining at the point where the company needs to turn a fast-moving electronics supply chain into a scalable international function.

title: Supply Operations FRANCE & BENELUX (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Company: Ambio

Location: Berlin, Germany

Type: Full-time

Seniority: 1-6 years (attitude over experience)

Salary: 50-65k€ yearly based on experience and skills

Other: In this role, you are expected to be able to occasionally travel to visit our supplier partners and meet them at trade fairs.

Language requirements: C2 or native-level in French & Dutch, and able to work in English

About Ambio:

Ambio is the world’s first AI-native physical commodity trader. Our mission is to accelerate the transition to sustainable materials, and this mission is progressing fast in our first domain, recycled plastics.

We work closely with industrial manufacturers through the full procurement cycle, making sustainable material options an easy choice. With our AI-native approach and proprietary trading technology, we can offer the widest selection of recycled plastics on the market.

We’re a Helsinki-based startup with 19 employees in Helsinki, Berlin, and Stockholm, and funding from e.g. Lifeline Ventures, b2venture, and SpeedInvest.

More information about Ambio: https://ambiomaterials.com/

Position

Join Ambio’s Supply team to find, validate, and deliver recycled plastics to our growing customer base across Europe! We make sure our customers get the best recycled plastics to manufacture new products.

We do whatever it takes to drive customers’ success, and to grow our delivered volumes and our positive impact. We are continuously looking for great new materials and suppliers to complement our current offering - to then match them to new and existing customer needs.

This role is about leading our sourcing in France & BENELUX regions. It is a fantastic opportunity to work at the forefront of sustainable materials and operational-AI applications, and to make a difference in how circularity becomes reality. You will own and drive supplier cooperation, grow our supplier pool and build strong relationships, and ensure efficient delivery of high-quality materials. You also get to develop our software (the Ambio Platform) with our Product team to help us grow faster.

In your work, you will be given full ownership of what is in your responsibility, and the full support of the team to succeed in it.

Key responsibilities

  • Growth & Pace: You are the main driver together with our Sales team to drive our revenue growth - you are Supply owner for key accounts and projects.

  • Sourcing: You source suppliers and build business and long-term relationships between Ambio and them. You own your region, and you make sure we know the partners’ team, materials and production operations inside-out, ensuring high two-way trust and efficient sales and delivery.

  • Purchasing & Negotiation: You will ensure both high standards of service and quality assurance as well as a competitive price for Ambio’s customers. Your role is to excite partners to go the extra mile to meet our standards and service our demanding customers.

  • Product management: The whole Ambio team provides their expertise and context understanding of their function to the benefit of our Product team. You will support our software developers to make our service to our customer’s even more stellar, our pace of growth even faster, and your life easier.

Requirements

To excel in this role, we believe the ideal candidate:

  • Takes initiative, drives things forward without waiting for instructions, and turns ideas into action even when everything is not fully defined

  • Has a strong will to build, improve our company, and grow with it

  • Is excited to face new things daily and open to jump into new things, to meet new people and build a relationship with them

  • Likes to work with and talk to people, can communicate effectively and make our partners laugh and love working with us

  • Learns new things quickly, doesn’t hesitate in front of uncertainty, and adapts to situations

  • Can work independently and take full ownership of their work

  • Can keep their head cool and move forward steady even when adversity or problems arise

  • Is C2 or native-level in French & Dutch, and able to work in English. Other language skills are viewed as an asset (German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Slavic and Baltic languages)

Typical recruitment process:

  1. Intro: get to know each other

  2. Culture & case interview: practical interview through examples from real work

  3. Founder round: interview with one of the founders

  4. Peer calls: with your future teammates

  5. Closing: with your future team lead and/or one of the founders

title: Support Specialist
descriptionHtml:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

⛩️ Our Principles

Exciting challenges lie ahead. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1:

  1. 💙 Care deeply

  2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

  3. 🤝 Be your word

  4. 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency

  5.  🚀 Do your life's best work

  6. 🥳 Find the fun

Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook.

Who you are

  • 📣 Able to communicate very well, in a style that is fun, clear, honest, concise and engaging.

  • 🗓️ Organised, with the ability to juggle multiple things at a time whether that be conversations, tasks or projects.

  • 💙 A hunger to do your life's best work, to have a large impact on the struggling health system.

  • 🔍 Analytical, with the ability to crunch data and use a spreadsheet well.

  • 💪 Can take projects from just an idea, to fully complete.

  • 👌 A insatiable desire to help others, to always give NHS staff, one less task

  • 💎 A true attention to detail - as this is a trait that makes us stand out from the rest. It shows we care.

Desirable to...

  • 💙 Have worked in the NHS.

  • 🏎️ Have worked in a fast paced startup.

What the job involves

  • 👮🏾 An opportunity to have real positive impact with a passionate world class team, supporting the backbone of the country's health - NHS staff

  • 📣 Speaking to NHS staff, responding to problems, questions and ideas, quickly.

  • 🤩 Helping new customers get onboarded, and giving them a A* experience - they deserve it!

  • ✍️ To write best-in-class content so that you can support many practices.

  • ⚙️ Manage users' accounts; understanding concepts of: billing, user management, features, GP land.

  • ⚒️ Using modern tools such as Intercom Notion, Slack, and Typeform.

  • ✨ To bring customer insights and feedback back to the team, so we can improve our products.

  • 🧠 Think and implement ideas to help this area scale nationwide.

"Support @ Healthtech-1 is the front line to the wonderful NHS staff we serve every day! We're looking for someone who has the compassion and determination to help them get to the right solution. A career at Healthtech-1 is unlike any other. It's a career that changes lives. We're excited to hear from you!" -- Rupert, Head of Operations & Finance

💙 A bit about us

💙 We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world.

🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception.

💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🌀 We work in growth cycles. Every 8 weeks we do the same set of activities. 1 week outside of Business-as-Usual to research, strategise, plan our work. 7 weeks to knuckle down and deliver it.

🤝 We’re highly collaborative. One of the benefits of a high trust team is we often work autonomously, but as a team we’re very collaborative by nature. Two heads are often better than one, and we frequently lean on each other to solve problems together.

🤜🏽 We’re backed by industry leaders. We’re on the DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, backed by the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Program, winners of the London Business School Healthtech Challenge, Innovate UK, and Y Combinator (S23).

🚀 An opportunity for real upside

💉 Paid volunteer days. We offer an additional 2 paid days off per year where you can give back to your mission of choice.

🎢 Every 8 weeks we take a day off to socialise as a team. In the past we’ve hiked box hill, raved at All Points East and spent one rainy day at Thorpe park. This works out as 6 working days a year.

📚 Learning budget of £250 annually and time off to spend it - we care about this; this is flexible and based on need but everyone will receive a yearly allocation towards their continual growth.

🍽️ Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🥡 Team takeaways every Monday night

🥗 Health and fitness budget of £60 per month - see more here

🧘‍♂️ An additional 7 days of paid leave is available if you want to take time to learn how to meditate.

💫 Tooling; You’ll have your choice of operating systems and any additional tools you need to do your best work (e.g. keyboard, additional monitors, mouse etc). If you’re on our Engineering teams you’ll receive the latest MacBook Pro and our Growth & Ops teams receives a MacBook Air.

🩺 We know health and family come first which is why we have a generous sick leave policy with additional days that can be taken for mental health leave.

✈️ We prioritise time outside of work to bond, once a year we’ll holiday together! Destination chosen by popular vote. In 2025, we spent 8 days in a surf camp in France!

👎 No private medical insurance, because we believe in the NHS and we are here to improve it!

🐥 Parental leave: Post passing probation it is: statutory - 6 weeks 90% pay then, SMP for 33 weeks; if you've been an employee for a year: 12 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 27 weeks; and if you have been here for 2 years: 18 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 21 weeks. This will improve over time. We also include up to £9,000 of childcare contribution for primary caregivers to support a five-day return where possible.

👪 Fertility leave. We understand how difficult a fertility journey can be. This is why we give an extra 5 days off per year if you or your partner are going through fertility treatment.

🐖 Pension - We operate a standard 3% employer contribution and employees auto-contribute 5% of their salary. We use Nest as our provider.

🏡 Local living benefit - A one-off benefit to support living closer to the office: £5,000 if you live within a 30-minute walk, or £2,500 within a 30-minute bike. It is optional, available immediately on signing, and not linked to performance or progression.

🚕 If you choose to work late in the office, you can expense dinner after 7pm and an Uber home after 9pm, or earlier if you feel unsafe travelling in the dark. This is optional and about wellbeing, not performance or expectations.

⛵️And of course, an adventure of a lifetime!

🌈 Inclusive & Diverse by Design

We care about building a product that is loved and a culture that is rich in perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds.

Our team represents more than ten different cultures. We come together every lunch time for a home cooked meal, rotated among team members!

We want everyone in our team to know that they belong. We are purposeful about this and are proactively building a company that is inclusive of all people; from race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodiversity, disability, colour, and national origin - essentially every type of diversity. We don’t just want people who fit in, we want them to fit together. We're active in continually improving the way we make this happen.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als neues Teammitglied stehen Sie bei uns an erster Stelle. Sie möchten nicht nur Positionen besetzen, sondern Recruiting-Strukturen aufbauen und verbessern? Verstärken Sie unser Group-HR-Team in Düsseldorf als Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d). In dieser Rolle verbinden Sie operatives Recruiting für Holding und Werke mit der Entwicklung einer gruppenweiten Recruiting-Strategie, dem Rollout unserer Recruiting-Plattform JOIN und ausgewählten Aufgaben der HR-Administration.

Die DIHAG Gruppe ist eine der führenden Gießerei-Gruppen in Europa. Unter ihrem Dach vereint die DIHAG traditionsreiche und moderne Gießereien sowie Bearbeitungszentren in Deutschland und Europa. Unsere Tochtergesellschaften agieren eigenständig in ihren jeweiligen Marktsegmenten und sind zugleich eng miteinander vernetzt. Gemeinsam entwickeln und fertigen wir hochwertige Gussprodukte für anspruchsvolle Anwendungen in Industrie, Mobilität, Maschinenbau und Infrastruktur. Aufgaben

  • Eigenständiges End-to-End-Recruiting für Holding und Werke: Bedarfsklärung, Erstellung von Ausschreibungen, Bewerbermanagement, Interviews, Auswahlkoordination und Vertragsvorbereitung

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer gruppenweiten Recruiting-Strategie unter Berücksichtigung von Personalbedarfen, Zielgruppen, Suchkanälen und internen Besetzungsmöglichkeiten

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit HR-Bezug oder ein einschlägiges Studium, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft oder Personalmanagement

title: Talent & People Lead (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About VIA HealthTech

VIA turns a therapy session into a finished session note, and session notes into a complete psychological report. That is work which used to cost therapists hours every week.

We are the market leading AI assistant for psychotherapists. Over 4,000 psychotherapists across the DACH region use VIA every day, and we process hundreds of thousands of sessions per month. We are ISO 27001:2022 certified and hold a BSI C5 attestation.

We are a multidisciplinary team of 12 in Berlin-Mitte. Being the market leader in AI documentation is our starting position, not our goal. We are going much deeper, into the therapeutic process itself and into how a practice is run, with products that will be regulated as medical devices under EU MDR.

The role

We are 12 today and plan to roughly double in the next year, across engineering, our clinical team and go-to-market. We are bootstrapped. Every salary is paid from revenue, not from a funding round, and a wrong hire costs us a year we cannot buy back. We cannot afford that mistake, so we do not hire good. We hire exceptional.

Today, hiring lands between three founder calendars that are already full, or with agencies. Both fill roles. Neither builds anything that stays. We would rather internalise it: one person who knows our bar, owns the whole pipeline and builds the people function around it. You are not joining an HR team. You are becoming it.

Recruiting is the core of this role, and the measure in year one is simple: every role we open, filled on time with someone excellent, closed by you. Everything else in HR is yours to build lean behind that.

What you'll own

  • The whole funnel, for every role. Briefing with the hiring founder, the job ad, sourcing, screening, interview loops, references, offer, close. You are the first conversation a candidate has with VIA, and the one who gets them over the line

  • Sourcing that does not wait for applications. The people we want are rarely looking. Outbound on LinkedIn and beyond, our network, the places where therapists, engineers and salespeople actually are. We use agencies today. After you, we do not

  • The bar. A process that reliably separates excellent from good: structured interviews, take-home challenges with the hiring team, scorecards, fast decisions. You say no to candidates the founders like, and you say it with reasons

  • Candidate experience. Answers within days, not weeks. Every candidate, hired or not, leaves with a better opinion of VIA than they came with

  • Onboarding. A new engineer ships on day two, a new Sales Manager runs their first demo in week one. You build the path from signed contract to productive, together with the hiring lead

  • A lean people function. Contracts, probation reviews, feedback and performance cycles, compensation bands and the tooling behind them. Founders' time out, structure in. Our ISO 27001 and C5 frameworks carry HR controls, from joiner and leaver processes to security training, and you own those with the Security & Compliance Lead (who may be one of your first hires)

  • The team as it doubles. Rituals, offsites, the things that keep a company twice this size feeling like the 12-person one that got here

Your profile

Must-have

  • A track record of closing hard roles yourself, in-house or at an agency, with numbers you can show: hires per year, time to hire, offer acceptance. Senior engineers and salespeople at minimum

  • Real sourcing craft. You find people who are not applying and get them to take the call

  • Judgement about people. You can tell exceptional from polished in a first conversation, and explain the difference

  • Closing instinct. You know what moves a candidate who holds three offers, and you negotiate for us without losing them

  • Builder mentality. Processes, templates and tooling you set up yourself, because there is nobody else to do it

  • Working knowledge of German employment basics: contracts, probation, notice periods and the thresholds that matter as we grow. Payroll and legal are outsourced; you know when to call them

  • Hunger. You want to build the people function of a company that is going to be much bigger, not run one that already exists

  • Fluent German and English. Our candidates and contracts are in German, parts of our team work in English

Strong plus

  • You have been the first People hire somewhere and built from zero

  • Employer branding, from the careers page to events

  • AI tools as a matter of course. One person using them well replaces a recruiting team

  • You have recruited in a regulated health-tech environment

This role is not for you if

  • You want to run HR and let someone else do the hiring. Hiring is the job

  • You need an ATS, an employer brand and inbound applicants already in place. You build those

  • You hire to fill a seat. We would rather leave it empty

What we offer

  • A team that outperforms. DACH market leader for AI assistance in psychotherapy within two years, bootstrapped, with a team of 12. Our plans from here are considerably bolder, and we hire people who want to be part of it

  • Ownership of a core function from day one. Every person who joins VIA in the next year came through you. There is no clearer measure of impact

  • High autonomy. Competence and execution are what count here. We do not put obstacles in your way

  • Direct work with the founders. Decisions in hours, not weeks, including on offers

  • Competitive salary plus equity, so that you participate in the company's success

  • Office in Berlin-Mitte with flexible hours, latest equipment and any tool you need. Berlin-based hybrid is our preference for this role

We are not looking for someone to administer HR. We are looking for the person who finds the people VIA's next year depends on, and then builds the function that keeps them.

Sounds like you? A short CV or your LinkedIn profile is enough. If there is a hire you are proud of, tell us about that one.

title: Team Lead, Software Development (Backend)- all genders
descriptionHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might be in the right place!

We're looking for a talented Software Development Team Lead to help us lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing software development team while fostering an inclusive environment that inspires them to do the best work of their career to date.

As a leader at Lightspeed, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Lightspeed. You also lead the team's delivery, enabling productive and sustainable ways of working while focusing on the most important things that bring long-term business value.

As a leader of strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must so that you can challenge and grow your team members. You will also be able to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery and work with your team on strategy and execution.

If you’re motivated by tackling technical challenges, delivering impactful solutions, and pursuing excellence within our distributed workforce, we’d love to hear from you!

Your Mission

Under your guidance, the team will take on the critical mission of supporting and enhancing our Restaurant Point-of-Sale product, helping businesses worldwide streamline their operations. You foster and strengthen a healthy, highly collaborative, and continuously learning culture across the teams.

What you’ll be responsible for

  • Be the trusted lead and partner of a development team of 5-6 members, guiding, motivating, and developing your team to solve complex business problems.

  • Enhance team growth through effective mentoring, coaching, and constructive feedback, while fostering a mutually supportive, inclusive, and collaborative environment.

  • You model hands-on, lead-by-example excellence—actively contributing to the codebase, providing high-quality code reviews and design feedback, and driving technical alignment in challenging areas.

  • Lead the way to develop performant, scalable, and maintainable applications and microservices, ensuring high technical quality and operational excellence in your area.

  • Collaborate closely with other teams, architects, product managers, and engineering leaders to align approaches and priorities.

  • Continuously improve our software delivery processes and practices, staying updated with industry trends to influence our strategic direction and foster innovation.

  • Provide technical and process guidance to your team, and participate in recruiting top talent for the organization.

What you’ll be bringing to the team

  • Proven experience leading a team of developers through successful software projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to convey technical information to a wide variety of audiences.

  • Solid understanding of development processes, testing, and CI/CD best practices.

  • Experience delivering horizontally scalable applications and microservices.

  • Passion for learning new things and desire to improve continuously.

  • Solution-oriented and constructive mindset and ability to manage ambiguity.

  • A backend development background with:

    • Advanced skills in Python (preferred) or Java.

    • Strong experience designing and building scalable APIs (e.g., REST, GraphQL) and database architecture.

Even better if you have hands-on experience with (but not necessary):

  • Interest in or experience with POS or eCommerce systems

  • Experience building scalable SaaS solutions

  • Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases

  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent

Who you are:

  • You are a problem solver who does not shy away from tackling complexity and critical thinking.

  • You have a strong will to learn, grow, and leave your comfort zone.

  • You have great energy and passion for technology.

What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience!

  • Lots of autonomy, flexible work culture with the option of working remotely or from one of our beautiful offices

  • Genuine career growth opportunities within a company that's continuously expanding.

  • Make a meaningful impact by helping merchants grow their businesses through creating or improving products and addressing customer feedback.

  • Be part of a team large enough for growth yet agile enough for real impact.

  • Work on high-traffic products with a global user base.

  • Opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and expand your expertise.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

title: Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kurz und knapp

Suchst du eine Führungsrolle, in der deine positive Energie und dein Teamgeist den Unterschied machen?

Bei Picnic suchen wir nicht nur jemanden, der Prozesse steuert, sondern eine Führungskraft, die ihr Team inspiriert und jeden Tag zu einem Erfolgserlebnis macht. Als Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d) bist du das Herzstück des täglichen Betriebs in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Nürnberg. Du coachst, motivierst und unterstützt dein Team aus Shoppers, stellst sicher, dass sie sich wohlfühlen und gemeinsam Großes leisten. Dein Engagement ist entscheidend, um unsere Lagerabläufe reibungslos zu gestalten. Im engen Austausch mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung sorgst du dafür, dass wir als großes Team unsere täglichen Ziele erreichen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Leite, motiviere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus 20+ Shoppers. Du bist ihre erste Ansprechperson, hast stets ein offenes Ohr und förderst ihre Entwicklung.
  • Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung steuerst du proaktiv die Prozesse im FC. Du trägst maßgeblich zu einer positiven und unterstützenden Arbeitsatmosphäre bei.
  • Tagesgeschäft: Stelle sicher, dass alle Einkäufe pünktlich, sicher und in bester Qualität das FC verlassen. Dabei bist du der Fels in der Brandung, der auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf bewahrt und Ruhe ausstrahlt.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Bringe deine Ideen ein und verbessere gemeinsam mit dem Leadership stetig unsere Logistikprozesse. Du ermutigst dein Team, mitzudenken und sich aktiv einzubringen.
  • Faires Gehalt mit Perspektive: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 34.000 € und 38.000 € brutto, bewertet durch jährliche Performance Reviews, für deine persönliche und finanzielle Weiterentwicklung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Logistik, Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Ähnlichem absolviert.
  • Alternativ bringst du min. 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in der Teamleitung oder einer ähnlichen Führungsposition in der Logistik mit.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse, um dich in unserem internationalen Team zu verständigen.
  • Du bist flexibel für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) in einer 37,5-Stunden-Woche.
  • Du liebst es, mit Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten und packst selbst mit an.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte durch - mit uns: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.
  • Die Basics: Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – mit Zugang zu modernen und innovativen Tools, die dich im Arbeitsalltag optimal unterstützen, sowie exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.
  • Zeit zum Auftanken: Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.
  • Verpflegung für Gewinner: Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Ob bei unseren Weihnachts- oder Sommerpartys und weitere Teamevents – wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam und schaffen Erinnerungen, die verbinden.
  • Lebensmittelretter: Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!
  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.
  • Absicherung für morgen: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.

title: Technical Lead (Core Services)
descriptionHtml:
Technical Lead – Core Services

Build the Future of AI in Financial Services

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows.

We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our team to meet that demand.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the core services that underpin Aveni’s platform.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with responsibility for the architecture, quality and operational reliability of the foundations our product teams build upon. You’ll work across areas including client-data ingestion and preprocessing, CRM integrations and APIs, multi-tenancy, identity and authentication, and data lifecycle and retention.

You’ll lead the technical direction of a team of around six to seven engineers, remaining close to the code while making architectural decisions, setting engineering standards and helping other engineers grow.

Our platform supports regulated financial-services organisations, so reliability, security, auditability and data isolation aren’t afterthoughts — they’re fundamental to how we design and build.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Owning the technical architecture and direction of Aveni’s core platform services.

  • Designing and building scalable, event-driven services on AWS.

  • Developing and evolving our client-data ingestion capabilities, enabling new clients and data sources to be onboarded increasingly through configuration rather than bespoke engineering.

  • Building and maintaining APIs that give Aveni products a consistent way to consume client and CRM data.

  • Designing robust multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, security and operational controls.

  • Leading our approach to data lifecycle management, including retention, deletion, residency and GDPR requirements.

  • Building resilient integrations with third-party platforms and APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, retries, reconciliation and failure recovery.

  • Making and documenting architectural decisions and representing Core Services in Architecture Review Board discussions.

  • Raising engineering standards across testing, observability, security, reliability and operational ownership.

  • Remaining hands-on with production code, primarily across Node.js and AWS.

  • Mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions and technical coaching.

  • Helping the team make effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle while maintaining strong engineering judgement and appropriate controls.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

  • Significant software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and architectural decision-making.

  • Deep production experience with Node.js, particularly across backend, API and distributed systems.

  • Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native systems on AWS.

  • Experience building event-driven architectures and an understanding of the challenges that come with asynchronous distributed systems.

  • Experience designing production systems with complex multi-tenancy, data isolation or data lifecycle requirements.

  • Strong experience integrating with third-party APIs and designing for rate limits, partial failures, retries and reconciliation.

  • A strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational ownership.

  • Experience making architectural trade-offs and communicating technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.

  • A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards.

  • The ability and desire to remain hands-on while providing technical direction to a team.

Desirable

  • Production experience with Python alongside Node.js.

  • Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Auth0, AWS Cognito or similar.

  • Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0 and authentication/authorisation patterns.

  • Experience building software within financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Experience handling data residency, retention and GDPR erasure requirements at scale.

  • Experience contributing to Architecture Review Boards or similar technical governance forums.

  • Experience establishing or improving AI-assisted software engineering practices.

The Kind of Technical Lead We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for someone who has moved completely away from engineering.

You’ll still design systems, review code, solve difficult technical problems and contribute to production software. At the same time, you’ll create leverage by helping the engineers around you make better decisions and take greater ownership.

You’ll be comfortable asking questions before reaching for a solution, thinking through failure modes as carefully as the happy path, and balancing architectural quality with the realities of delivering software in a fast-growing business.

You don’t need to have used every AWS service or technology in our stack. What matters more is that you understand the underlying engineering problems, can explain the trade-offs behind your decisions, and have successfully operated the systems you’ve helped design.

Benefits at Aveni

What you’ll love:

  • Remote-first working across the UK

  • Work abroad policy

  • Co-working spaces available

  • 34 days holiday (including flexible bank holidays) and your birthday off

  • Company-wide off-sites

  • Optional Personal Development Plan

  • Protection essentials including Life Insurance, Income Protection, Critical Illness cover, and Pension (up to 5% matched employer contribution with optional increased contributions)

  • Private health and dental care

  • Potential share options

  • Enhanced family leave

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we’d love to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet 100% of requirements, we’d like to hear from you anyway if you believe you’d fit in. Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.
