title: Technical Product Manager, Developer Experience & Product-Led Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're looking for a highly technical Product Manager to own how developers discover, build on and grow with Telnyx.

Telnyx operates a global infrastructure platform spanning communications, AI inference, GPUs, edge compute, databases and real-time applications. We've invested heavily in building the underlying infrastructure. Now we want to make it dramatically easier for developers to understand what's possible, build useful applications and get into production.

This is a hands-on product role leading a small team of six engineers across Developer Relations and Product-Led Growth. We aren't looking for a traditional DevRel leader or someone whose primary skill is managing people. We want a strong engineer with excellent product judgment who understands developer experience, builds things personally and knows how to turn developer adoption into revenue. 

The Team

You'll lead a team of six: three DevRel engineers (sample apps, open source, technical content and demos) and three PLG engineers (activation, AI agents and automation, self-service conversion and expansion). You'll report to the Chief Operating Officer. 

What you'll own

  • Build applications developers actually want to use — Lead the DevRel team in building production-quality sample applications, integrations, templates and reference implementations on Telnyx. Publish them on GitHub, maintain them and make them easy for developers to deploy and extend. Turn those applications into compelling technical content, live demos and developer distribution.
  • Drive product-led growth — Own the PLG operation responsible for moving developers from signup to meaningful usage and revenue. Use product telemetry, behavioral signals, AI agents and human intervention to identify friction, accelerate onboarding, improve conversion and expand self-service usage.
  • Make the developer experience better — Get hands-on with our APIs, SDKs, documentation and infrastructure. Work directly with product engineering to identify and resolve the issues that make products difficult to use. Our reference applications should continuously test whether our products are genuinely ready for developers.
  • Build AI-native growth systems — Work with Growth Engineering and RevOps to develop automated workflows for developer acquisition, onboarding, account intelligence, technical assistance and expansion. We believe small teams of excellent technical people supervising powerful automation can outperform much larger traditional GTM organizations.
  • Connect the entire developer journey — Applications attract developers. Developers experiment with the platform. PLG helps them succeed. Production usage generates revenue. The feedback from that process improves our products and informs what we build next. You'll be accountable for making that system work. .

What we're looking for

  • A strong software engineering background. You should be comfortable building and debugging real applications, working with APIs, reading code and understanding complex infrastructure.
  • Experience as a Technical Product Manager, founding engineer, technical founder or similar role with substantial personal responsibility for shipping software.
  • Exceptional product judgment, particularly around developer tools, APIs, documentation, onboarding and usability.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure, LLMs, inference, cloud platforms, real-time systems or developer infrastructure.
  • Understanding of product-led growth, including developer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention and monetization.
  • Ability to work with AI coding agents, automation frameworks, product analytics and modern developer tooling.
  • Strong technical communication skills. You can explain complicated technologies clearly and recognize what makes a useful demonstration or reference application.
  • Comfortable leading a small technical team while remaining deeply involved in the actual work.

Experience at a developer infrastructure company is valuable. Experience personally building and growing something developers love is more important.

How we'll measure success

Your primary objective is growing developer-led revenue on Telnyx.

We'll look at activated developers, production applications deployed, self-service conversion, usage expansion and retention. We'll also measure the adoption of our reference applications, how effectively our developer content attracts users and how quickly developers can get from signup to a working application.

We care about applications developers actually use, not demos shipped for the sake of demos. We care about developers reaching production, not just generating signups. And we care about revenue, not vanity metrics.

Who will thrive here

Someone who would rather build a working prototype than spend a week debating a roadmap. Someone who notices a broken onboarding experience and immediately starts fixing it. Someone who understands both what makes infrastructure technically excellent and what makes developers want to use it.

You should be capable of leading six very technical people because you have the engineering ability, product instincts and judgment to make everyone around you more effective.

This is a builder's job, not a professional management job.

We're looking for someone who can make Telnyx a platform developers genuinely love building on, and turn that into a meaningful business.

title: Technical Program Manager, Cloud
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking experienced and highly motivated Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to join our Cloud Infrastructure organization and drive the delivery of complex, high-impact infrastructure programs.

As Mistral continues to scale its AI compute infrastructure, bringing new capacity online quickly and reliably is critical to our success. This involves not only deploying physical infrastructure but also coordinating the engineering efforts required to make that infrastructure fully operational.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of cloud engineering, software infrastructure, and data center deployments, ensuring seamless execution across multiple technical teams.

You will coordinate programs involving networking, storage, Kubernetes, fleet management, and infrastructure operations, working closely with engineering teams to manage dependencies, anticipate risks, and accelerate the deployment of production-ready compute capacity.

The TPM role spans several critical areas of program management:

Cloud Infrastructure Deployment – Coordinate the software deployment and bring-up of new compute infrastructure, ensuring smooth transitions from physical data center deployment to fully operational cloud environments.

Technical Program Management – Plan, execute, and oversee complex infrastructure programs involving multiple engineering teams, managing dependencies, timelines, and technical risks to ensure successful delivery.

Cross-Functional Engineering Coordination – Work closely with Cloud Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure, Networking, Storage, Kubernetes, and Fleet teams to align priorities, resolve blockers, and drive execution.

Engineering Operations & Process Improvement – Identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure deployment processes, improve coordination, and introduce scalable, lightweight workflows that accelerate delivery.

Location & Office Policy

The position is based in our Paris HQ offices and we encourage going to the office as much as we can (at least 3 days per week) to create bonds and smooth communication. Our remote policy aims to provide flexibility, improve work-life balance and increase productivity. Each manager can decide the amount of days worked remotely based on autonomy and a specific context (e.g. more flexibility can occur during summer). In any case, employees are expected to maintain regular communication with their teams and be available during core working hours.

What You Will Do

Program Management — Lead and coordinate complex cloud infrastructure programs, from physical infrastructure handover through software deployment and production readiness.

Infrastructure Deployment — Oversee the software bring-up of newly deployed compute infrastructure, coordinating engineering teams responsible for networking, storage, Kubernetes, fleet delivery, and infrastructure health.

Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with Cloud Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure, and other technical teams to ensure alignment across deployment activities, technical dependencies, and operational priorities.

Project Delivery — Define and track project milestones, timelines, and resources. Anticipate blockers, coordinate technical dependencies, and ensure infrastructure is brought into production efficiently and reliably.

Process Improvement — Continuously identify opportunities to improve deployment workflows, reduce time to production, and establish scalable processes that support our growing infrastructure needs.

Stakeholder Management — Maintain clear communication with engineering teams, technical leads, and leadership, providing visibility into program progress, risks, and key decisions.

Risk Management — Proactively identify technical and operational risks, develop mitigation strategies, and drive the resolution of critical issues that could delay infrastructure availability.

What We're Looking For

  • You hold a degree in a relevant scientific or technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline).

  • You have at least 4 years of relevant experience managing technical programs, preferably in cloud infrastructure, software infrastructure, data centers, GPU computing, hosting, or related environments.

  • You have proven experience coordinating complex technical projects involving multiple engineering teams and interdependent workstreams.

  • You have a strong understanding of infrastructure deployment processes and the technical challenges involved in bringing systems into production.

  • You have excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex programs and drive execution in fast-paced environments.

  • You thrive in cross-functional collaboration and can effectively communicate with engineers, technical leads, and senior stakeholders.

  • You are highly organized and know how to manage cross-team dependencies, anticipate blockers, and keep projects moving forward.

  • You are a proactive problem-solver with a continuous improvement mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking ownership.

Ideally, you have:

  • Experience managing cloud infrastructure or large-scale data center deployment programs.

  • A background in cloud engineering, software infrastructure, platform engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, networking, storage systems, distributed systems, or infrastructure automation.

  • Experience working on GPU infrastructure, HPC environments, or large-scale compute deployments.

  • Experience coordinating projects involving both physical infrastructure and software engineering teams.

  • Previous experience as a Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, SRE, or Technical Program Manager.

  • Already worked in an AI company or on large-scale AI infrastructure projects.

descriptionHtml:

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

  • Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

  • Figma

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout & Components

  • Design Tokens

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in complete user journeys, not just beautiful screens.

This Role Is Not For

  • Individuals who require extensive direction before making design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Switzerland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Switzerland.

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie
descriptionHtml:
Over ons

Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid.

Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd.

We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen.


Het Operations Team

Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. Snelheid en kwaliteit gaan bij ons hand in hand, en we verbeteren continu op basis van wat we leren. Met een groeiend medisch acceptatieteam en uitbreiding naar meerdere Europese landen, speel jij een directe rol in iets wat echt impact maakt.


Jouw rol

Als Medisch Acceptatie Werkstudent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in een van de meest persoonlijke momenten van hun ondernemerschap. Je werkt nauw samen met medische specialisten en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen soepel, nauwkeurig en klantgericht verlopen. Dit is geen standaard bijbaan — je draait mee in een snel groeiend team waar jouw bijdrage echt telt.


Wat ga je doen
  • Klantcontact. Je beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat. Je legt complexe verzekeringspolissen en medische beslissingen uit op een manier die klanten écht begrijpen.
  • Gegevensbeheer. Je vraagt medische dossiers op bij huisartsen en specialisten, controleert de volledigheid en verwerkt alles nauwkeurig in ons systeem.
  • Samenwerken met specialisten. Je fungeert als schakel tussen de klant en de medisch specialist — je vat informatie samen, signaleert complexe vraagstukken en houdt de communicatie helder.
  • Administratie. Je houdt klantgegevens up-to-date, verwerkt poliswijzigingen en bewaakt deadlines.

    • Wat je meebrengt
  • Je studeert momenteel, bij voorkeur in een richting met raakvlakken aan zorg, communicatie of bedrijfskunde.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 24 tot 32 uur per week.
  • Je Nederlands is uitstekend — zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dit is een harde eis, omdat je dagelijks contact hebt met Nederlandstalige klanten.
  • Je bent georganiseerd, schakelt makkelijk tussen taken en verliest deadlines nooit uit het oog.
  • Je hebt een oprechte klantgerichte instelling — je vindt het fijn om mensen echt te helpen, ook als het niet makkelijk is.
  • Je bent bereid het WFT-examen te halen als onderdeel van je professionele ontwikkeling. Wij betalen het en begeleiden je erdoorheen.

    • Wat wij bieden
  • 💰 Marktconforme vergoeding — we betalen goed, omdat we de besten willen aantrekken.
  • 🏖️ 25 vakantiedagen — plus een extra vrije dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is.
  • 🏠 Hybride werken — twee dagen per week thuiswerken als je eenmaal ingewerkt bent.
  • 🚆 Reiskostenvergoeding — we helpen je met je woon-werkverkeer.
  • 🎯 €50 netto per maand via Alleo — op te sparen en te besteden aan wat jij wilt, van sportschool tot UberEats.
  • 💻 MacBook van de zaak — zodat je altijd snel en efficiënt kunt werken.
  • 🎉 Echte teamcultuur — maandelijkse borrels, kwartaaluitjes, lunch & learns en meer.
  • 📈 Ruimte om te groeien — bij Insify groei je mee met het bedrijf. Voor de juiste persoon is dit veel meer dan een werkstudentpositie.
